le'u gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/dus na sna tshogs bzang zhes bya ba'i mchod sbyin la drang srong rnams rtsod par gyur pa na/ der a shad tha'i 'bras bu za ba la serdzogs pas smras pa/ byol sesnang rnams kyi mchod sgyin bya'o zhes zer ro/ /skra g.yeng la sogs pas smras pa/ byol song bsad par mi bya'o zhes zer ro/ /zhes dang /gzhung las kyang/go bin mchod sbyin shing shun can/ /'be shan ba na zhes byadag/sngon lanar byol song bsad bya bag /'di dag gis ni nye bar brtags/ /der ni gnyis skyes mang thos kyis/ /'di skad zer ba chos min zhes/ /de yi gzhung de rab tu bkag /de ltar shin tu rtsod par rgyud /zhes sogs sam/ yang la la ltar na/ gnyis ldan yan chad du ma byung bad rtsod dus ma dag par byung bar 'dod de/ drang srong bskyed byed kyi yal ga las smras pa/ sngon dus gnyis ldan 'jig rten 'dir/ /thams cad 'tshe ba med par gnas/ /de nas don la gdu gyur nas/ /byol song dag ni bsad pa nyid/ /chos ldan e lnga bsad byas shing] /sngon gyi rig byed bor nas ni/ /rdzas kyi don du rig byed kyang] /rig la gzhan du bsgrub par byed/ /ces sogs ltar mchod sbyon gnyis rim bzhin byung zhing] mdo ltar drang srong la las bskal ba du ma dran mod kyang] bskal ba 'di la gsar du byung zhing/ mkhas pa phal cher dang 'jug pa rtsa'agrel ltar grangs can snga mar bya'o/ /gnyis pa rnam grangs ni/ gzhadarje rnghi rgas gsabyed 4g.yonangaka /zhes pa rang sde nang pa sangs rgyas pa las gzhan gyi sde yin pas gzhan sde/ de'i lugs las phyi rol tu gyur pas pyi rol pa dngad mu stegs kyi skad dod tīr zi ka ni/ sgra bhyor bam gnyis las/ 3ra thi ka ni༈ra thi spribya te twā rba dges bya ste mtsho'i 'gram nas mtshor 'jug pas stegs 'cha' ba dang / zhes sogs dang / sher sgron 'grel bshad las/ mu stegs byed ces bya ba ni/ gangadag chos kyi phyir 'jug ngogs su 'jug par byed pa ste/ nor lha dang lha chen po dang tshangs pa dang ser skya dang gzeg zan dang/ rkang migadangaka 'phel bdang/ rgyaladapogs kyi bu la sogs pa'o zhes gsungs 63
grub mtha'i rnam bshabāpadang/ khyad par 'phags bstod 'grel ba las/ mu stegasani thar pa dang mtho ris kyi lam ste/ de ston par byed pa'i bstan bcos la mu stegs zhes bya la/ de byed pas na mu stegs byed de zhes dang / gzhi 'grel las/ gang dag la chu klung du 'jug pa'i thar pa'i lam yod pa 'di dag ni mu stegs can no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltag 'jugangogs khus dang stegs bu byas te/der zhugs pa thar pa ste bde 'gro'i rgyur smra ba de byed pas mu stegs byed ces bya yi/ stag los thar pa mu dang de'i stegs khad nye ba'i lam byed pas mu stegs pa zer ba dang] la las kyang bzang spyod 'grel bar 'khral nas nang pa kun mu stegs par 'dod pa ni zhakhrul ba'o/ /gsum pa dbye ba ni/ nyer lnga bshad kyang bedir gsal mi 'dra khyim/ /lngar gsal rang rjer mi mtshungs grangs ma bkag /chad sgagacigadang rtag sgabacagacig grags/ /zhes pa rje'i ṭīka chen dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i stong thun las/ grangs can las gyes pa'i gzhan sde nyer lnga yod par gsungs pa ltar yin te/ 'grel bshad spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las/ grangs can dag las zhes bya ba ni/ grangs can dag las gyes pa nyi shu rtsalnga yod do zhes grags pa de dag las so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /nyer lnga 'dir mi gsal yangarga lang gshegs las/ blo zos chen po mu stegs byed kha cig ni phung po dang] khams dang /skye mched rnams 'gog pa dang yul la 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / rtag tu chos mi mthun pa mthong bas sems dang sems las byung ba mang po mi 'byung ste/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang] da ltar gyi yul mi dran pa dang / mar me dang / sa 'on dang / de bzhin du rgyu zad pas rnam par rtog pa mi 'jug par brjod do/ /de'i phyir de dag de la pya ngan las 'das pa'i blor 'gyur mod kyi/ blo phros chen po 'jig par lta bas mya ngan las mi 'da'o/ /slo gros chen po gzhan dag ni yul la rnam par rtog pa zad bas/ mda'i shugs zad pa bzhin du yul gzhan gyi gnas su 64
le'u gnyis pa med mtha'adagag pa/song nas thar pa'o zhes brdzod do/ /yang mu stegs byed kha cig ni blo dang rig par bya ba mthong ba rnam par gzhig pas thar bar brjod do/ /kha cig ni rnam par rtog pa mi 'jug cing / rtag pa dang mi rtag par mthong bas thar par rtog go/kha cig ni mtshan mar rnam par rtog pa mthong lha shā /ga 55sna ñtsha ba skyursha par shāmi ('o /rdzu /rdzu /ji dzo spyam rsha kau (( pa dhri ṭwāṃ (sna rdzu ༵ mya ngan las 'das pa'i blor 'gyur bar brjod do/ /yang kha cig ni rang dang spyi'i chos thams cad kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid khong du chud cing / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa/ da ltar byung ba'i dngos ṭo mi 'jig ste/ yod pas mya ngan las 'das par rtog go /kha cig ni bdag dang sems can dang / srog dang gso ba dang skyes bu dang / gang zag dang chos thams cad mi 'dzig pas mya ngan las 'das par rtog go/slo gros chen 4 mu stegs byed mi mkhas pa'i blun 4 kha cig ni/ rang bzhin dang skyes bu'i bye brag mthong ba dang / yon tan 'gyur bar byed pa po'i phyir mya ngan las 'das par rtog go /kha cig ni ba〈snad nams dang ba〈snad nams min pa 〈snangs su zad pas/ kha cig ni nyon mongs pa dang zad pa shes pas/ kha cig ni 'jig rten rnams kyi byed pa dbang po rang dbang can du mthong bas mya ngan las 'das par rtog go/kha cig ni 'jig rten 'byung ba 'di ni gcig gis gcig zhugs pa ste/ rgyu las ma yin no zhes de rgyu la mngon par chags bzhin du gti mug pas khong du mi chud de/ de khong du chud bas mya ngan las 'das par rtog go/blo gros chen po pu stegs kha cig ni/ bden pa dang lam khong du chud pas mya ngan las 'das par rtog ko/kha cig ni yon tan dang yon tan can mngon par khong du chud cing / gcig pa dngam tha dad pa dang / gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka min bar mthong bas mya ngan las 'das pa'i blor 'gyur ro/ /kha cig ni rang bzhin las 'byung ba yin te/ rma bya'i rnam par bkra ba dang] rin 65
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/po che'i 'byung khungs rnam pa mang po dang / tsher ma rno ba lta bur dngos 4 rnams kyi rang bzhin mthong bas mya ngan las 'das par rtog go /slo gros chen po kha cig ni de kho na nyid nyi shu rtsalnga khong du chud pas/ kha cig ni skye dgu skyong ba dang / yon tan drug bstan pa 'odzin pas mya ngan las 'das bar rtog go/kha cig ni byed pa 4 dus yin par mthong ba'i phyir 'jig rten 'byung ba dus la rag las so/ /zhes de ltar khong du chud pas mya ngan las ladas par rtog go/blo gros chen 4 kha cig ni srid pas so/ /kha cig ni srid pa med pas so/ /kha cig ni srid pa dang srid pa med pa 〈snangs su shes pas 〈sna/ /kha cig ni srid pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa bye brag med par mthong bas mya ngan las 'das par rtog go/ zhes gsungs pas shes la/ 'dir kha cig ces pa nyer gnyis las ma byung yang] gron mde la gsum byas pas nyer lngar mngon nam brtags/ mu stegs kyi grub mtha' nyer lnga'i phal cher ston pa'i dus nas yod la ston pa'ang nyer lnga drenags yod de/ legs ldan phyi ma'i gzhung las/ ser skya dang gzegs zan dang 'ug pa dang / tsar ka dang dbang po dang] gsal ba dang sde can dang] bde ldan dang gser can dang / phyogs can dang sha ku nadangan sa ladaga' dang 'bri kun dang] ang gi ra ba dang] bu la skye dang bu la ha dang/ sa la smra dang phad tya ya ni dang ko'u thum dang / nar ya ni dang lo ma can dang / ma bu dang dzha ba nye ba la dadang bha sa dang] a shed thadang bha smi dang] shing shun canadang mdzi'i mi dang / shed dang rgyun shes kyi bu dngad 'jig rten mig la sesnags pas bskasnad pa gzhung la 'jug pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i mig yang dus dgor le'u gnyis pag tshangs pa pa/ dbang phyug pa/ khyab 'jug pa/ rgyang phan pa/ gcer bu pa/ stag gzig pa/ le'u dang por grangs can pa ste bdun dang] rtog ge 'bar bar grangs can pa/ bye brag pa rig byed skya mtha' gsang ba pa/ spre1da pa can/ mtha' bzhi'i skye ba dgag pa'i skabs/ rgyang phan pa/ gcer bu ba'i lugs bshad ba drug dang] gzhan yang tshangs 66
le'u gnyis pa med mtha'adagag pa/sna dī/ la stasna spyu sna /ta/ (ji /ga ༵ shā sbyi zhi ma tstsha ba ñdzaX rnyishā nā/ shā she/ rnyi /nā 〉pa /pa/ dus rgyur smra ba'i bye brag pa gcig lte gnyis/ yang de nyid las/ grangs can smra rnams yon tan med/ ces pas grangs can snga ma lha med pas/ lha'i yon tan de dag mi 'dod par bshad pa ste gsum/ de nyid las/ tshangs pa 'dod pa bram ze rnams/ /zhes pas tshangs pa'i bur khas len pa'i bram ze'am tshangs pa pa dang / yang pye brag pa gcig lte lnga/ de nyid las/ ser skya pa rnams stong pa'i tshul/ /zhes rang bzhin stong pa las snod bcud 'byung bar 'dod pa'i ser skya pa ste drug /de nyid las/ dbang po shul rnams nam mkha'i tshul/ /zhes bye brag pa sgra nam mkha'i 'angan tan du smra ba ste bdun/ de nyid las/ zad byed rgyal ba'i gzugs can rnams/ /dad pa 'bad de gzhol pa'o/ /zhes zad byed pa ste brgyad/ de nyid las/ dbang 4 lngadang nyer ldan pas/ /bdag 〈snad bram ze mchog rnams sesna/ /zhes rig byed mtha' pa lte dgu /de nyid las/ las med thar pa med kyang rung / /gzhung ngan rgyang phan pa yi gzhung / /zhes rgyang phan pa ste bcu/ de nyid las/dbang phyug pa yi bstan pa la/ /zhes serdzogs kyi dbang phyug pa dus 'khor ltar 'dzag bde rtsal ston gcig ste bcu gcig /de nyid las/ zla bas grub mtha' pa rtag tu/ /'phrog 4 la ni gus gzhol ba/ /zhes pas khyab 'jug pa ste bcu gnyis bshad la/ da dung 'der ma bshad pa'i dpyod pa pa dang / gsang ba pa sogs yod/ gang dag stag los 'di rnams de nyid rnam gsum gnas/zhes pas yon tan can pa grangs can pa dang / tshangs pa gsum du pyi rol pa kun 'dus par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ slob dpon byang chub bzang pos/ yang gzhan dag ni ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam pa bzhir bshad pa ltar/ 'das ma thag pa 'di gsum gyis phyi rol pa ma lus pa bsdus pa ni de nyid gsum lte 'og ma rnams ni 'das pa gsum las gyes pa'o/ /zhes pa ni 67
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/bdag gis khong du ma chud pas mkhas pa rnams kyis legs par brtags pa'i rigs theg zhes dang / dbus pa slo gsal rtsod pa'i seng ges kyang / sngon gyi slob dpon kha cig dang 4 dbang lcag gi yon tan brgyad dang / gnyis pa gtso bo'i yon tan gsum dang / gsum pa rang byung gi pa/ kṣiṃ /dri 〉pa snahā ba/traṃ ryaṃdzi /shā /lha ༵ ༵ rī krā rnyi(sdipa pa'i spya dī raṃ snashā ñtsha kyang gnod de/ rgyang phan pa dang] gcer bu pa de gsum sun 'byon pa po de gnyis de gsum gang yin brtags na dngos su 'gal bas seng/ /dbu ma rgyan las/ rnam pa'i skabs gzeg zan rgyal ba pa/ rgyal dpog pa lha'i bla ma pa ser skya pa 'og tu tshangs pa pa/ khyab 'jug pa dbang phyug pa/gsang ba pa rnams bshad pas bcu'o/ /zhi 'tshos tshad ma'ide nyid las/ le'udang 'os rang bzhin kho nas bskyed par 'dod pa'i ser skya pa lte grangs can ltand pa gnyis pasadabang phyug pa gsum pas rang bzhin dang dbang phyug gnyis gas bskyed par 'dod pa'i grangs can lhar bcas pa dang]bzhi pas rang bzhin smra ba rgyang phan pa/ lnga bas sgra'i tshangs pa pa'am brda sprod pa/ drug pas skyes bu rgyur smra'i rig byed pa/ bdun pas pye rig gnyis/ brgyad pasadapyod pa pa/ dgu bas grangs can gyi bdag gi khyad par bcu bas gcer bu pa/ bcu gcig pas gzhan stong 'dod pa'i gsang pa pa lte/ bye rig so sor byas na bcu gcigadang/ ma byas na brga 'do'idapyod pa par ma 'dus pa'i dus gshor ltar gyi khyab 'jug pa yod de/ dngor ba mtha' can du bshad pa'i pyid 'de'i tshangs pa'am brda sprod par ma gtogs pa'i tshangs pa pa/ rig byed pa gcig dang / 'de'i rgyang phan dang mi 'dra ba'i rgyu 'bras dang ltasogs 'dod pa gcig ste bcu gsum byas tshog pas/ kun btus rtsa'greladang/ slobadapon gdo'i lugs ltar bcu gnyis sam btsugasum byung/ de la kho na re/ chad smra gcig dang rtag smra sde bzhir grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyang phan pa/ grangs can pa khyab 68
le'u gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/'jug pa/ dbang phyug pa gcer bu ba lngar pu stegs kun 'dus pa'i phyir zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/slobadapon 'phags pa lhas/tshangs pa 'dod pa bram ze rnams//zhes pa rgyang phan grangs can gcer bu pa gsum la dogs pa med cing/khyab 'jug padang dbang phyug pa gang rung yang ma yin pa'i phyir te/de gnyis las zur du rtsa'agrel gnyis spus bshad cingadonayang mi mthun pa'i sgyid'o na rang sde la'ang thal rang sogs mi mthun pas grub mtha' lnga'am drug 'jog par 'gyur snyaman/mi mtshungs te/gzhan sde la grangs ma bkag pa'i phyirate/nyer lnga yang mdo dang bstan bcosadag las bshad pade'i pyidades ni bye brag pa dang/grangs can pa dang] dpyod pa ba dang/rig pa can pa gcer bu ba rgyang phan pa drug tu grangs nges par 'dod pa yang khegs so//khyod la'ang nyer lngar bshad pas gnod snyaman/sbyor gzhan sde nyer lnga kun gyi gzhung ma 'gyur bas bshad mi 'dod la/bcu gnyis su grangasanges paralang mi 'dod kyi/'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par che ba bka' bstan bcosanas bshad pa bcaganyis mthong bsadedag 'tshad ces pa'o//bzhi pa so sor rgyas par bshad pa la chad smra dgag pa rtag smradagag pa gnyis/dang 4 la/chad smra'i 'dod pa 'god/ de lasag pa gnyis/ dang so la/ ston pa dang] rnam grangs 'khral slong dang / grub mtha' gsum/ dang po ni/phur sa'ajiganyinanagadang 'jugastobasastob /zhes pa ston pa bco brgyadadang lha'i bla ma'am phur bus ltalha min 'thab tshe g.yul rgyal du re nas bsten pa mi yul du babs par grags la/de btus nas lang gshegs las/ blo gros chen yo 'jig rten rgyang phan pani 'bum las phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe lo lnga brgya'i tha ma langan pa'i rtog ge'i rgyur ltab /ḍā kṣiṃ ༵ smaṃ ༵༵ ndha zlo mb+ya sna rsha/ ba/tā kṣiṃ )pa dī sna ladraji ṭwāṃ pā ༷༈ ḍi midzo sta pa'i drang srong 'jug stobs ni de'i slob ma ste 'jug stobs kyi rnam par yod pas de ltar grags/69
grub mtha'i rnam bshadzhi 'tshos/ lus nyid las ni shes pa ni/ /skye bar 'gyur bar rigs so zhes/ /lnga ba can dang rta mtshog zed /gsungs pa ltaran lnga ba canadang] ltamachog nide'i ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshuramadzersāchad tshand 7phurabu ga /rgyang phan rtsogasartsosnang bzhinargyur sgagazug /zhes pa la tshe 'di la gang legs tsam gyis tshog par smra bas tshur rol mdzes par grags/ shi tshe bdag rgyun 'chad par spru bas chad smra/ skye ba dang las sogs ci rigs med par smra bas med spru/ phur bu'i rjes su 'brangs bas phur bu ba/ yang dag pa'i lta ba las gud du song bas rgyang phan pa ste/ ye shes kun btus 'grel bag a yo lha ni song ba dang] bral ba dang 'gro ba'i don to/ /zhes dang] mkhas pa blo gsal gyis kyang/ des na tshe snga ma rgyang ring du 'phen pas rgyang 'phen pa dang] tshe snga phyi mi gdod pas rgyang ba pa dang/ tshe 'di kho na la phan par 'dod pas rgyang phan la sogs par bshad pa ni rgyang phan pa'i sgra don mi shes pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang lha'i bla ma ston par 'dzin pas lha'i bla ma pa/ 'jug stobs ston par 'dzin pas 'jug stobs can pa tsher ma'i rno dang sran ma'i zlum 4 sogs kyi rgyu med par ngo bo nyid dang rang bzhin las byung bar smra bsango bo nyid spyabadang/ rang bzhin smra ba zer gyi/ stag tshang ba rang bzhin rgyur smra zer ba mi yod de/ de grangs can gyi ming yin cing/ 'de pas rang bzhin las byung yang/de rgyur mi smra ba'i phyir te/ zhi 'tshos rang bzhin smra ba rnams kyis ni/ /dngos 4 rnams kyi skye ba 'di/ /rgyu kun la ni stos med smra/ /dedag rang yang rgyur mi spru/ /zhes dngad ka shī'i de'i 'grel bga'o na gang dag dngos po rnams rang nyid las skye ba yinano zhes smra ba de dag las/ 'di dag khyad par ci zhes pa nas/ snga ma ni rang bzhin rgyur 'dod la 'di ni de yang mi 'dod do/ /zhes gsungs bas dren/ /gsum pa la 'khrul ba bkag nas dbye ba 'chad/ chad smra'i gtso bo'i lugs bshad pa 70

le'u gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/'jig tu shes pa'i bdag nyid kyis chad cing zad par 'gyur la/ gzugs kyi bdag nyid kyis zhig cing chud zos par 'gyur te/ shi ba'i 'og tu shes pa'i bdag nyid dang] gzugs kyi bdag gnyis gas bdag chad par 'gyur zhing mi 'byung la/ zhes lus sems kyi bdag nyid yin par bshad pa ltar lus sems dbang po'i sbyod yul du gyur pa tsam zhig bdag tu 'dod la/ blo gsal gyis/ chad smra dag ma shi bar du bdag shes rig tu skyes la/ shi nas chad par 'dod gsungs pa tshad ma'i lugs 'ga' zhig dang mthun pa ltar snang yang] skyes bu'ang de tsam kho nar zad/ /ces pa dang / bdag zad lugs dang 'gal lam dbyad/ ming gi rnam grangs skyes bu dang bdag dang /gang zag sogs so/ /dbye na 'gro ba gsum mam drug go/skyes bu de yang] mdo las/ srog ni 'di nyid la 'tsho zhing de phyis chad par 'gyug zhig par 'gyur phyis mi 'byung ngo / /skyes bu'i lus 'byung ba chen po bzhis 'dus byas pa gang yin pa/ de ni 'chi ba'i dus na 'byung ba chen po bzhi dag gi bag la zha bar 'gyur ro/ /mig la sogs pa dbang po rnams ni nam mkha'i bag la zha bar 'gyur te/ zhes pa nas de lta bas na byed pa po dang / za ba 4 dang shes pa po'i lus ni 'di nyid du zhig ste/ 'jig rten pha rol tu mi 'gro bas de'i phyis 'bras bu za ba po med pas sbyin pa la sogs pa med do zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/ skye ba yongs su len pa na/ /'byung rngubs dbang 4 blo dag ni/ /rang gi rigs la stos med pag /lus nyid 'ba' zhig dag la skye/ /zhes dang tshad ma'i de nyid nyer drug pa las/ de tshe 'jig rten pha rol pa/ /med phyir 'jig rten pha rol med/ /lus dang blo dang dbang po sogs/ /so sor skad cig 'jig pa'i pyig /'jig rten pha rol pa rigs min/ /zhes dang slob dpon snang bral gyis/ gal te 'jim gong tshe gzhan la/ /'gag pa mi skye zhig pa'i phyig /'bras bu yin phyir dper na ni/ /bum pa bzhin du 'dod tshe na/ /zhes bkod pa ltag zhig pa'i phyir skye ba snga ma dang 'jig rten pha rol med la/ yang 'phags ba lhas 79

le'u gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/nyid/ /ji ltar skyur dang nus sogs bzhin/ /skye ba'am gsal bar byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'byung ba bzhi'i khyad par las sems skye bar 'dod cing rtsashe'i 'grel bshad las/ rdzas su yod pa min par smra ba ni/ dngos 4 med pa yin par smra ba lte/ gos dmar sde dang mdo sde ba dngaka 'jig rten rgyang phan pa la sogs pa dag go/zhes gsungs pa ltag myang 'das ni phung 4 zad tsam dang/ lus sems zad tsam gyidangos med tsamayin pa dang/ rgyud gcig mi rung ba dang/rnam 'grel las/ blo ni lus la brten pa'i pyid /goms pas grub pa med/ ces pa ltag 'byung ba las sems skye ba'i rgyu mtshanade rnams kyi phyir 'jig rtenan nyon mongs rtsadanas spangs pa'idagrabcom gang yang med pas/ sangs rgyas dang thams cad mkhyen pa dang dge 'dun mi 'dod/ nyon mongs spangs pa dang spong byed kyi lam med pas/ dam chos kyang med par 'dod pa mang lte/ lung kṣiṃ nyi/kli spru kau shāsnran bandha/ ༵༵ ṭwāṃ kṣiṃ ṅge ṭā sna pa da pa tā/ (( spra rsha ṭwāṃ/ padī da spyad ༷ shā sum du byasanas bsgrub ste/ bdag cagani skye ba zadado/ /tshangs par spyad pa bstenano/ /bya ba byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan mi shes so/ /zhes go bar byed pa dag med do zhes de ltar lta zhing /de skad smra'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtog ge pa dag gi dngos 4 rtag brtan g.yung drung mi 'gyur sogs snyam nas dang / snyoms 'jug pa dag gis bsam gzugs gang dang gang thob pa na dgra bcom pa'i 'du shes skye la/ de slar 'chi tshe ting 'dzin nyams nas gnas 'og mar skye ba mthong nas/ 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa dang / de'i lam med do snyam nas de skad smra bar 'grel ba las bshad cing / yang ji tsam dbang po'i sgyod yul ba/ zhes pa ltar tshad ma ni mngon sum gcig pu dang] rjes dpag ni tshad ma ma yin te/ tshad ma'i mtshan nyid rang mtshan dngos su mi 'dzin pa'i phyir dang / lha sbyin gyi bu las sngo bsang dpog pa sogs gtan tshigs rnams zhakhrul ba'i phyir 81
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/rjes dpag kyang 'khral bar bshad do/ /pa dang ga/trā dī shā kṣiṃ (rsha la pa/snro shā ༈ shāsta shā paX /lha rdzu rshadī]tshon/ ndha snang smi sdu rnyisna sngon rtsong drana'ang lhag /zhes bya ba ni/ mngal gnas kyi tshe 'de'i sems gron ma chos can/ rang gi nyer len sems 'das pa'am 'grag pa sngon du song ste/ sems yin pa'i phyigadaper na btsas rjes kyi rnam shes bzhin/ slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ mngal gnas gron rol blo la ni/ /mdun rol kho nar 'gag blo yod/ /shes bya gzhan gyis de gzhan phyir/ /yang na blo phyir de 'og bzhin/ /zhes dang] zhi 'tshos/ de phyir thog ma'i rnam shes ni/ /rang gi nyer len stobs las byung / /rnam shes nyid 〈snags gtan tshigs kyis/ /da ltar ba yi rnam shes bzhin/ /zhes so/ /'phags pa min pa'i 'chi kha'i tshe 'di'i rnam shes tha ma chos can/ rang gi nye bar blang bya'i sems bskyed nus te/ chags bcas kyi sems yin pa'i nyid sdon gyi rnam shes bzhin/ zhi 'tshos/ shi kha'i skad cig rnam shes ni/ /rang gi nyer blangs bskyed nus te/ /chags pa byas pa'i 'brel ba nyid/ /cadan gyi rnam par shes pa bzhin/ /zhes dang] dbu ma snying po las/ 'phags pa min pa'i 'chi 'pho'i sems/ /sems gzhan skyed pa nyid yin te/ /ma rig pa dang bcas pa'i mig /sems de bskyed par byed pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /slob dpon dpa' 'os/ blo ni shes bya rtogs pa yin par gsungs/ /desan mngal gnas sngon rol blo yul 'dod/ /de 'di'i min mig la sesnags med pa'i phyis /gang gi yin te 'jig rten sngar ma grub/ /ces gsungs pa la/ kho na re/mer nur skabs su mig sogasadabang 4 dang/don ma phrad par shes bya med pasade mi 'thad zegde dus kyi rnam shes chos can/ mig sogs la mi ltos pa'i rang bzhin gyi blo yin te/ yid shes yin pa'i gyid dper na rmi lam gyi rnam shes mngon gyur pa bzhin/ des na rnam rtog thams cad 82
le'u gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/dbang po don dang phrad pa sogs la mi stos pa'i rigs can yin no/ /zhi 'tshos/ mig la sogs la ltos med phyig /rang dga' yid kyi blo yin te/ /rang gi nyer len stobs nyid kyis/ /hra lam sogs ltar 'byung bar 'argyug /'di ltar rnam par rtog rnams ni/ /dbang po dang don ltos ma yin/ /zhes dang / nur nur 〈snags la rnam shes ni/ /yod ces bya ba gzu lum min/ /der ni shes pa ji ltar med/ /rnam shes kun ni dbang 4 dngan /don gyi stobs las byung zhes pa/ /de ni mi rigs gang phyirade//gzhan du rmi lam sogs su'ang rigs/ /zhes dregags so/ /lus zhig kyang rnam shes ldog mi dgos pa ni/ de nyid las/ lus ni rnam par 'gyur na yang / /yid kyi blo ni mi 'gyur te/ /de phyir de la 'di rten min/ zhes pa nas/ de phyir lus ni 'jig na yangaka /yid kyi blo nider rten min/ /rang gi nye bar len stobs kyis/ /'byung 'gyur 'gal ba med pa can/ /gang phyir yid blo 'ba' zhig kyang / /'gal ba med pa de ltar yin/ /zhes sogs ya mtshan par sgrub pas zhib par der stos shig /brda la ma byang ba'i byis pa'am/ ze'u serdzogs tshos can/ skye ba gzhan du za ba dang] chags sogs la goms pa sngon song yinate/ bslab mi dgos par zas kyi ched du bskyod bdang/ chags sogs la 'jug pa'i phyig dper na/ dbang po smin pa'i mi bzhin/de skad du slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ ze'u yang sngon chad goms byas pas/ /byung ma zag tu zas 'tshol byed/ /zas kyi don du bskyod pa'i mig /dper na dbang 4 smin pa bzhin/ /zhes dang/ dpa' 'os/blo yi mthu stobs gsal ba med pa dang / /dbang 4 rnams kyang blun pa'i rang bzhin can/ /btsas ma thag du sus kyang ma bstan pag /kha zas za bar rtsol ba byed padangaka /nu zho 'thung bar rtsol bar byed pa yangaka /de dang tshe rabs gzhan la 〈snams pa'i mthus/ /zhes 〈sna/ /rig pa bem po'i nyer len las mi skye ste/ drum rig nyer len so sor nges pa'i phyis khyod kyi rkyen gyi rtags 'galasang/chang las myos mthu sogs de sgrub kyi mthun dper mi rung ste/ rtags chos gnyis ldan gyi mthun 83
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/dper mi rung ba'i pyid dbu ma snying bo las/ myos mthu shes yod ma yin pas/ /khyod kyi dpe ni med pa nyid/ /rgyu rnams rigs mthun pa yin pyid /gtan tshigs kyang ni 'gal ba nyid/ /ces so/ /pha rol gyi 'chi sems rtags su dgod pa ma nges pa tshe rabs dran pa yod pa'i pyir dang /bhyod tshul tha dad pa yod pa'i phyid 'das pa'i sems yod de/ legs ldan gyis/ gtan tshigs ma nges nyid 'gyur te/ /'das pa'i 'chi 'apo'i sems kyis sdu / /tshe rabs dran pa sogs yod dang / /rāX sgra ṭwāṃ /ra lha ṭwāṃ ༵ rshardol/ / mipa chi/rdha/ dzo rdzu sna rnghi sdus ༵ da pa) spra ṭwāṃ/ ni kho na re/ skye ba snga phyi yod du chug kyang / kun mkhyen dang rgyu 'bras ji ltar 'grub snyam na/ sems goms pa'i gsal snang 〈snang 'phel du 'gro ba'i gtan tshigs dang / chos gang dngos sa gzhan gyi phan 'dogs byed yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog gi rtags gnyis kyis go rim bzhin du kun mkhyen dang / rgyu 'bras 'grub lte/ dpal ldan chos grags kyis/ 'dod 'jig mya ngan gyis brlam dang / /rkun po hra sogs kyis bslad pa/ /mdun na gnas pa ji bzhin du/ /yang dag min yang mthong bar 'gyug /zhes sogs dang / tshad ma'i de nyid las/ blo dang brtseb la sogs dang / /'di dag ji snyed bshad chos ldan/ /de dag rab kyi mthar phyin pa/ /'od gsal kun mkhyen nyid 'byung 'gyug /zhes serdzogs dang/ des na rnam shes gcig la ni/ /chos rnams dag ni thams cad kyang / /cig car gsal bar snang srid pas/ /de lta bu dag rtags sbyi1ra gyis/ /zhes serdzogs kyis kun mkhyen 'grub la/ ka ma la shī las de nyid snang ba'i rab byed las/ gang phyir rang gi sa bon las/ /tsher ma la sogs skye ba nyid/ /dzño sogs de nyid las yin phyir/ /des na dbee ni grub pa med/ /de dag res 'ga' kha cig tu/ /'byung bar yongs su nges pa ni/ /bstos dang bcas par skye ba ste/ /bltos bya de dag rgyur 'dod do/ /rgyu ni phan pa 84
le'u gnyis pa med mtha' dgag pa/byed pa nye/ /phan pa med par ltos bya min/ /zhes sogs dang / zhi 'tshos/ de phyir dngos 4 gzhan dag kyang / /rgyu bcas nges las skye phyir ro/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa ltar thams cad las thams cad skye bar thal ba drenags kyis khegs zug/ /gsum pa ni/dezedacarngani4garjesadabaltabakar9rayangaka/zhes pa'i don yang/ skye ba snga pyi dang kun mkhyen med pa dang / sbyon sogs kyi 'bras bu med pa sogs khyod kyi mngon sum gyis ma mthong ba'i phyig zer ba'ang thams cad kyi'am khyod rang gis mngon sum gyis ma mthong pa gang la byed/ yang de dag med par mngon sum gyis mthong ngam/ rjes dpag gi yin brtags na/ zhi 'tshos/ kun gyis ma mthong ze tshom dang / /rang gis ma mthong 'khral ba ste/ /'bigs byed ri phug ngur ba sogs/ /ma mthong bar yang yod phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang 4 mi 'thad cing / pyi ma'i brtags pa gnyis kyang mi 'thad de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gal te mngon sum gyis so zhe na/ 'jig rten pha rol med pa ni mngon sum gyis rtogs par bya ba ma yin lte/med pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyig dngos 4 med pa bzhin no/ /gal te rjes su dpag pas zhe na/ rjes su dpag pas kyang mi 'grub ste/ med pa ba mngon sum tsam tshad mar smra ba dag la khas blangs pas gnod pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyig zhes dang slob dpon dpa' 'os/ rgyu dang bcas pas smra ba rgyu med ces/ /dam 'cha' rang nyid kyis gnod ma yin nam/ /ci snye'ang gtan /lhasatsho ṭwāṃ ༵ spya 1 lhapa ṭwāṃ/da/ ṭwāṃ tt+waṃ parnyi miga~X ༵ ༵༷dī ༷/ ༷ swāswā/ da/)lha ghnā pazlo pa pa pa/ ghnā pa3 /dī/ hā ghnā dzo dā ldu ༵ spri( paX pa /da /sdishā ( ༵༵ tā dzño tsho rsha rṇi sna rshaX ji/ ni/ /rtag tu thams cad las kyang thams cad 'byung 'gyur zhing / /zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/85
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/rgyu med gzhan la mi stos pyid /rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyud /zhes dang/ zla bas/ gal te 'gro ba rgyu yis stong bar gyur na nam mkha' yi/ /ud pa la yi dri mdog ji bzhin gzung du med nyid na/ /shin tu ches bkra'i 'dzig rten 'dzin pa'ang yin de'i phyir/ /rang gi blo bzhin 'jig rten rgyu las yin par shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltag skye ba snga pyi sogs yod rnyishā /( spras /pa sna( patan rshakā rnghi dri shārmo tt+waṃ shā 〉spras rsha dīpa ༵༵ ndha ༈ par/ ṭwāṃ ñdza ghnā legs par bkag zin to/ /sprus pa/dbu sems lung rigs 'od zer stong spros pas/ /med lta'i mun tshogs ma lus kun bsal te/ /yang dag lta ba'i padma 'bum bzhad cing] /shing rta chen po'i lugs brgya gsal bar byas/ /chad smra 'jig rten mig gi rjes 'brang las/ /med bsam rgyang phan rnam gzhag 'chad 'dod 'ga'/ /sbre'u rkun po'i ngang tshul ltar mthong nas/ /rgyu 'bras 'dod tshul lugs gnyis ma 'khrul bshad/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son g.yu 'brug sgra/ /bsgrags kyang grangs can rgyan pan ming tsam la'ang / /ches 'khrul sgra bshad kun slong sogs rmongs khyod/ /bza' bral star rdog skam sar da gdod shes/ /cal rgyugs tsam min rton bzhi'i gnad ldan pa'i/ /dpyod ldan skal bzang rnam sad ma lus kyi/ /dga' skyed legs bshad yongs 'du'i tshal chen 4/ /'jam mgon bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin spros/ /zhes grub mtha'i rnam bzhag zhabrul spong gdong lnga'i sgradabyangs kun mkhyen lam gsal slon me'i rnam bshad las med mtha' tshad bsal le'u gnyis pa'i 'grel pa byas zin to// //86
le'u gsum pa grangs can ser skya'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/༈ gnyis pa rtag mtha' dgag pa la/ grangs ser gnyis dang] tshangs brda rig byed mtha' gsang bzhi'i dang / khyab 'jug dpyod pa ba gnyis kyi dang / zhi bye rig gsum gyi dang] zad byed pa'i rtag mtha' lagag pa lnga/ dang 4 la 'dod pa brjod de dgag pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ston pa ming dbye ba gdod tshul bzhi/ dang po ni/ ser skyamatshod thosadabang lcagachu klung ston /zhes pa'i don ni khyad par 'phags bstod 'grel ba las/ de yang bskal ba dang po'i tshe ser skya zhes bya ba'i drang srong zhig byung ste/ de ni grangs can gyi bstan bcos rtsom par byed pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i drang srong ser skya dang / sngar ltar kun tu rgyu dag gi gzhung ltar na drang srong mchod 'os kyang yin la/ 'on kyang 'di ba la mchod 'os par ma grags pas phyi ba byings kyis mi 'dod dam snyam mod kyangaka 'di dag bshad tshod las/ gnas tshod gang la'ang dka' bar bstan pa'i ched du bkod pa yin pas shes par gyis/ dbang phyug kyang 'chad 'gyur ltar grangs can pyi mas ston par 'dzin cing] lhades rjes su bzung nas dbang phyuganag po'i rgyud sum cu pa dang drug cu pa sogs rtsom pa'i ston pa chu klung rnams ston pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ grangaphucagang bzhinargyur5seraskyasogag /zhes smras la/ slobadapon bo nyi bha tras/ 'dodangos po 'byung ba'i rgyu grangasanges pa smra bsan grangs can te zhesadang] legs ldan gyis/ grangs kyis 'jug pa'am/ grangs 'dzings su shes pa'i grangs can te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi grangs can dang sbyi'am sngar ltar rang bzhin rgyur smra bas rang bzhin rgyur smradang/ slobadapon shes rab go chas/de'i slob ma ming ser skya pa zhes bya lte/ ser skya'i buyin pasan ser skya pa zhes gsungs pasadang/ gtso sa mthong dka' ba rgyur grabs gtso 'o pa sogs so/ /87
grub mtha'i rnam bshabugsum pa ni/ da)ngo ser skya 63gsalalhand ga /grangasapon lhasabacasanasa'agabhāchu klung lugag/zhes pa dngaka 'dir cung zad dpyad na gzhung du mar ser skya pa dang/ grangs can pa tha dad du bshad snang ste/ zhi 'tshos/ nus pa ma lus dang ldan pa'i/ /gtso bo nyid ni 'ba' zhig las/ /zhes pa nas/ de yang yin zhes ser skya smra/ /zhes dang] de'i dka' 'grel las/ ser skya pa rnams na re/ zhes pa nas/ 'ba' zhig las zhes bya ba'i tshig ni/ dbang phyug dang bcas pa'i grangs can gyi brtags pa'i dbang phyug la sogs pa bsal ba'i don du'o/ /zhes dbang phyug mi 'dod pa'i ser skya pa bshad cing / le'u gsum par/ de ltar rang bzhin dbang phyug dag ces sogasadang]dka' 'grel las/de ltar rang bzhin dbang phyug dag/ces bya ba la sogs pa smos te/ de la grangs can kha cig ni gtso bo 'ba' zhig las 'bras bu tha dad pa 'di dag 'jug pa ma yin te/de ni sems pa med pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes dang/ yi shes kun btus las/ ser skya pa rnams stongs pa'i tshul/ /grangs can smra rnams yon tan med/ /ces dang / 'grel pa ltar na 'di'i grangs can pas kyang dbang phyug lhar mi 'dod par bshad cing/ grub chen sman zhabs kyis bdag gi rnam grangs sum sopa las/ dus las byung bdang/ 'dod rgyaladang/gnam gyis bskos pa dang gyi na bzhi ni grangs can gyi medod pa yin no/ /rtswal 'byor dang tshad ma dang dag pa dngan ma dag pa bzhi ni ser skya ba'i 'dod pa yin no/ /zhes dang/ 'od ldan las/ gang dag grangs can dang ser skya la sogs pa'i bstan bcosade kho na nyid yin pa'i blos zhes bshad cingaka'on kyang mi 'gal ba ni/ legs ldan sogs kyis ②bar ser skya zhes par 'grel bar grangs can du bshad pa'i phyigdper na zhi 'tshos/ ser skya smra zhes pa'i 'grel bad ka ma la shī las/ zhes ser skya pa ste grangs can rnams smra bar byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu shin tu mang zhing] 'jug 'grel drenags kyis kyang shes pas so/ /des na 'dir dbye ngo la gnyis te/ 'dod tshul phal cher mthun yang / drang 88

le'u lnga pa khyab 'jug pa dang dpyod pa ba'i rtag mtha'adagag pa/du mchod pa dang sa dang rdo dang shing dang / lcags dang blug gzar dang / chu dang padma'i 'dab ma ste snod bdun du dang / khyod mar gyi chu yi dbang bskur bar byed pa dag yin pa'i phyig de skad du rig byed las/ mi khyod kyi zas ni bdun no/ /lce ni bdun no/ /drang srong ni bdun no/ /khyim ni bdun no/ /nyin zhag bdun du lan bdun khyod mchod do/ /skye gnas bdun du khyod mar gyis tshems par byacas/ /swahwa/ zhes dren/ /gsum pa ni/ mngon sumarjesadabaganyer 'jagi5byungadangaka /donargadangos med ces bya'i tshadangadrug /gcigarigasadacadamigasagragasasnyalagagag /zhes pa/ dbu ma snying 4 las/ mngon sum rjes su dpag pa dang / /sgra las byung dang nyer 'jal ba/ /don gyis go dang 〉( pa (sra pa(/sa//spyan ༷/ ༵ pañdzab ༈ dzo rnyi ( ༵ ༵ tsha/ ༈/ ༵ ghnā sulha snang kṣiṃ rdzu/ngo//lha tshad ma dngos med tshad ma ste drug 'dod cing / mngon sum ni dang por don dang dbang po phrad nas skyes pa'i rtog bral dbang shes su 'dod do/ /kun btus las/ dpyod pa ba rnams ni yod pa dang yang dag par 'phrad pa las skyes pa'i skyes bu'i dbang po'i rnam shes kyi blo de mngon sum mo zhes zer ro/ /zhes so/ /du ba mngon sum gyis grub pa las me yod par dpog pa lta bu 'brel ba mngon sum du shes pa dang / gang zag gzhan 'gro ba mthong bas nyi zla sogs 'gro bar dpog pa lta bu'i 'brel ba mthong ba lta bu mngon sum mngon du 'gro ba'i shes pa gcig rjes dpag tu 'dod de/ phyogs glang gis/ dpyod pa la brjod pa mngon sum mngon 'gro can yin pa'i phyir/ rjes dpag la sogs mdor ma mtshon/ zhes bkag pas so/ /ba lang dang 'dra bar bstan nas ba min rtogs pa ni/ dpe nyer 'jal gyi tshad ma ste/ ji skad du gang gis ba min ci 'dra zhes/ /krong ba dag gis dris pa na/ /ba lang ci 'dra de 'dra zhes/ /'brog pas smras pa lta 131
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/bu'o/ /nyer 'angal ba lang grags ldan pa/ /zhes 〈sna/ /rig byed kyi tshig las lkog gyur rtogs pa lta bu sgra las don rtogs pa ni/ sgra byung tshad ma ste/ gzhan ni sgra las byung ba yi/ /shes pas rtogs pas sgra las byung / /yang na yid ches tshig yin zeg /zhes dre / /ma mthong ba'i don la tshad ma gzhan gyis drangs te don de rtogs pa ni don go ba'i tshad ma te/ ji skad du tshad ma drug tu shes bya ste/ /gang du don gzhan du 'gyur min/ /ma mthong ba las rtogs pa gzhan/ /de ni don gyis go bar bstan zhes serdzo/ /dbye na me tsha ba las sreg pa'i nus pa go ba dang / nyi ma song ba las 'gro bar go ba sogs yod de/ ji skad du/ de la sreg par mngon sum rig /me la (1)sogs pa'i nus yod dang / /zhes sogs sem/ /tshad ma gzhan lnga 4 gang rung ma skyes pa'i don gyi dngos por yod par rtogs pa ni dngos 4 med pa'i tshad ma lte/ ji skad du/ dngos 4 gang gi ngo bo la/ /tshad ma lnga po ma skyes pa'i/ /dngos yod rtogs phyir de la ni/ /dngos 'o med pa tshad ma nyid/ /ces 〈sna/ /dbye na snga na med pa'i/ zhig nas med pa'i/ gcig la gcig med pa'i/ shin tu med pa'i dngos po bzhi rtogs pa'i tshad ma bzhi yod de/ ji skad du/ snga na med pa la drenags pa'i/ /'di ni rnam pa bzhi ru dbye/ /zho 〈snags 'o ma la med gang] /'di ni snga na med par brjod/ /zho la 'o ma med pa nyid/ /zhig nas med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rta sogs ba lang la med gang / /gcig la gcig med par brjod do/ /ri song rwa dag med gyur pa/ /'di ni shin tu med par 'dod/ /ces so/ /de'i nang tshan kha cig ste/ tsā ra ka pa'am sman dpyad pa ni/ sbyor dug gi drang srong gcig byung ba las snod bcud kyi dug sogs byung bar 'dod pa sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa ltar dang / tshangs pa'i dbral ba snad pa 'tsho byed dran sogs smra yang btang snyoms byas nas tshad ma la drug tu ma zad/ de yod par ni 'di 'byung la/ /med par yang ni mi — wawa— wawa wawa ——1 dbus dbar dun la sreg132
le'u lnga pa khyab 'jug pa dang dpyod pa ba'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/'byung ba/ /de phyir de las byung ba de/ /'di ni rigs pa zhes brjod de/ /zhes pa nas/ 'di ni tshad ma gzhan nyid ces/ /thub pa tsā ra ka smra ste/ /zhes yod med rjes su 'gro ldog gi sgo nas rgyu 'bras rig pa rigs pa'i tshad ma dang / dmigs pa gang gi don gang zhig /rtogs pa de dngos med pa las/ /med pa nyid du rtogs pa de/ /ma dmigs pa zhes bya bar 'dod/ /dpe la ltos pa med pa'i phyir/ /'di yang tshad ma gzhan nyid yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ chags bral ma dmigs pas med par rtogs pa lta bu ma dmigs pa'i tshad ma dang / stong yod 'bras bus rtags las ni/ /brgya sogs yod pa'i shes pa skyes/ /zhes stong yod sar brgya yod par rtogs pa srid pa can gyi tshad ma dang / de bzhin du gtam rgyud rnying ba las don rtogs pa grags pa'i dang / der slebs so snyam pa'i tshad ma sogs 'dod do/ /tshad ma drug gi dgag pa mdo tsam kun btus rtsa'agrel sogs na'ang snang yang tshad ma'i de nyid ga'agrel ltar re re nas rgyas par bkag pa gzhan na mi snang bas rgyas par der stos/gnyis pa de dgag pa la lha'i khyad par dgag pa ni/ kun la gelhagazos 'gage'ajugbcakun /zhes pa ni/ khyab 'jug gis kun la ma khyab par thal/ bros pa'i mig dper na mi phal ba bzhin/ yang des bros pa mi 'thad par thal/ kun la khyab pa'i phyig dper na nam mkha' bzhin/ gzhan yang / khyab 'jug khyab 'jug la gnas par thal ba dang/ khyab 'jug gis khyab 'jug za bar thal ba dngaka khyab 'jug khyab 'jug gi lag pa la'ang 'ong bar thal/ khyab 'jug cha med dang gcig yin zhing kun la khyab pa'i phyir te/ rigs ldan grags pas/ khyab 'jug khyab 'jug la gnas shing / /khyab 'jug khyab 'jug gis za dang / /khyab 'jug khyab 'jug lag pa la/ /rgyu mtshan ci yi phyir na 'ong / /zhes dang / dbu ma snying po las gal te de la stobs yod na/ /ci'i phyir shugs can nag 4 yis/ /'jigs nas phug tu zhugs zhes grags/ /shugs 133

le'u lnga pa khyab 'jug pa dang dpyod pa ba'i rtag mtha'adagag pa/sogasango bo yod pa'i pyid /gzhan yinan yang 'chi med min/ /nas/ gal te gcigani zhi bdag nyid/ /yin yang gcig ni ma zhi na/ /bud med 'phyon ma'ang bsngags par 'os/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa 'grel ba skor gsum dang legs ldan gyi gzhung zugags lta'o/ /yang bu med pa la mtho ris med par 'dod pa rig byed dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ drang srong rgyal ba'i bu nee tso sogs gzhon dus nas dka' thub spyadade tshangs gnas su zhugs par bshad pa nyi ma'i nang du song bar bshad pa sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir te/ don dam bsnyen pa las bu med mtho ris gnas su mi 'gro ste/ /'dzig rten grags pa'i tshad ma gal te 'dor 'gyur na/ /ne tso la sogs gzhan yang gzhon nu'i dus suni/ /dka' thub byas nas tshangs pa'i gnas su zhugs par 'gyud /zhesadangankhyad par 'phags bstod las/ na tsos nyi ma brtol nas ni/ /〈snags so/ /khyab 'jug kun mkhyen du 'dod pa dang/ bud med dang phyugs rnams phrogs pa ma shes pa dris pa 'gal la/ de bzhin du sa chen gom pa gsum gyis mnan pa dang rgya mtshor 'gyo ba'i zam pa dgos pa 'gal/ rang gi nyo bar srid gsum gnas pa dang / rang gi chung ma phrogs pa sogs 'gal 'du shin tu mang ste/don dam bsnyen pa las/ kun mkhyen khyab 'jug gal te 'jig rten grags pa na/ /bud med bral ba'i dbang gis ci'i pyir phyugs rnams 'dri/ /gang gi sa la rkang pa gsum du byas pan/ /chu ladeyis ci'i phyir zam pa bcing bar byed/ /rang gi sto ba la gnas ma lus srid gsum pa/ /de yi rang gi chung ma ci'i phyir phyogs par 'gyud /sogasadangan dbu ma snying 4 las/ 'og tu zhugs nas sa 'dzin pag /nus na drang srong dmod pa yis/ /rang rigs sa 'og 'phro 'gyur ba/ /74na par mi byed ji lta bu/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyig des na khyab 'jug la gus na nyams par mi 'gyur ba dang thar pa ster ba dang dam pa ster ba sogs kyang 'gal ba dang mi bden te/ de la gus pa'i chung ma'i co to nas bzung lte dgras khyer ba dang] der ma zad de'i rigs rgyud nya5sa pa sogs 135

le'u bdun pa gcer bu ba'i rtag mtha'adagag pa/zag pa dang/ sdom pa dang] nges par rga ba dang / 'ching ba dang) lasadang] sdig pa dang/ bsod namasadang thar pa zhes bya ba dag go/zhes so/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang rnam grangs kyi khyad par ni/ kun kyang rdzasadang rnam grangs rtag mi rtag /ces pa/ srog lta bu'i tshig gi don phal cher gyi rdzas dang rnam grangs gnyis gcig dang tha dad pa'i tshul yod de/ de gnyis yul dus rang bzhin tha mi dad pas de'i sgo nas rdzas gcig dngad grangs dang / ming dang/ don nam 'bras bu'i tha dad yin pas/ de'i sgo nas rnam grangs tha dad par bzhag pa'i phyig dper na gzugs dang bum pa rdzas gcig kyang / rnam grangs kyis tha dad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ tshad chen las/ yul dang dus dang rang bzhin dag /tha dad med phyir gcig tu brjod/ /grangs dang mtshan nyid ming dang don/ /tha dad phyir na tha dad brjod/ /ces dang / gzhan las kyang / yul dang dus dang rang bzhin tha mi dad pa'i phyis chos dang chos can tha mi dad pa yin no/ /grangs dang ming dang mtshan nyid dang / /'bras bu tha dad pa'i phyir tha dad de/ 'di lta ste dper na/ gzugs la sogs pa rnams bum pa lta bu'o/ /zhes rtso/ /don ni rdzas ni grangs gcig dang ldan la rnam grangs ni grangs du ma can yin la/ bum gzugs sogs la sbyar na/ bum pa las gzugs la semags pa dag yul dus rang bzhin tha mi dad de bum pa'i yul dang rang bzhin gang yin de nyid gzugs sogs kyi yang yin pas so/ /grangs sogs kyis ni bum pa las de dag tha dad pa yin te/ bum pa ni gcig yin la/ gzugs 〈snags mang 4 yin pas grangs tha dad dang / bum sogs rdzas ni rjes su 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid yin la/gzugs sogs rnam grangs ni ldog pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas mtshan nyid tha dad pa dang / bum pas chu len la gzugs 〈snags dmar 4 yin no/ /zhes don nam 'bras bu tha dad pa yin pas /sna/ /tshad chen las/ gzugs dre gas rnams dang bum pa zhes/ /grangs dang ming gi rnam 179
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/dbye dang] /'bras bu dang ni rjes 'jug ldog /mtshan nyid dang ni don nam dbye/ /rdzas dang rnam grangs dag gis yin/ /zhes zug/ /bum pa gzugs gnyis ltar/ sems pa can dag gi rdzas nāṃ dī/ ༷༷ sdu/ ṭwāṃ sniX ṭwāṃ ༷༷ |spri ༷༷༷ ñdzaṃ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ /spra //shlau two /༷ ༷༷ grangs can kun gyi rdzas ni mi 'jigs pa'am mi ldog par rjes su 'gro bas rtag la/ rnam grangs ni rjes su 'gro bar med par ldog pa'i sgo nas mi rtag pa'o/ /ji skad du/ 'grel chen las/ zad byed pa'i grub pa'i mtha' smra ba la/ rdzas dang rnam grangs dag gis rtag pa dang mi rtag pa'i tha snyad du 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'di rnams kyi nang nas/ srog dang / dus dang / nam mkha' ni mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes dang / de'i rjes la 'gyur mang du/ gang zag dang / bsod nams dang / sdig pa ni mi rtag pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar na/ gang zag dang bdag la khyad par cher snang bar mngon yang / dbu tshad gzhan la mi gsal lo/ /gsum pa ni/ dusagasu4rdzasadrugasagacasadrugagagadagu/zhes pa/ 'das ma 'ong da ltar dus rtag pa rdzas yod gsum dang] rdzas ni drug ste/ 'grel chen las/ rdzas ni drug lte/ zhes pa ni/ srog dang / gang zag dang / dus dang / nam mkha' dang/ bsod nams dang / sdig pa'o/ /zhes so/ /srog can ni ka la ba'i zad byed pa rnams drug tu 'dod de/ 'grel chen las/ srog ni drug gi lus la cha shas sdug/ /zhes pa ni/ sa'i lus la cha shas dang / chu'i lus la cha shas dang] me'i lus la cha shas dang / rlung gi lus la cha shas dang / nags kyi bdag po'i lus la cha shas dang /'bras bu'i lus la cha shas so/ /zhes so/ /nags kyi bdag so ldon shing yin la/ rwa 'gyur las/sa'i lus la cung zad ces sogs cha shas cung zad du bsgyur kyang don gcig la/ kha cig 'bras 180
le'u bdun pa gcer bu ba'i rtag mtha' dgag pa/bu'i lus zhes thar pa'i lus la 'chad pa ma dag pas/ nas drenags 'bru rnams sems ldan du sgrub 'dod snang bas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan 'di srog can thams cad 'di drug tu bshad pa min gyi yongs la sems med du grags pa la sems ldan drug byed 'dod pas 〈sna/ /'di'i thad la tha snyad ma gtogs zad byed gnyis mthun par sems serdzo/ /'phags yul gyi zad byed pa rnams ni 〈(ga can gyi sde dgu ba'i tha snyad byed de/ rtog ge 'bar ba las/ de la srog can gyi sde dgu ste/ sa dang chu dang shing dang me dang rlung dang srin bu dang / grog ma dang / bung ba dang / mi zhes bya ba dag go zhes so/ /des na 'dis kyang srog can la 'di dgu khonar 'dod pa min te/ sems med du grags pa 'ga' sems ldan du sgrub ched dang / dbang po gcig ldan sesnags kyi mtshan gzhi tsam bzung ched yin pa'i phyir dang / 'di dgu ma yin pa'i srog can du ma bshad pas so/ /rtog ge 'bar ba las/ de dag las sa dang chu dang/ shing dang me dang rlung rnams ni dbang po gcig ldan te reg pa'i dbang 4 dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /srin bu dang / bung ba dang] dung dang] nya phyis dngaka srin bu padma la sogs pa ni dbang 4 gnyis ldan te/ reg pa dang ro'i dbang po nyid dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /grog ma dang srin bu me la sogs pa ni dbang 4 gsum pa ste/ reg pa dang / ro dang/ sna'i dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /bung ba dang / sbrang bu mchu ring la sogs pa ni/ dbang 4 bzhi pa lte/ reg pa dang ro dang sna dang / mig gi dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /mi dang rkang bzhi pa dang bya la sogs pa ni dbang po lnga pa lte/ reg pa dang ro dang sna dang] mig dang rna ba'i dbang po dang ldan pa'i phyig de ltar na de dag ni srog gi tshig gi don rnam pa dgu'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa lam ni/ dzolalnga brtul zhugs lngadangs shes lnga/ /gyod ba bcugakhulasal'dod ces pa sdom pa lnga ni/ gcer bu sogs spretshed lam gyi dang mi smra ba se gas ngag gam skad kyi dang / slong spyod sogs yongs 'tshal gyi dang/ brtsod snyoms chud zos su mi 'dor ba'i dang]181
grub mtha'i rnam bshatwasbrang yab sogs nye bar rab gnas kyi sdom pa ste lnga'o/ /brtul zhugs lnga ni/ mi 'tshe ba'i dang /bden smra'i dang] byin pa tsam len pa'i dang / tshangs par rgyud pa'i dang] dngos po kun yongs su gtong ba'i brtul zhugs lnga'o/ /blo gros kyi dang/ thos pa'i dang] 'tsham gyi dngaka yid kyis yongs su 'tshol ba'i dang mo'i ye shes te ye shes lnga'o/ /'di sogs so so'i ngos 'dzin ṭīka chen de nyid snang bar stos/ sprudod pa ni bcu gsum lte/ brtul zhugs lnga dang/ sdom pa lnga dang] me lnga bsten pa dang / gaṅgār 'jug pa sogs lus kyi gsang ba dang sngags bzla ba ngag gi gsang ba dang / sems kyis 'di pa rang gi lugs kyi thar lam bsgom pa ste spyod pa bcu gsum dang bcas pa 'di dag ni 'di'i lam gyi skor yin no/ /sogasag sbya rdzu pa kau raṃ bu sdi( shāspyu rnyi/ ༵༵nga pa/sa ༵ chod sdur/ daX /darnyi dī snyi/ pa/ two ṭwāṃ bzhi las/ dang ṭo ni/ zarabagazugag /zhes pa 'di'i thar pa gzugs dang / 'gro ba'i nang tshan lnga pa dang] lus kyi nang nas kyang lnga ba/ gnas khams gsum las 'das pa na dbyibs dang kha dog gdugs lta bu kha dog dkar po ku mud kyi mdog can tshad gzhan nas ma bshad kyang 'grel chen 'dir dpag tshad 'bum phrag zhe lnga yod pa dngad gcig las med kyang / kun grol tshe der dbyer med par 'dod de/ rgyal ba dam pas/ kha ba rgya spos me tog mdog /ba zho ba mo pu tig mdog /gdugs bkan bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar pa yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /ces dang / 'grel chen las/ grub pa'i mtha' gang du thar pa'i tshad ni 'jig rten gsum gyi steng du gdugs kyi rnam pa dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsalnga bar nges par brjod par byed pa de ni rgyal ba pa yi bstan pa'o/ /zhes dang / ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ 'jig rten gsum las brgal ba na 'jig rten 'dus pa zhes bya ba'i gnas zho'am ku mu da ltar dkar ba/ srog 182
le'u bdun pa gcer bu ba'i rtag mtha'adagag pa/yod pas dngos po yin zhing gshor ba las grol bas dngos po med pa gdugs dkar po gyen la bslangs pa lta bu/ tshad 'dir bshad pa de tsam dang ldan pa yod la/ zhes dang / slob dpon legs ldan gyis/ thar pa ni las thams cad zad pas 'jig rten thams cad kyi steng na 'dus pa'i gnas 'jig ltan 'dus pa zhes bya bar 'gro ste/ zhes sogs shes byed mang bas 'gro ba lnga pa dang lus lnga par 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang / rgyal ba dam pas/ la lar slog ni stobs ldan zhing / /la la las ni stobs ldan 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyis 'khor bar 'khor tshe mi shes pa'i dbang gis las stobs che la/ krol tshe yi shes dbang gis srog stobs che ba dang /khams gsum gcig las med la/ de zhig na srid pa gzhan med pas hrengag chags thams cad gang la gnas nges na gargar ba'ang rtag pa dang / srog kyang rtag par smra ba sogs mang po snang ste ma bris them/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'ju lnga lus lngadabang 4gcigaldan thegags/ /zhes pa las ba lnga ste/ 'grel chen las/ lag ba'i dbye ba lnga ste/ dmyal ba dang1 dud 'gro dang / mi dang / lha dang / thar pa'i las ba'o/ /zhes so/ /'dis thar pa dang las ba'i gzhi mthun khas blangs so/ /sog can rnams kyi lus kyi dbye ba lnga ste/ mi sogs khams zas can gyi lus dang/ lha rnams 'od kyi lus dang / srog gi rang bzhin can nags kyi bdag po sogs drug gi lus dang/ yongs su grags pa'i rdzus skyes kyi lus dang] mtha'i thar pa'i lus te lngar bshad pa'i phyir te/ 'grel chen las/ gzhan yang] yod pa'i lus lnga zhes pa ni/ kha zas can gyi lus dang / 'od kyi lus dang / rang bzhin can gyi lus dang / nus skyes kyi lus dang / mtha'i lus rtso/ /zhes pa ni/ srog rnams kyi'o/ /zhes rtso/ /'gro ba de dag la dbang po ldan tshul yang yod de/ sa sogs dbang po gcig ldan nas/ mi sogs lnga ldan du sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /sogs sgras tshig dgu'i khyad par gzhan rnams ston te/rtog 183
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/ge 'bar ba las/ zag pa ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las rnams kyis zag par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sdom pa ni zag pa 'gog pa nyid de/ las gsar ba mi gadre'og pa'i pyir ro/ /nges par rga ba ni sdom pa de nyid dang/ zas mi za ba dngaka skom mi 'thung ba dang / bsam gtan dang / bhyor ba la sogs pa dka' thub dang bcas pas sngon nye bar bsags pa'i las nges par gnas par byed pa lte/ zad pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang/ sdig pa ni chos min pa'o/ /badrend nams ni chos zug/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mdu/ /gsum pa ni/ 'ching ba sum brgya drug calas tshe tshedags/ /zhes pa/ thar pa thob pa la bgegs byed 'ching ba dang / nyes par smra ba sum brgya dang drug cu 'dod de/ dbu ma snying po'i rang 'grel las/ 'ching ba ni nyes par smra ba sum brgya drug cu rtsagasum po dag gis brtags pa'i log par lta ba'o/ /zhes dang] yang lta ba brgya rtsabacur yang bshad de/ de nyid las/ de yang ltaba'i rtsab brgya rtsabacur 'gyur la/ de'i thad kyi dbye ba ni/ sangs rgyas pa dngaka 'odzin pa med pa dang / 'tsho ba pa dang / zhes pa nas/ nam mkha' la sems 'amad par lta ba la dredags pa lta ba sum brgya drug cu rtsagasum 4 thams cad kyang zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /las ni bzhi ste pyis myong 'gyur dang/ ming dang] rus dang] che'i bar bzhi 'dod pa'i phyir te/rtog ge 'bar ba las las ni rnam pa bzhi lte/ phyis myong bar 'gyur ba dang / ming dang / rus pa dang/ tshe zhes bya ba dag go/zhes then/ /tshe thegags zhes pas las lhag ma lus thenags 'aroston pacas/ /bzhi pa ni/ ma brtsams lung labastanadang nyal sogs lhag /kun mkhyen medadangashang chista //byis rmopa/༷pa ༵/ngaXsdu zhi me)sna shā ༵ hāshā spra /pa /(1 /shā sbo snropa (( du bshad do/ /'jig lten na chos kun mkhyen pa med de/ gcig gis kun mkhyen pa mu stegs 184

le'u brgyad pa bye smra'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/par grags pa yang legs par go ste/ bye smra la yang phal chen sde pa'i mdo dag dang theg chen mthun pas zeg chen 'dod pa kha shas yod par mngon te/ rigs pas sgrub pa'i phyir te/ de dus kyi bye smra sgyi dang gnas ma bus kyang theg chen gyi mdo las dngos po med par gsungs pa de grangs can sogs pu stegs lugs kyi rtagadangos dgag pa yin zhes dgongs pa len pa'i phyir dang / de ltar bshad pa zhi 'tsho yab sras kyang bzhed pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel las de lta min pa bye brag tu smra ba dang/ gnas ma bu'i tshul gyi rjes su 'brangs nas/ 'di ni lhur grangs can la sogs pa'i lugs kyi dngos 4 dgag pa yin no zhes lado bshad mi nus pa ci yod/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rje yab sras kyang bzhed de/ rgyud bla ma'i rnam bshad las/ gnas ma bu pa'i sde pa la yang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde la skur ba 'debs pa dang / mi 'debs pa gnyis yod la/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba sogs la yang gnyis yod par shes par bya'o zhes gsungs shing] jo bo'i gtam rgyud kyis kyang shes la/ bye smra'i nang tshan lde pa bco brgyad la zeg chen gdod mi 'dod gnyis yod pa 'di thogs med zhabs kyi'ang dgongs pa yin te/ bye smra'i gnas ma bu pa gang zag gi bdag med phra mo mi 'dod pa la zeg chen bka' min zhes skur ba 'debs pa'am/ snang mi snang gnyis yod cing/ de'i rigs pas sde pa gzhan la'ang sdang mi snang gnyis yod pa'i phyir te/ rgyud bla thogs 'grel las/ der nges par lhung ba chos 'di pa nyid de dag las/ kha cig zeg pa chen po'i chos la sdang ba lte/ zhes sogs kyis dang yang 'grel ba de las/ rnam pa du ma'i mu stegs pa mang po dang / de dang mthun par spyod pa chos 'di pa nyid dad pa yod kyang nyes par bzung ba 'dzin pa ste/ de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ don dam pa la mi mos pa gang zag tu lta ba lte/ zhes drenags gsungs pa'i phyig 'di gnyis ka gnas ma bu ba'i bye brag bye smra kha cig yin te/ chos 'di pa zhes gnyis nar byung pas rang sde yin zhing / gang zag tu smra ba zhes pas bdag smra bar 205

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/na sde pa bco brgyad yod de/ gyes tshul ni/ rtog ge 'bar ba dang / sde pa tha dad klag pa'i dngor lo dang/ slob dpon padma'i dge tshul slong gi lo 3 ba gnyis dang]'od ldan dag las byung la/ de yang rtsaba'i sde pa bzhi las dang / gcig las dang / gnyis las dang / gsum las gyes tshul dag yod pa'i phyir te/ ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu drug na gnas brtan pa so sos skad legs sbyag zur chag dngaka rang bzhinadang]sha za'i skad kyis bton pas rtsaba'i lde bzhir gyes par rgyud sde sbyo rnam las so/ /rtsaba'i lde bzhi'i ngos 'odzin la dul lha sogs sbyo'i lugs dang /padmas gsung lugs gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba 'ga' zhig gis 'dod par grags pa ni/ rtsaba'i sde bzhi thams cad yod par smra ba dang] phal chen pa dang/ gnas brtan pa dang] mang bkur ba bzhi'i dbye ba ni/ rim bzhin bdun dang lnga dang gsum dang gsum yin te dul ba lhas/'od srung sa ston chos srung lde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dngaka /rnam par phye dang gzhi kun pa/ /thams cad yod par spru ba bdun/ /shar dang nub dang gangs rir gnas/ /'dus byas rtag par smra bdang] /'jig rten 'das smra phal chen lnga/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jigs med gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan gsum/ /sa slog ri dang bsrung ba pa/ /gnas ma bu pa'i sde rnams ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /zhes dren/ /'di btus pa'i khungs bzang bas 'di ltar bzungayod /gnyis pa ni/ yod smra bzhi/ phal chen par drug/mang bkur la lnga gnas brtan pa gsum du 'dod de/ dge slong gi lo 3 ba las/ 'od srungs zhes bya sa srung dang] /chos srung zhes ni bya ba dang / /gzhi kun yod par smra ba ni/ /zhes dang / dge 'dun phal chen dbye ba ni/ /drug lte shar gyi ri 'o dang / /de bzhin nub ri zhes bya dang] /gangs gnas zhes bya de las gzhan/ /rnam par phye ste smra bdangan /gzhan nide bzhin btags par mpa /'jig rten 'das smra zhes bya ba/ /zhes dngan mang pos bkur ba'i bye brag ni/ /rnam pa lngar ni mkhas pas bsgrags/ /gosnas 208

grub mtha'i rnam bshabrapa kho na'o/ /so sor snang du mi rung ba gang yin pa de dag 'dus kyang snang du mi rung ba'i nges pa medade/ skra la sogs pa bkram pa rnams thag ring po nas mi mthong bdang] spom pa dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / kun btus las/ mig las skye blo rnams med cing] /mngon sum rig pa rdul gyi tshogs/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bad mig la sogs pa dbang po dag las skyes pa'i blo ste rnam par shes pa dag la rig mi rig 'dra ba dang / rdul phra rab kyi rnam pa med cing/ blo dang dbang po de dag gis mngon sum du rig pa la gzugs la sogs pa ni rdul te/ rdul phra rab bskor ba'i tshogs su 'dod de/ zhes bshad pas so/ /yang shes bya la gzhi lja dang] de'ang don byed pa'i dngos po dang rdzas su 'dod la/ rdzas btags gnyis kyang 'dod pas/ snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi/ gtso 4 sems kyi gzhi/ dgor sems byung gi gzhi/ gnas skabs ldan min 'du byed kyi gzhi/ 'dus ma byas kyi gzhi lnga'i 'dod tshul ni phal cher bshad zin la/ rdzas grub ni chos de las gzhan rang dbang ba re med na 'angog mi shes pas thams cad rdzas su grub par 'dod cing] rdzas yod dang btags yod kyi khyad par yangaka gtso cher don dam du grub pa rdzas yod dang] kun rdzob tu grub pa btags yod kyidonasan pas khyad par che/ sems byungang gcig ste/nges pa'i sems byung sde lnga dang/ ma nges pa'i brgyadade sems kyi sa mang bcu/ dge ba'i sa mang bcu/ mi dge ba'i sa mang gnyis/nyon mongs chen po'i sa mang bcu/nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu gcig yod pas so/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / /'du shes med snyoms 'jug dag dang] /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la dregags pa yang/ /zhes ldan min 'du byed bdun las/thob pa rnyed dang ldan pa'o/ /thob dang ma thob rang rgyud du/ /gtogs pa rnams kyi'o/ /zhes thob pa ni/dper na nor la khal 'ching byed kyi thag pa lta bu'i rdzas gcig lte/ las dge sesnags skyes bu la ldan byed gcig la 'dod de/ thob pa'i yang thob pa sogs 'dra/ ma thob pa'ang de dang 'dra/ 'du 228
le'u brgyad pa bye smra'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / 'gog snyoms gnyis sems med 'du byed yin la/ bye smra la la sems phra mo yod par 'dod/ srog ni tshesan drod dang ni/ /rnam shes rten gang yin pa'o/ /zhes dang / srog ni rnam smin/ zhes srog tshe yin la rnam smin du'ang 'dod/ mtshan nyid dag ni skye ba dang / /rga dang gnas dang mi rtag nyid/ /de dag skye ba'i skye la sogs/ /de chos brgyad dang gcig la 'jug/ces skye rga gnas 'jig bzhi dang/ ming gi tshogs la sogs pa yang/ /zhes minganingo bo tsam ston pa ste/ lhadag lha rnams zhes pa/ sgra ba rnams tshig zer yang 'dir ming ngo] /tshig gam ngag ni khyad par ston pa'i sgra ste/ 'dus byas mi rtag ces pa lta bu/ yi ge ni de gnyis kyi gdags gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs ka dam pa zhes pa lta bu'i ka ste/ sbyor 〈sna zhes pa lta bu yi ge dang ba lang gi ming la'ang 'jug pas/ mingadangayi ge mi lagal bar bzhed cing/ sgra padang brtsad tshul mngayod /bye smra phal cher 'dus ma byas gsum 'dod kyang/ yuladabus kyi bye pade bzhin nyid dang bzhir lasad cing/ de bzhin nyid kyang rdzas grub tu medodade/ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba ltar 'dus ma byas med dgag la lasdog mi shes pas 〈sna/ /ye shes kun btus 'grel ba las/ yul dbus kyi bye brag smra ba dag ni 'dus ma byas bzhir 'dod pas na/ zhes pa nas/ 'di ltar 'dus ma byas bzhi po de dag ni kho 'o cag gi phyogs la'ang rdzas su yod par 'dod pa'i 9ga bzhi gang zhe na/nam mkha' dang so sor brtags pa min pa'i 'dog pa dang/ so sor brtags pa'i 'gog padang]de bzhin nyid do zhes rtsod pa smra ste/ zhes dang] dul lha dang / legs ldan gyis kyang ngo] /drug pa ni/ gzugs phungadesan sangs rgyas mi rdzogatshog /zhes pa/ rang 'grel las/gzugs kyi sku ni snga ma dang phyi mar yang bye brag med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyor dgra bcom gsum ga lhag bcas pa yin zhing / nyan rang la las nyon gyi 'bras bu lhag ma 'dzid pa shes sla zhing / sangs rgyas kyang sngar gyi rtso skye'i lus kyi rgyun nyer len gyi phung po ldan par 229
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/'dod de/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa'i ṭīka chen las/ nyan thos sde pa dag gi lugs la longs rgyud rdzogs pa'i sku zhes bya ba gtan mi 'dod cing] mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bdud rol ba'i mdzad pa'i gnas skabs man chad so skye mtshan nyid pa yin pas/ mchog gi sprul sku'i lus ni so skye'i lus kyi rigs tso'i rgyun du 'dod la/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku beem po kho nar smra ba yin zhingan sangs rgyasades myangan las gas pa'i mdzad pa ma bstan bar la lhag ma dang bcas pa'i myang zos dang mya ro las zos pa na mar me shi ba ltar beem rig rgyun chad pa'i lhag med kyi myang 'das mngon du mdzad par khas len te/ zhes so/ /skyabs 'gro'i ngo bo ngag gi rig byed du legad la/ mi slob chos kho na la sangs rgyas su lasdog na/ de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyis khrag phyung pa'i mtshams med ji ltar snyam na/ de ni rten la gnod pa byas pa sangs rgyas la'ang gnod par bzhag zer ro/ /rngas〈cocas tshosalha// sprasalha tsho /lha/25 tshob/:rdob/'gyu zhwa/rna yabasha/'gyu pasanam mkha'adangani 'gog pa gnyis/ /'dus ma byas gsum rtag pa ste//'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ /bdag gi stong gzhi byed po med/ /dbang skyes blo ni rnam med kyi/ /phra rab bsags pa dngos su rig/kha che'i gzhung gi chu gter gyi/ /bye brag graba'i gzhung 'dod 'gyug/zhesagasungs la 'gyur khyad mgatogs tshig 'dagawe shes kun btusadang/ bde gshegs gzhungagi rab byed dang/'grel chen dri med 'od du byung la/landamadapal zhal lung las kyang/nam mkha'adangani 'gog pa gnyis/ /shin tu 'dus ma byas pa lte /shin tu brtan bya 'dus byas kun/ /skad cig ma lte bdag po med//ces sogs byung la/stag tshang bas/dus lubor rtsargyud kyiyin zerayang]dbyadanadaka'/ṇḍa'i 'dus byas skad cig ma sogs kyidonani/ ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ 'dus byas thams cad skad cig ma/ mi rtag padang/ gang zagagi bdag gis stong zhing] snod bcud ladabang phyug la 230
le'u brgyad pa bye smra'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/sogs pa'idon gzhan med padang/ zhesadang/ byang chub bzang posadedag sngar bstan pa'i bdag gis kun tu stong pa de'i phyir byed pa po las ma gtogs pa medade/ zhesadang/ rtag pa las dpen pas skad cig ma'o/ /zhesadang1 dzi tā ris/ rgyu dang rkyen tshogs shing 'dus nas/ byas pa'idangos po'i rnam pa mtha'adag ni skad cig ma yin te/ skyes pa'i skad cig ma tsam khonacand pa'i phyir zhes so/ /kha che'i sogs kyidon la/rdze tā ris rtsabag sa che bye brag smra ba'i gzhung//de ltar slodang ldan rnams bzhed/ /ces pa'i rang 'grel las/ kha che ba rnams kyi gzhung lte mngon pa de lngade lta bu'ingo bor slodang ldan pa mkhas pa rnams bzhedade/ zhesadang/ ye shes kun btus chos shes 'gyur las/blo ldan zhes bya mkhas pasas/ /bye brag smra ba'i gzhung du bshad/ /cesadangan 'grel bag 'di ltabu'i pyi rol pa la stosate blodang ldan pa zhes bya bar 'grub 'o//zhesadang/ṭīka chen las chu gter zhes pa med de/ 'grel bag mu stegs pa la nyos nas blo dang ldan pa'i bshad pa byas sdug/ /zhes so/ /chu gtera'adzid pa'i bshad pa sngar ltar ro/ /lde pa so so'i thun mong min pa'i 'dod tshul rtsaba'i sde pagasum du byas pa'i lugs kyi so so'i 'dod pani/rtogage 'bar ba las/de la tha snyad pa rnams kyi dam tshig gi rtsab ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig lten las 'das pa lte/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten gyi chos ni mi mnga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes su gsung mi 'jug go/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyigasungani snying 'o la mngon par mos pa'o//de bzhin gshegs spru la gnasader gzugs nyer bar len pa mi mnga' 'o/ /byang chub semasadapa'i dusan nur nur 4 dang/ mer mer po dang ltar ltar bos 'jug pa minate/ glang po cher gyuranas yum gyidakunas rang nyidanges par 'grang bayin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ladod pa'i 'du shes mi 'byungaka ra 'go rnams su bdag nyid kyi ladod pas skye ba blangasate/sems can7nangs su smin par byedado//ye shesagacigagis bden pa bzhi rnamasazungangs 231
grub mtha'i rnam bshatwasu shes so/ /rnam par shes pa drug 4 rnamasani 'dod chagasadang bcas padang/ 'dod chagasadang bral ba yang yinano/ /mig gis gzugs rnams mthongayod /dgra bcom pa rnams kyang gzhanadag ༷sna ༵༵ pa (snropa ༵ ārsha/ /mi hārsha pa~Xbyi( sprasbra) (sna kṣiṃ lha pa/sna pa~X /sna do/ /mi gtsang pa spangs palangazungadado/ /yangadag par sdom pa mngon sum du byas pa nyid skya kun tu kyor ba thams cad rab tu spangs par brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la 'jig rten pa'i yangadag pa'i ltabani mi mnga' 'o//semasani rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bayin pas bag la nyal ba rnams semasadang mtshungs par ldan zhe 'am mi ldan zhes brjod par mi bya'o/ /bag la nyal yang gzhan la kunanas snang b.lang gzhanasanano/ /'das padang ma 'ongs pa ni medado/ /rgyun du zhugs pani bsamagatan thob pa'anano//zhesadang/de la mang du thos pa rnams kyi rtsaba'idam tshig khro smo/ do/ na ḍā sgyi dhri /// /zo waṭwāṃ st+ri ṣṭṛ/ khro ༷ ñdzashāshā ༵ ṭwāṃ pa/sdu shā mbhi dī dī shā/ kham̐/ /sna( sdu ba kṣiṃ dīsna pasna ( kṣiṃ lli dā/ kyi/ji kau sdursha glu/༷| rdo kṣiṃ nāṃ waṃ stso ༷༷/ 99 ༷༷ hūm̐ sgyu ༷༷ shlau / ṭwāṃ// / pyā hūm̐ ༷ do/ /skyes bu byed palang medado/ /sdug bsngal thams cadani las las byung bayinano/ /zhes bya ba 232
le'u brgyad pa bye smra'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/de ltabu'i brtags par smra ba rnams kyi rtsaba'idam tshig yinano/ /zhesadang] sngar gyi gnas brtan pa'i rtsaba'idam tshiganidagra bcom pa rnams la gzhan gyis ston cing sgrub pa ni medado/ /de bzhin du gzhi lnga ponang medado/ /gang zag ni yodade srid pa bar ma nisku'odado/ /dgra bcom paskumangs su myangan las 'das pa ni yodado/ /ladas padang ma 'ongs palangasku'od do/ /myangan las 'das pa'i donani'amadado/ /zhes bya bani gnas bag pa'i rtsaba'idam tshig go/de la gangs ri ba'i rtsaba'idam tshigani/ byang chub semasadapa' rnams ni so so'i skye ṭo min zhes bya'o/ /pyi rol pa la yang mngon par shes pa lnga ni yod do/ /phung 4 las gang zagani gzhan min par brjod par bya lte mya ngan las 'das par gyur pan gang du phung 4 'gag pan gang zagani gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /mnyam par bzhag spya twi sgru āoṃ shlau ༷ /smo/ )lha ༷stso ༷ ༷ ༵ / |྅ nywa/ ༷༷༷ hūm̐ /dhī/ skad pu bdag med pa' lus 'de byung ba na//byed pa med cing rig pa posang med/ /ji ltar lhagar ba'i chu klung 'jug gyur pa/ /nyan pa'i mchog khyod de ni bstan gyis nyon/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /dedagani thams cad yod par smra ba'idam tshig go/yangadedag gi rtsaba'idam tshigani/ ming dang gzugs kyis bsdus so/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pani yodado/ /rgyun du zhugs pani mi nyams pa'i chos canayin par brjod par bya'o//'dus byas rnams kyi 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyidani gsum yinano//'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i rim gyis rtogs par 'gyuraro//stong pa nyidadang smon pa med padang] mtshan ma med pa dag gis skyon med pa la 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /skad cig ma bco lngas ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa yin no/ /rgyun tu zhugs pani bsam gtan thob pa yin no/ /dgra bcom palang nyams pa sridado/ /so so skye 'o layang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags sam/gnod 233
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/sems spong bsku'odado/ /pyi rol pa layong mngon par shes pa lngagegad do/ /ltarnams la yang tshangs par spyod pa la gnas patsamadado//mdo lde thams cadani drang ba'idonasanano//skyon med pa la 'jug pa'i 'dod pa'i khams nas so/ /'jig rten pa'ikhangadag pa'i ltaba'iskungadado/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga'i 'dod chags dang bcas pa min/ 'dod chags dang bral ba yang min no/ /zhes bya ba 'dedagani thams cadayengad par smra ba'idam tshig go/zhesadang/de la mang ston pa rnams kyi rtsaba'i /rdzu hūm̐ paXng/༵ bhee shā dīpa snangaspya (spyashā pa(/ ryaṃ/ spri dzo nga dzño bee ༵ hāX tsho sbyo/ two/ ma/sna du rgyu yang gzhan yin no/ /srid pa bar ma ni med do/ /lha'i gnas na yang tshangs par spyod payang yod do/ /dgra bcom pa yang bsod nams bsog go/rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga la yang 'dod chags dang bcas pa dang] 'dod chags dang bral bzungadado/ /gang zag ni mgo la sogs pa lus dang mnyam po yinano/ /rgyun tu zhugs pani bsam gtan thob pa'o/ /so so skye bos kyang 'dod pa'i 'dod chags sam/ gnod sems spong ngo / /sangs rgyas ni dge 'dun gyi khongs su gtogs pa'o//dge 'dunani 'bras bu chen po 'byung bar byed kyi sangs rgyasanide ltar minano//sangs rgyas dang nyan zos kyi rnam par grol ba ni gcig go/gang zag ni mi mthong do /semasadang sems las byung ba 'ba' zhig ni skye ba'i chos cung zad tsam yang 'jig rten ṇḍa nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'pho ba ni med pa nyidado/ /'dus byas thams cadani skad cig ma'o/ /'du byed rgyas par gyur pa las ni skye bsanano/ /'du byed rnams gnas pa'i medado//sems ji ltabade ltar lasasan gyi/ lusadang ngag gi las ni med do/ /nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i chos medado/ /mchod rten mchod pa lani 'bras bu medado/ /da ltar byung ba rtag nyub ni bag la nyalayinano/ /'dus byas mthong bas skyon med par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba 'didag ni mang ston pa rnams kyi rtsaba'idam tshigasan no/ /yang 234
le'u brgyad pa bye smra'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/chos smras pa rnams kyi rtsaba'idam tshigani/ sangs rgyasanidage 'dun gyi khongs su gtogs pa min no/ /sangs rgyas las 'bras bu chen 4 'byung bde ltaradage 'dun lasani minano/ /lha'i gnasan yang tshangs par spyod paniyodado/ /'jig rten pa'i chosanicanadado/ /zhes bya bdedagani chos sbas pa rnams kyi dam tshig yin no/ /de la 'od srungs rnams kyi dam tshig ni rnam par smin pa'i chos rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i chos ni yod do/ /spangs pa las yongs su ma shes pa yang yod do/ /zhes bya bdang/ chos sbas pa'i thams cad kyang medodade/dedagani 'od srung ba'idam tshigasan no/ /gos dmar ba rnams kyidam tshigani/ gang zagani medarda 'as bya ba'o zhesadang/ slobadayon glama'i gzhung ston par byed pa'i 'pho ba pa rnams kyi rtsaba'idam tshigani/ phung po lngani 'jig rten 'de nas 'jig lten pha rol tu 'pho ba'o/ /lam ma gtogs par phung po 'gag pa medado/ /rtsaba'i lhung ba dang bcas pa'i phung po'i yodado/ /gang zag nidonadam par midamigs so/ /kun kyang mi rtag go zhes bya ba de dag ni 'pho ba'i dam tshig yin te zhes dang] yang gnas ma bu'idam tshig ni nye bar blangs padang]nye bar len padang ldan pani btags pa'o/ /chos gangasang la)ga rten 'denas 'dzig rten pha rol tu 'pho ba med do/ /gang zag ni phung so lnga nye bar blangs nas 'pho bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas ni skad cig mdang skad cig ma min pa yangatsamadado/ /gang zagani nye bar blangs pa'i phung po 'anyad dang gcig pa'am gcig pa min par brjod par mi bya'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni chos thams cad dang gcig pa nyid dam tha dad pa nyid du mi brjodado/ /myangan las 'das pa ni yod pa nyid dam med pa nyid du mi brjod do/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs lnga ni 'dod chags dang bcas pa yang ma yin/'dod chags dang bral ba yang ma yin no/ /zhes bya ba ni gnas ma bu rnams kyi dam tshig go/zhes dang| de la mang pos bkur ba rnams kyi dam tshig ni/ 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / 'byung ba dang]lagag par 'gyur bdang] lanag padang/ skye bar 'argyur bdang/ skye bdang/ 'bru bar 'argyur bdang/235

le'u dgu pa mdo gne pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/bkra/ /blo ldan skabs gsum rol gnas lha'i pho brang / /legs bshad rkang 'thung 'phreng bas kun nas mdzes//zhes grub pa'i mtha' rnam par bzhag pa 'khrul spong gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs kun mkhyen lam gsal slon me'i rnam bshad las rtag mtha' bkag pa'i bye brag smra ba'i skabs kyi 'grel pa legs par bshad zin to////gtan tt+waṃ //ba kṣiṃ gā lha ghnā hā ṇā lci ñdza ji rnyi rdokā/ spya/thapa shārnyi rdzu padī zalha dzo sna dī rsha kṣiṃ marasgabs64 3 ga/zhes pa ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/mdo sde'i rjes su 'brangs nas grub pa'i mtha' rnam par 'jug pas mdo sde pa'i rigs so//zhes dang / bde gshegs gzhung gi rang 'grel las/de ltar mdo sde sgo nas lhod pa'i mdo sde pa rnams kyis zhes dang/ye shes kun btus 'grel bda'adi ni sgo drug pa dang 'phags pa bzang po rgyud pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde rnams sgra ji lta bar khas len cing mdo de dang de dag gi rjes su 'jug pa dang ldan pas na mdo sde pa dang/ming gzhan dpes ston pa la mkhas pasadape ston pa'o zhes gsungs pa ltasamado sde padangadape ston pa sprapagarmo / ༵ skyi sa dzño /dri ༵ paX shā rnyi phrupa rdzu spya ༷rsha (spridī ༷ /ji spras/sbyi gang zag gi gnyis pa ni/dbyengo lungarigs rjes 'grang rnalaba'igasug/zhes pa de la dbye na lung rigs kyi rjes 'brangs gnyis mkhas pa dag la grags pa ltar 'dod dgos te/ mdzod 'grel las/mdo sde pa na re dang /dpe ston pa na re zhes gsungs pa'i kho 'o cag mdo tshad mar byed kyi bstan bcos tshad mar mi byed ces pa'i lung gi rjes 'brangs kyi de dang mdo dang sde bdun gnyis 237
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i rig pa'i rjes 'brangs gcig kyang yod pa ni/ sde bdun mdo sems shun mong gi gzhung du grags pas sgrub pa'i phyig rnam pa'i sgos gsum dang dbye ba la/ chos rje rgyan bzang ba na re/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam dang / sgo nga phyed tshal dang / sna tshogs gnyis med gsumadabu ma rgyan las gsungs zhes pa la gzhan gnyis bshad kyang/ sgo nga phyed tshal ni dbu ma rgyan 'der nyan thos sde pa'i skabs su mi 'byung bas/ nang du snang ba'ang gzhan nyid la/ /phyi ru snang ba'ang de gzhan nyid/ /gsal bar bya dang gsal byed nyid/ /mar me bzhin du de nyid min/ /zhes pas mdo sems thun mong du bstan zer na ma gtogs mi 'thad par snang la/ de dag gi ming don rgyan bzang bas/ ldon 4 dang grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i sngon po'i steng gi byas mi rtag sogs ji snyed 〈snad pade snyed kyis rang 'dzin yul canade la rnam pa gtad la/ yul canade la'ang sdo sogs de snyed kyi rnam ldan du skye ba dper na khra 'dzin mig shes la khra bo'i sngo sogs ji snyed kyi rnam pa gtad pa de ltar mig shes de yang gro ser sogs ji snyed kyi rnam ldan du skye ba bzhin te/ des na gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam zhes bya'o/ /yang sngon 4 dang grub bde rdzas gcig pa'i sngon po'i steng gi byas sogs ji snyed pa de snyed kyi rnam pa mi gtod par gro tsam zhig gi rnam pa gtod la yul canade'ang sngon po'i byas sogs ji snyed kyi rnam pa ma shar bar ldo tsam zhig gi rnam pa shar ba yin te/ dperan khra'adzin mig shes la rgabo'i sngo ser sogs ji snyed kyi rnam pa mi gtod par rgatsam zhig gi rnam pa gtod la/ yul can de'ang khra bo'i sngo ser sogs ji snyed kyi rnam pa ma shar bar rgatsam zhig gi rnam ldan du skyes pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir na sgo nga phyed tshal zhes bya'o/ /yang sngon po'i grub bde rdzas gcig gi byas sogs ji snyed pa de snyed kyis rang 'dzin yul can de la rnam ba gtad kyang] yul canade sngon po'i byas sogs ji snyed kyi rnam ldan du mi skye bar ldo tsam zhig gi rnam ldan du skye ste/ dperan rga'adzinadabang shes la yul khrabo'i gro ser sogs ji snyed rmya rnam 238
le'u dgu pa mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/pa gtad kyang/ mig shes de la khrabo'i sngo ser sogs ji snyed kyi rnam ldan du mi skye bar gtsam gyi rnam ldan du skye ba bzhin yin pa'i pyir sna tshogs gnyis med pa zhes bya'o gsungs/ yang na sngon 4 dang grub bde rdzas gcig gi rdul phran ji snyed dam/ mtha' dbus kyi rnam pa gtad kyang/ zhes sogs gsum gar sbyar na dbu ma rgyan dang mthun no/ /rang lugs la rnam pa'i sgo nas gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa dang / sna tshogs gnyis med pa dang / sna tshogs rim 'dzin pa gsum du 'dod de/ dang 4 ni/ dbu ma rgyan las/ ri mo gding pa mthong ba'i tshe/ /de la de bzhin sems mang po/ /ci ste gcig cha'i tshul gyis su/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar 'dod na go/zhes dang / de'i snga 'grel las/ gang dag rigs mthun pa'i shes pa rnams kyang rnam pa'i grangs bzhin du ri mo la 〈snags pa la lhan cig tu du ma byung ste gzugs dang sgra la 36gas pa'i shes pa rigs mi mthun pa bzhin no sogs dang/ de'i 'grel bshad las/ gangadag ces bya ni sgyi rol gyidon yod par smra ba kha cig kho na ste/ sogs kyis bstan te/ sgyi don dang rnam pa 'dod pa'i nyan thos sde pa gcig yin pa'i phyig mdo sde pa las 'os med la/ gzhan sde'i lugs ni 'di'i rjes su rim pas bkod nas bkag cing/ de'i 'og tu sems tsam pa'i lugs gnyis bkag cing/ sems tsam pa'i sna tshogs gnyis med pa 'og der bkag pas so/ /gal te je tā ris grub mtha'i rang 'grel las/ lung 'di dag sems tsam la yang sbyar bas 'di ltar mi rigs snyam na/ skyon med de/ mdo sde pa'i lugs bzhin 'dod pa'i sems tsam pa yod pa la sbyar ba yin pa'i pyig dperan 'jug pa'i rang 'grel lhapa pa/dri kha zloshā ༵ snaX spra rmirdo sbri two lha/ dī lha kṣiṃ (1 /pa ༵ (rsha tu /pa kli sdidī/ pas kyang shes pa'i phyir ro/ /'di'i kha cig sems tsam pa yin la de la'ang lugs gsum byung ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de'i rang 'grel las/ gal te rnam par shes pa ni gcig lpu kho na'i 239
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/rang bzhin yin la/ rnam pa ni du ma yin na de'i tshe zhes phyogs sngar blangs pas 〈sna/ /gsum pa sna tshogs rim 'dzin pa ni/ dbu ma rgyan las/ dkar podag la 〈snags pa la/ /shes pa de ni rim byung lte/ /martsu1gas par 'byung bas blun po dag /cig ga'o snyam du sems pa yin/ /zhes bshad cing] rnam 'grel sogs las kyang phyogs sngar blangs nas bkag pa de'i phyig 'di ni sngar gyi grub mtha' mkhan 4 sus kyang ma thon pa kho bo'i blo zos kyi 'od zer gyis rnam par pye ba la dpyod ldan rnams dgyes par gyis shig /gsum spru la/ sbyor bstan pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gzhi'i lam gyi 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag gsum/ dang 4 la/ bden pa gnyis kyi dang phung khams skye mched kyi rnam bzhag bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdenaganyis bden bamadon byed nasal nag /zhes pa slob dpon lha dbang blos kyang / chu dang 'o ma la sogs pa bzhin du kun rdzob tu yod pa yin nam/ gzugs dang bde ba la sogs pa bzhin du don dam par yod pa yin zhes/ rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs skabs su'ang bye mdo thun mong ngam lung gi rjes 'brangs kyi 'dod tshul mdzod ltar yin pas bshad zin la mdo sde pa rang gi thun mong min pa'am/ rigs pa'i rjes 'brangs rang lugs kyi bden gnyis 'dod tshul ni/ don dam par don byed nus pa/ don dam bden pa dang /don dam du grub pa dang / rang mtshan du lasag /de ltar mi nus pa'i chos kun rdzob bden pa dngankun rdzob tu grub pa dang] sbyo mtshan du lasdog lte/ dpal ldan tshos kyi grags pas/ don dam don byed nus pa gang / /de 'dir don dam yod pa yin/ /gzhan ni kun rdzob yod pa lte/ /de dag rang sbyi'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /ces rang mtshan sgyi mtshan dang bcas pa gsal bar bshad la/ dngos po la rang mtshan gyis khyab lte/ rnam 'grel las/ don byed nus pa gang yin pa/ /de ni rang gi mtshan nyid 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyis 'des ni stag tshang bas/ dngos po la rang mtshan gyis ma 240
le'udagu pa mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/khyab zer ba'i ljags zung ngur byas snang ste/ gangayin spru zhesadangos 4yin tshad bshad pa'i pyidmngon sum gyi snang yul dngos 4 rnams chos can/ donadam bden pa zhes brjodade/ blodonadam pa snang yul la ma 'khul ba'i mngon sum gyi ngo bor bden pas de skad brjod pas so/ /'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' sogs chos can/ kun rdzob bden pa zhes bya lte/ blo kun rdzob pa rtog pa'i ngo bor bden pas de skad brjod pas so/ /'de dag sgra bshad pa la 'jug tu yod par ma nges pas/de la khyab pa'ang mi rtsib ni rigs smra sbyo'i lugs so/ /rtog pa la ci'i phyir kun rdzob ces bya snyam na/ zhabrul zhing rang mtshan mngon sum du sgrib pa'idon gyis de ltar brjod de/ gang gis rang gi ngo 4 yis/ /gzhan gyi ngo 4 sgrib byed pa/ /kun rdzob de dag tha dad kyang / /zhes bshad pa ltar yin pa'i pyig 'on kyangade kun rdzob tsamadang/ kun rdzob bden pa gangalang min te/ don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyis de la stag tshang ban re/ mdo lde pa'i lugs sngar gyi bod mkhasadagadang] da lngarje yab sras sogs kyis bshad pa rnams 4 'thad par thal/ de ltar mdo sde pa'i lugs bye smra dang mi 'dra ba mi 'thad pa'i phyir te/ mdzod las bden gnyis skabs sems tsam pa'i 'dod pa zur du bshad kyang] bye mdo'i lugs so sor ma bshad pa'i pyir zer na/ 'o na mdo sde pas rang rig mi lasad par thal/ mdzod las shes pa 'chad pa'i skabs de snyed cig tu gzhan rig tsam las rang rig ma bshad pas so/ /dngor gsum la lan med do/ /'dus byas thams cad bden par grub pa ni/ ngo bo nyid med par smra bdang] mdo sde pa brtsad tshul gyis shes te/ ngo bo nyid med pas/ don dam paradon byed nus pa med byas pa la/ mdo sde pan re/ mi 'thadade/ sa 'on myu gu sogs la mi zhakhrul ba'i nus pa mthong ba'i pyid yangango bo nyid med pasade kun rdzob tuyin byas pa la/ mdo sde pas/ sa bon sogs las myug sogs kun rdzob tu ma 'chol bar ci stede ltar 'byung ste mi 'byung bar thal/ sa bon sogs las myu gu sogs 'byung bar rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa'i sgyid de skad 241
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/du/ gal te thams cad nus med na/ /sa bon sogs ni myug sogs la/ /nus mthong gal te de kun rdzob/ /zhe na ci lte de ltar 'gyud /zhes so/ /gal te rang sbyo kun la don dam par don pyed nus pa yod ce na/ sgyi mtshan chos can/ de ltar min te/ rjes su 'ju ldog gi sgo nas rang 'odzin gyi blo la phan 'dogs pa ma mthong ba'i phyir te/ mi mthunadape ni/ mig dang gzugs sogs kyis mig blo skyed pa ltar ro/ /des na rigs pa 'desani rdza'i bum pa dang] las ladogs pa dang] spyi mtshan dang/ yon tan grangs sogs bedzin pa'i blo la ni gzung don med par bshad pa yin te/ de lta bu'i blo lda brda dang / rtsol ba sogs nang gi yan lag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyig de skad du/rnam 'grel las/ gal te kun la de yod na/ /sgyi yi mtshan nyid rjes 'gro ldog /blo la ma mthong phyir min te/ /mig dang gzugs sogs blo bzhin no/ /'dis ni brda dang rtsol ba sogs/ /nang gi yan lag rjes 'jug phyir/ /bum pa 'degs dang sbyo dang ni/ /grangs sogs blo ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de la stag tshang ba sogs na re/ mdo sde pa de bye brag smra ba lasadaman par thal/pye smras bum pa kun rdzob tu grub par 'dod la/ mdo sde pas de don dam par grub par 'dod pa'i phyir zed 'o na pye mdo gnyis sems tsam pa gsum ga grangs can las dman par thal/ grangs can gyis blo dang gzugs sgra sogs la don dam par grub pa gcig kyang gtan mi 'dod la/ 'de dag gis gdod pa de'i phyig lugar gsum la lan med do/ /kho na re/ skyon med de/ grangs can sgya kun rdzob tu grub pa la 'di dag gi bden grub kyidon tshang bdang/ de dag gis mi rtag pa la skye ba snga phyi'i 'brel dang] las 'bras kyi rten sogs 'jog mi shes la/ 'di dag gis shes pas so snyam na/ 'o na bye smra dang mdo sde pa la'ang mtho dman 'chol ba'i skyon med par thal/ bye smra'i kun rdzob tu grub pa la mdo sde pa'i rang mtshan gyi don tshang yod la bye smras rdzas grub min pa'i shes bya tsamakhang 'jog mi shes pa la/ mdo sde pas lasdog shes pa sogs du ma yod pas so smras na dpal 242
