grub mtha'i rnam bshad'thad par thal/ rgyu 'bras bskyed pa tsam de kho na mthar yang yin pa'i phyig de'i phyir yang skad cig dang por skyes/ skad cig gnyis par gnas zer na'ang] nam yang 'jig par mi 'gyur bar thal/skad cig dang por skyes gnyis par gnas pa'i pyid khyab ste/ skad cigadang po bzhin du skad cig gnyis pa la'ang skye bdang gnas pa gnyisadagos kyang/de'i gnyis pa la'ang skye bdang gnas pa gnyis dgos pa'i pyid gal te rgyus dngos po de brtan par bskyed kyang 'jig pa'i rgyus zhig zer na'angapa'o na dang por mi 'jig par skyes par thal la/ de lta na gang gis kyang 'jig mi thub par thal/ dang po nas mi 'jig par gnas pa'i phyir/ spyor ba ni/ gang zhig gang gi tshe 'jig pa'i ngang can yin pa de ni/ de'i tshe de ma thag tu mi gnas pa yin te/ dper na mtha'i skad cig la gnas pa'i dngos po bzhin no/ /gzugs la sogs pa yang skye ba'i dus na 'jig pa'i ngang can yin no zhes pa rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag go/de la kho na re/ rang sde pye smra kha cig dang /gzhan sde dag na re/ dngos po rnams skad cig ma yin na/ de dang de sngar mthong ba 'de'o zhes so ji ltar shes snyam na/ de ltar ngo shes kyang skad cig mi rung ba'i skyon med par thal/ deni 'dra ba'i rgyun 'jug cing mi 'dra ba med la dngos med kyi bar ma chod pa'i phyiradang ma rig pas de gnyis tha dad pa shes pa'i go skabs bcom pa'i sgyig bregs pa'i skra sen la'ang de 'di'o snyam pa'i blo skye yang snga phyi gcig ma yin pa bzhin no/ /gnyis ba ni/ rje bdun bka' min byas/ /mngon ba mdo 'duladang gnas rang rdu 'chad /lungani tshegagakhugasazhes pa mdo sde pa kha cig na re/ mngon pa lde bdun ni bka' min te/ shā ri'i bu sogs dgra bcom bdun gyis byas pa'i pyir te/ dper na chos skyob kyis byas pa'i ched brjod kyi tshom bzhin/ de skad du/ 'grel ba rgyal sras ma'i don mchims lha rje go chas sdoms su byas pa las/ chos kyi phung po shā ri'i bus/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos mo'u 'gal 250
le'u dgu pa mdosde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/bus/ /rab tu byed padabyig bshes kyis/ /rnam shes tshogs ni siskyid kyis/ /khams kyi tshogs ni gang pos byas/ /'gro ba'i rnam grangs gsus 4 ches/ /zhes 〈sna/ /mdo sde pa phal cher gyis bka' ma yin par ma zad dgra bcom pas byas pa'ang ma yin te/ nam mkha' rtag rdzas sogs smras shing / 'phags pa dag ni de ltar mi bzhed pa'i phyir te/ de dag chos la tshad ma'i skyes bu dbang du gyur pa yin pa'i phyig so so'i skye bo de 'dra ba'i ming can dag gis byas so/ /ji skad ma thub bstan pyi dor las/ nyan zos kyi zeg pa ba 'phags pa slob pa dngad mi slob pa bye smra'i 'dod pas btags pa'i/ zhes pa nas/ de'i phyir mdo sde pas kyang mngon pa sde bdun la sogs pa rtsom pa so rnams 'phags pa min par smra ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs 〈sna/ /'o na sde bdun mngon pa min na/ mngon pa mi dmigs pas bcom ldan 'das kyis sde snod gsum pa zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par 'gyug zhe na mngon pa ni zur du med pa bden yang / sde snod gsum mi rung ba'i skyon med de/ mdo sde dang 'dul ba'i nang na chos rnams kyi rang sbyi'i mtshan nyid thor bu thor bu 'chad pa dag yin zer ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos phung brgyad khri gsungs pa dag kyang tshig gi rang bzhin tshogs pa yin pas gzugs can yin yang / gzugs sgra dri ro reg lngar tshe ba'i gzugs ni ma yin la/ chos phung de dag dang nyan sa ltar gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis gdod pa dag kyang sde snod gsum dang drang nges kyi mdo gnyis su 'du bar ladod cing lung rigs kyi rjes 'brangs phal cher gyis kyang zeg chen gyi sde snod drang don gyi bkar 'dod de/ rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gis sher mdo'i dgongs pa 'chad tshul 'og tu 'chad la/ btsun pa dge bsrung la sogs pa'i mdo sde pa na re/sher mdo sogs las tshos thams cad med med ces pa'i mdo tshig gi dgongs pa yod de/ 'di'i med med ces pa'i don gtan med la mi rung bas de'i don smad pa dang nyung ba sogs la skyedar ba lung rigs kyis bsgrubs pa'i phyir te/ dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel 251
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/las/ rang gi lde pa gang dag chos thams cad dngos 4 med pa la sogs pa'i mde'i tshig 'chad pa na smad pa dang nyung ba'i don la sogs par 'chad de/ zhes dang / 'grel bshad sngar drangs pa de'i migasher mdo las dngos med sogs gsungs pa dngos po skad cig ma yin pas smad pa'i sgrasadangos 4 med sogs gsungs te/ dbus da ltar gyi gnas skabs na yang mi brtan pa'i phyigdperan bu ngan par bu med ces pa bzhin/ de nyid las/ dngos po ngan pa yin pas dngos 4 med pa ste/ dbus da ltar gyi gnas skabs na mi brtan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /yang dngos po med pa mang la dngos 4 nyung bas dngos po med/ ces dang / rang bzhin med ma skyes ma 'gag sogs gsungs pa yin te/ sngon dang phyi ma'i mthar ma skyes pa dang 'das pa yin pas rang bzhin sogs med par gsungs pa'i phyig dper na nor nyung ba la nor med zer ba bzhin/ de nyid las/ yang dngos po dag ni dngos 4 med par mang bas dngos po med pa ste/ gron dang phyi ma'i mthar ma skyes pa dang] 'dus pa yin pas rang bzhin med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i phyir ro/ /'di ltar gsal bar bshad kyang] 'od dag gis nyan thos sde pa theg chen bkar 'dod pa dang drang don mi srid zer 'dug ba dag gi rmongs pa'i glang gi nga ro de lajigs med gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs lan nyon la bag yod par mdzod cig /'od kyi gron gyi tshad ma pa mang yos/ dngos pho la beem shes gnyis kyis khyab cing/ de yang gzugs kyi mtshan nyid mig shes kyi gzung bya'am/ blta bya zhes bris pa ni/ ldan min 'du byed rtag par khas blangs la/ sgra sogs kyang rtag pa'am/shes par slos shag /'di sems la bzhag pa'i bod kyi sgom chen par rlom pa'i sems khrid pa dag kyang] khyod kyi sems dngos 4 dngos med gang yin/ dngos po yin na gzugs yin nam shes pa yin zhes btsal 'dug pa'ang blun po'i 'tshol lugs yin pas dor zhig/des na bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung bzhin tha na'ang phung po lnga'i rab byed tsam bslab 'tshal lo/ /252
le'u dgu pa mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/gsum pa ni/ gardul chayod med/ /rigs minagazugs medagazugs ༅ tshad mar min /zhes pa la/ sbyir nyan thos sde pa'i 'dod pa phyogs sngar byas pa phal cher la rdul phra rab cha med pa bshad pa mang la/ cha bcas 'dod ces pa'i gsal kha med kyangaka mdo sde pa rdul phra rab cha med cha bcas 'dod pa gnyis yod pa shes te/ cha med 'dod mkhan la bar yod cing ma 'byar la/ phan tshun gyis bskor te gnas par 'dod pa slob dpon dge 'dun bsrung lta bu ste/ de'i phyi rol don grub las/ tha dad phyogs nas mang 4 dag /'ga' la kun nas bskor tsam pu /gnas par zad kyi rdul de ni/ /cha dang bcas pa'i bdag nyid min/ /zhes so/ /yang bar yod na mi rung bar med kyang ma reg par 'dod pa btsun pa lta bu yin te/ dbu ma rgyan rang 'grel las/ yang mang po dag bar med de/ ci ltar rdul phra rab rnams mi reg cing / bar med par reg par 'du shes 〈sna/ /zhes bya ba zhes dngaka 'grel bshad las/ gzhan dag na re reg pa yang min la/ bar dang bcas pa dag kyang min mod kyi 'dab chags pa kho nar gnas so zhes zer te/ de yang ji skad du/btsun pa na re/ rdul rnams ni mi reg kyang reg par 'du shes serdzo zhes zer te zhes serdzo/ /des na stag tshang bas/ reg kyang ma 'byar zer ba rtog bzo kho na yin no/ /'di rgyas par mdzod 'grel sogs la blta'o/ /cha bcas kyang 'dod mkhan gyi rigs pa'i rjes 'brang yod de/ dmigs brtags rtsa'agrel las/ mdo sde pa dang sems tsam pa brtsad pa'i tshe mdo lde pas cha dang bcas pa'i rdul phra rab tshogs tshe re res kyang rang 'dra'i rnam pa gtod par khas blangs pa'i phyig des na 'di dag sogs grub mtha' kun gyis rdul phra rab bam/ shin tu phra lha sa de la ci yang gsil du med pa dang / gsil na med par 'gyur ba zhig 'dod de/ mngon pa kun btus las/ rdul phra rab bsags pa ni gzugs 'dus pa'o zhes gang brjod pa de la/ rdul phra rab lus med par rigs par bya'o/ /blos mthar rab tu phye nas rdul phra rab tu rnam par bzhag lte/ zhes dang mdzod las/253
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/skad cig phra rab rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dang ni de bzhin pu /lcags chu ri 'ong / zhes sogs ltar ri 'ong spu 6tsam gyi rdul gyi bdun cha gcig chu rdul dang]de'i bdun cha gcig lcags rdul dang/ de'i bdun cha gcig rdul phran dang] de'i bdun cha gcig la rdul phra rab tu lasdog pas ri bong gi spu rtseg nyis stong bzhi brgya nyag ma gcig byas pa/ rdul phra rab kyi tshad yin te/ 'de ltar ri 'ong gi spru rtsegacig cha bdun du bsil ba'i cha gcig chu rdul te/ ri 'ong gi spu rtsegacig la chu rdul bdun 'byung / de'i chu rdul bdun po re re'ang bdun du bsil ba'i cha gcig ni lcags rdul te/ ri 'ong gi spu rtsegacig la lcags rdul bdun bdun te zhe dgu 'byung / de'i lcags rdul re re'ang cha bdun du bsil ba'i cha gcig ni/ rdul phran te/ ri sang spu rtsegacig la rdul phran sum brgya zhe gsum byung / de'i rdul phran sum brgya zhe gsum po re re'ang bdun du bsil ba'i cha gcig ni rdul phra rab te rdul thams cad kyi phra zugs sam phra ba'i rab ste/ 'di las phra ba dang chung ba'i gzugs grub mtha' bzhi po su yang mi 'dod la/ 'di la gsil rgyu gzhig rgyu med par mthun yang] cha yod med tsam la grub mtha' gong 'og rtsod cing] 'di'ang rdul rdzas brgyad 'dus yin yangaka bsags rdul yin par mi legad de/ rang rtsom byed kyi rdul med pa'i phyir dang] rdzas rdul khas blangs na phyi rol pa'i lugs su 'gyur bar bzhi brgya pa'i 'grel ba dang /ṭīka chen de nyid snang bar bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang blun 4 la la de cha drug byas de'i drug cha re regano de ltar du bgo 'dod pani rdul phran tsam gyilangadon spyi ma shes pa'o//desan rdul phra rab cha bcasayinasang/ rdul 'dus pa masan pas yan lag can min par sa sde las bshadacas/ /bstan yodadang thogs bcas ci rigs kyi rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs gzugs mtshan nyid pa med par 'dod de/ bye smra'i mdzod las/ rnam gsum dri med gzugs gsungs dang/ /'phel dang ma byas lam sogs phyig /zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan yod thogs bcas dang / bstan 254
le'u dgu pa mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/med thogs bcas dang/ bstan med thogs med kyi gzugs gsum gsungs pa'idang po gzugs kyi skye mched/ gnyis pa sgra se gas dbang 4 gzugs can yin la/ gsum pa la mtshan gzhi rig min gyi gzugs dgos pa'i phyir dang / gzugs gang la chags pa mi skye bar bshad pas zag med kyi gzugs gsungs pa dang/ dge 'dun la kunadaga' ra ba phul ba dge 'dun gyis longs spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ sgyin bdag gnyid log kyang rgyud la bsod nams 'phel bar gsungs pa lta bu'i rdzas las byung ba'i bsodanams bdun bdun 'phel bar bshad pa'i pyir dang] rang gis srog bcad pa ma byas kyang gzhan la byed du bcug pas las lam rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir dang]chos ni phyi'i skye mched de bstan du med la thogs pa med pa zhes gsungs kyang] gzugs can min pa'o zhes ma gsungs pa'i phyir dngaka 'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi ngag sogs mnyam bzhag na yod pa'i phyir dang / dge slong sems g.yeng ba sogs kyi tshe sdom ldan yin pa'i phyir dang / sdom pa 'chal tshul 'gog pa'i chu lon lta bur gsungs pa'i phyig zhes rigs pa brgyad lasad pa la/ mdo sems thun mong gi lan ni/ rang 'grel las/ 'di la mdo sde ba na re/ 'di ni mang po yang yin la/ 'di ni sna tshogs pa yang yin mod kyi 'di ni de lngayang min no/ /zhes zer ro/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ zhes sogs gsungs/ don ni/ dang 4 gnyis ni ting nge 'odzin gyi rgyud yul gzugs snang la dgongs/ mdo sems thun mong du zer ba yangan mdo sde pa kha cig dgra bcom pa dang / sgyi rol gyi gzugs la zag med du bshad de/ de'i rten min pas so 3da gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni dge sdig gi sems pas bsgos pa'i sems rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par 'phel ba'am skye ba'idon dang] de la rtsod pa mgo mtshungs byas so/ /lnga palang snga mdang 'dra la/ gzhan rnamasani mi mthun phyogasade mi byed pa'i dran shes kyi mthus byas pa'i lus sems kyi khyad par yin zer te/sgrub byed mang ste ma bris/ mdzod 'grel stos/ de la stag lo na re/ gzugs la bye smra ltar rnam par 255
grub mtha'i rnam bshabārig byed dang rig min gyi gzugs yod de/ kun btus sa sde sogs las bshad pa'i phyir zeg'od snga rabs pa mang pos/ mdzod 'grel gyis rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs bkag pas de med zer ba gnyis das bye mdo'i rtsod tshul gtan ma go snang ste/ mdo sde pa sogs kyis rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs yod kyang gzugs min la chos kyi skye mched pa'i kun btags pa'i gzugs su khas len pa'i phyir te/ bde gshegs gzhung gi rab byed las/ thogs pa med pa'i gzugs yod min/ /zhes dang / de'i rang 'grel las/ thogs pa lte rang gi yul du gzhan 'byung ba'i gegs byed pa rnam par rig byed min pa zhes bya ba'i gzugs gang la med pa ste yod pa min te med pa yin la/ zhes dang / tshul 'di zugs la bzhag nas/ ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa lta bu bstan du med cing] thogs pa med pa'i rnam par rig byed min pa'i gzugs gzugs mtshan nyid par gyur pachungad pa minalhas/ /zhes sesna/ /dbang po gzugs can pa tshad mar mi rung nye/ beem 4 yin pa'i phyiradang/ rang gi yul gzhal mi thub pa'i phyiradang]gsal rig gis stong pa'i phyis ji skad sa mthong ba dbang po'i yul min zhing] zhes pa'i 'grel bad mig la sogs pas mngon sum du mthong ba gzugs la sogs pa 'di dag ni/ mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pas gzung ba yin gyi/ mig la sogs pa'i dbang po'i yul min te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa de dag nyid yul gyi rnam pa dang bcas par skye ba'i phyir te/ drum po snang du mi rung ba'i pyid zhes so/ /gal te rnam shes kyis mthong na rtsig pa dre gas kyis bsgribs pa yang mthong bar 'gyur zhe na/ mi 'gyur te/ bsgribs pa la mig shes mi skye zhing / ma skyes par yul mi 'dzin pa'i phyid gal te bsgribs pa dang bar du chod pa gang la'ang mig shes mi skye'am zhe na/ de ma nges te/ 'ching bu dang / lhang 'tsher dang] shel dang chu dag gis bar du chod kyang mthong bsan/ bye smras khyod kyis bar du chod la mi mthong zer ba'ang ma 256
le'udagu pa mdo gne pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/nges pa yin te/ gang la snang ba la gegs med na gzugs bsgribs bzhin du yang de la mig shes skye la/ gang la snang ba'i gegs 'amad pa de la mig shes mi skye bas dren/ /mdzod las/ mig gis gzugs rnams mthong zhes pa dang / mi 'gal te/ de'i dgongs pa de la rten te zhes pa'am/ yang na brten pa'i las rten la btags pa yin te/ dper na brten pa gang zag de 'bod pa la de'i rten gdan 'a4da zer ba lta bu/ rang 'grel las/ yang na brten pa'i las la nye bar btags pa yin te/dper na khri'u dag 'a4da do zhes bya ba ltabu'o/ /zhes so/ /lana'i khri'u 'bod ni/ da ltagadan rsān zer ba de'o/ /lhag ma'i brtsad tshul ni go sla la/ mthong dang / lta ba gnyis la pā shya zhes skad dod thun mong ba yod pas/ de dang shes zhes pa gnyis kyi khyad par rtsod pa'o/ /bzhi pa btags yod kyi khyad par ni/ yobyasadangosamed 'du byed baimasagabagagan/zhes pa bye smra sems byung zhe drug po kun nang phan tshun yang rdzas tha dad kyi rdzas yod du 'dod/ mdo sde pa'i btsun pa dpal len tshor 'du sems pa gsum rang skya ba'i rdzas yod dang] btsun pa sangs rgyas lha de gsum dang reg pa yid byed lnga de ltar 'dod la lhag ma sems kyi cha la btags pa dang / sems sems byung rdzas gcig 'dod do/ /btsun pa dpal len zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde ba med par 'dod kyang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos dang mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed rnams btags yod/ gzugs shes rnams rdzas yod du 'dod pas btags yod la kun rdzob tu grub pa mi dgos la/ rdzas yod la don dam du grub pa dgos so/ /de skad sa slob dpon byang bzang gis/ nam mkha' mo gsham bu 'dra la/ /serdzogs kyis ni 'dus ma byas btags pa'i 〈snad par bstan te/ btags pa'i yod pa ni ming tsam lte/ zhes pa nas/ de bzhin du 'di dag ni dus gsum dang ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed rnams kyang btags pa tsam du 'dod la/ zhes gsungs pa dang] mdzod 'grel blta'o/ /'dus ma byas kyi chos la rdzas yod rdzas grub gang yang min pa zhig 257
grub mtha'i rnam bshabradgos te/ thogs reg bkag tsam nam mkha' dang / rkyen ma tshang bas mi skye ba so sor brtags min gyi 'gog padang] so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis nyon mongs ci rigs dang bral tsam de so sor brtags 'gog ces 'jog la/ 'das ma 'ongs kyang skyes pa zhig tsam dang 'bras bu ma skyes pa'i cha nas 'angog pa'i phyir dang / 'di dag gi ngo 'o'ang gzugs tshor bzhin 'di zhes yan gar du bstan du med cing / mig sogs bzhin du byed las kyang 'di byed zur du bstan du med pa'i phyis rang 'grel las/ 'dus ma byas thams cad kyang rdzas su med pa kho na lte/ de ni gzugs tshor ba la sogs pa bzhin du rdzas gzhan du ni med do/ /zhes sogs dang] dze tā ris kyang] nam mkha' ni 'dod pa min pa nyid kyi mo gsham gyi bu dang mtshungs shing / 'gosnag pa gnyis kyang de lta bu'i nam mkha' dang 'dra zhing bsgres pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rtsod lan dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa de dag tu blta'o/ /des na dngos med ni dngos po zhig bkag cha la 'jog pas dgag pa zhig dgos par ma shes pag kun mkhyen rdzo nang pas sgrub pa rang dbang ba'i rtag bdag 'dod pa dang) yang 'od snga sgyi kha cig dang/ stag tshang bas/ med dgag gi rnam bcad yongs gcod kyi /pa/ rlog rdo pagaṇā ghnā snye/ /lharsha ṭwāṃ ༵ ༵sna pa~Xd lha/ shārmo ṭwāṃ snad rdzu/ kta (yo/ ṭā su 'dzin pa min/ /nag posna min zhes smras pa na/ /dkar posna min zhes ma brjod bzhin/ /zhes med dgaganidaper na bden par med byas pa'i tshe bden grub bkag tsam las sbyor med par mi sgrub rnyi( (1shā rsha spri snroskyo hūm̐ skyornyi ṭwāṃ/sna/ tsho(3 〉pa rlo ndhasdu shā/ stu nga dī pasdu ༵ pa/lhasna pa don gyis bstan pa dang] /tshig gcig sgrub par byed pa dngan /de ldan rang tshig mi ston pa/ /ma yin gzhan pa gzhan yin no/ /zhes shugs la chos gzhan 'phangs pa'i dgag pa dang / tshig 258
le'udagu pa mdo sde pa'i 'dod tshul bstan pa/gcig gis dngos su dngos po gzhan 'phen pa'i dang] tshig gcig gis dngos shugs gnyis dar chos gzhan 'phen pa'i de ldan gyidangaka rang tshig gis mi ston kyang skabs stobs kyis gzhan 'phen pa bzhi ma yin dgag tu ma yin zhesalan chadadang] gzhan pa gzhan yin no/ /zhes pa med sbyi/dri dīg② /rasnanga~X spya ghnā rdzu lha/sdu sna'i ṭwāṃ ṭwāṃ (pa lha(tā kli two kṣiṃ pa dwo/ṭwāṃ/ chi snashā te/ /blo dang don gyi dbye bas so/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar kā shis/ ma yin pa dang med pa'o zhes bya bani/ masan par dgag padang med pa ste/ med par dgag pa'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i tha tshig go/zhes gsungs pa ltaradagag padang gzhan seladon gcig la/ dgag bya dngos su bcad nas rtogs par bya ba ni gzhan sel lo/ /de la dbye na don gyi gzhan sel dang] blo'i gzhan sel med dgag gi gzhan sel gsum/ ma yin dgag gi gzhan sel gang rtogs pas sgra btags min pa'i don rang ngos nas grub pa de don gyi gzhan sel gyi mtshan nyid/bum pa ma yin pa las log pa lta bu mtshan gzhi/ sgra bshad don 'di la gzhan sel bar byed pa'i gzhi yin pas so/ /de skad gu shākya blos/ re zhig gcig ni 'di la gzhanadang gzhan sel bar byed pa'i phyir mtshan nyid ldog pa kho na yin no/ /zhes so/ /ma yin dgag gi de gang / rtog pas sgro btags tsam de blo'i gzhan sel gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi bum 'dzin rtog pa la bum pa min pa las log par snang ba lta bu/sgra bshad blo ltog pas btags shing 'des gzhan sel bar byed dgos so/ /de skad gu shākya blos/gsum pa 'des gzhan sel bar byed pa'i phyir rnam par rtag pa'i blo la snang ba yin te/ gang bstan bcos mdzad pa'i sgos brjod par bya ba nyid du bzhed pa zhes bya ba gdo yin no/ /zhes so/ /dgag bya dngos su bcad pas rtogs par bya ba gangad dgag bya bkag shul du chos gzhan mi 'phen pa de med dgag gi de'i mtshan nyid/ sgra bshad dgag bya med par bkag tsam gyis gzhan bsal 259

sems tsam pa'i rigs kyitswaskor/logs na med cing/ skye mched drug gi khyad par gyi gnas skabs la ming dang tha snyad btags par gsungs pas so/ /gnyis pa de'i rnam bzhag ni/ rigs kyi phra rags kyi khyad bar rgyu gcig pa'i tshul dang / rigs kyi nyes pa gsum gyis shes dgos te/ rigs de rgyu tsam las rang 'bras ma bskyed pa'i dus na rtogs dka' bas phra la/ 'bras bu bskyed dus rags pa dang / rigs de skye mched drug gi rgyud las tha dad pa med pas rgyud gcig pa dang] rigs de thog ma med pa nas yod kyang myangan las mi gda' ba ni/ mi khom par skyes pa dngan gdod pa la zhen cing nyes par mi lta ba'i bag med dang / chad lta sogs log lta la zhugs pa dang / thig glen sogs rnam smin gyi sgrib pa dngan mtshams med sogs las sgrib dang/ nyon mongs che ba nyes pa ste sgrib pa'i nyes pa bzhi yod pa'i dbang gis yin par shes dgos so/ /gsum pa rigs kyi rtags ni/ rigs med kyi rtags bzlog ba drug yin te/ lus sogs la chags zhen chung ba rtags dang 4 dang / gsor ba la skyo shas che ba rtags gnyis pa dngadango tsha khrel yod snying rje dang bag yod sogs kyis sdig las la cher mi rngams pa/ sdig byas pa la'ang 'grod sogs byed pa rtags gsum pa dang/ bden bzhi'i 'jug ldog 〈snags thos pa dang sems pa na lus kyi spu ldang zhing mig nas mchi ma 'byin pa rtags bzhi pa dang / 'dzigs skyob kyi tshul khrims dang/ legs smon gyi tshul khrims tsam dnganbslab pa blangs nas yang rgyal srid sogs kyi ched du 'dod pa sogs min pag thar pa'i ched du len cing/ lus srog la babs kyang bslab pa mi gtong bani rtags lnga pa dang] dge rtsagang byas sargar ba las grol ched du bgro ba rigs kyi rtags drug pa yin pas serdzo/ /bzhi pa ni/ rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag la zhugs ma zhugs/nges par byung ma byung] smin ma smin dbang po no rtul ci rigs kyi sgos dbye na nyer gsum yod de/ nyan sa las/ rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag rnams gang zhe na/ smras pa/ rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag ni rigs la gnas pa kho na yin la ma zhugs 307
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/shing nges par ma byung ba yang yod/ rigs la gnas pa zhugs shing nges par ma byung ba yang yod/rigs la gnas la zhugs shing nges par byung ba yang yod do/ /dbang 4 rtul 4 dang / dbang po 'bring 4 dang / dbang po rnon po dang] 'dod chags spyad pa dang / zhe sdang spyad pa dang / gti mug spyad pa dang / mi khom par skye ba dang / khom par skye ba dang / bag med pa dang ldan pa dang bag 〈snad pa dang ldan pa dang / log par zhugs pa dang / log pa min par zhugs pa dang] bsgribs pa dang/ma bsgribs pa dang / yun ring ba dang / thag nye ba dang / yongs su ma smin pa dang / yongs su smin pa dang / rnam par ma dag pa dang / rnam par dag pa dag kyang yod do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs se gas ni/rtog ge 'bar ba las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dag ni/ /rnam pa lnga ste rigs dang lam/ /gzhan yang kun nas 'byung bdang] /gnas dang de bzhin sprungad pa'o/ /zhes dang] rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las kyang] rang sangs rgyas kyi sa gang zhe na/ 'di ni rnam pa lngar rig par bya ste/ rigs dang / lam dang / yang dag par 'grub pa dang / gnas pa dang / rgyu ba'o zhes gsungs pa ltar lnga dang / sde snod kyi dang / dbang po'i khyad par zhugs gnas kyi khyad par dang tshogs bsags pa dang/ sgra bshad pa bcu las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can de dag gdod nas nyon yongs chung ba'i rigs dang] snying rje dman pa'i rigs/ nga rgyal che zhing dbang po 'bring gi rigs gsum yod pa yin te/ de dag nyon mongs chung bas 'du 'dzi la mi dga' zhing gcig pur dga' ba dang / snying rje chung bas sems can la chos ston pa sogs kyi sems can gyi don byed pa la mi 'jug par snying las chung ngur 'jug pa dang / nga rgyal che zhing dbang po 'bring yin pas slob dpon rgyun du gsang ba dang / slob dpon med pa dang / 'gran zla med par byang chub par 'dod pa rnams yin pas 〈sna/ /legs ldan gyis/ rigs kyi mtshan nyid gsum nyid de/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'byung ba nyid/ /dang po nyid nas 'dod chags chung] /snying rje chung ba'i rigs can 308
sems tsam pa'i rigs kyi skor/pa/ /khyad 'phags nga rgyal la spyod pa/ /des na de ni 'du 'odzi dang / /sems can don dang bya ba la/ /yid mi 'jug ste de phyir 'de/ /zhes sogs dngaka rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las kyang rang sangs rgyas kyi rigs gang zhe na/ 'di ni mtshan nyid gsum du rig par bya ste/ zhes so/ /rigs nges ma nges gnyis kyang yod de/ bse ru lta bu rigs nges dang / tshogs spyod pa gnyis ma nges par lasdog pa'i pyid /kun btus las/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid nges pa'am ma nges pa la gnas pa/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ des lam la slob tshul yang gsum yod de/ legs ldan gyis/lam dag kyang / /de yis gsum du rig par sga /zhes so/ /lam dang po ni/ rang rgyal gyi rigs la gnas nas bskal ba brgyar yang sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byas/ rang byang chub tu rgyud smin par byed cing / phyis rang byang chub mngon du bya ba'i ched du mkhas bya'i gnas drug la mkhas par byed de/ gnas drug ni/ phung po dang / skye mched dang / khams dang] rten 'byung dang] gnas dang / gnas min pa dang / bden pa rnams la mkhas pa'o/ /legs ldan gyis/ 'ga' zhig bskal ba brgyar sangs rgyas/ /'byung ba rnams la legs mchod cing/ /rang rgyal byang chub phyir brtsams nas/ /smin par byed do/ /zhes dang / gser phreng las/ 'di ni bse ru lta bu'i lam mo/ /zhes so/ /lam gnyis pa ni/ la las sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byas te skyes bu dam pa la brten pa dang / dam chos nyan pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la byas pas kyor lam dod rtsebazod pa gsum bskyed nas tshe de la/ chos mngon rtogs sam 'bras bu 'ob mi nus kyi/ phyis de gnyis thob ched du gnas drug la mkhas par byed pa'o/ /rtog ge 'bar ba las/ gzhan dag ni/ /sangs rgyas mnyes byas nges 'byed kyi/ /cha mthun bskyed pa rdzogs byed do/ /zhes so/ /lam gsum pa ni/ rgyu bzhi bo snga ma lade nyid ltar byas pa la brten nas chos mngon par rtogs par byed cing] dge grang gi 'bras bu thob la/ dgra bcom pa ni 'thob mi nus pas/ pyis 'das lam gyis de thob bya'i ched 309
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/du gnas drug la mkhas par byed pa'o/ /de nyid las/ gzhan ni sangs rgyas 'byung la 'bras/ /'job byed dgra bcom mngon mi byed/ /ces rtso/ /'dis phyir mi 'ong yang thob pa gcig bstan par 'dod/ gsum pa rgyu lamade gsum la bslab pa'i 'bras bu 'grub tshul yang gsum ste/de nyid las/ kun nas 'byung ba rgyu dag ni/ /gsum po de dag nyid dag gis/ /sangs rgyas med paradagra bcom nyid/ /slobadapon med par thobadang ldan/ /zhes so/ /'grub tshuladang po ni/ bskal ba brgyar tshogs bsags pa'i 'og tu sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba na slob dngon med par byang phyogs so bdun bsgoms nas nyon mongs thams cad spangs pa'i dgra bcom mngon du byed do/ /'di'i lugs la bse ru ltabulang bskal ba brgyar tshogs bsagasanas/ de'i 'og tu gnas drug la mkhas par byas te/ tshe 'phos pas phyi ma la lam lhag ma sbyongar lam mthong sgom mi slob lam bzhi bskyed par bzhed kyang] gdan thog gcig la nges par mdzod ltar bskyed par mi bzhed pa'i phyis 'di nyid las/ lam dang pos bskal ba brgya tshang bar tshogs bsags nas bskal ba brgya 'das pa'i 'og tu/ zhes sogs dang/ yang de nyid las/ de la yang dag par 'grub pa dang mas ni bse ru ltar spyod pa'i rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang legs bshad gser phreng las/de nas tshe 'phos pa'i phyi ma de nyid la lam lhag ma bskyed par bzhed kyang mdzod pa ltar stan thog gcig la nges par bskyed pa mi 'dod do/ /zhes dngaka legs ldan gyis/ dang po kun 'byung rang sangs rgyas/ /bse ru lta bur 'dod pa yin/ /zhes sesna/ /'grub pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni/ sngar lam phyi ma gnyis kyi skabs su bshad pa'i rgyu skyen de dang des sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba na slob dpon med par chos so bdun bsgoms nas/ 'grub pa gnyis pas chos mngon par rtogs par byed cing / dgra bcom pa'i bar du thob pa dang / 'grub pa gsum pas 'bras bu lhag ma nas dgra bcom pa'i bar mngon du byas nas tshogs spyod par 'gyur gyi bse ru lta bur mi 310
sems tsam pa'i rigs kyi skor/'gyur te/ legs ldan gyis/ lhag ma dag ni kun 'byung ba/ /rkyen gyi rang rgyal nyid yin no/ /zhes dngaka rang rgyal rgyas las/ yang dag par 'grub pa gnyis pa dang gsum pas ni tshogs dang spyod pa'i rang rgyal bar 'gyur te bse ru lta bur spyod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa gnas pa la zugs kyi gnas pa dang] lus kyi gnas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bse ru ltabu tshogs lhod pa rnams mthun te/ zab mo la mos pa dang/rten 'brel zab mo la so sor rtog pa lhur len padang/stong nyid mtshan med smon med de/ rnam thar sgo gsum yid la byed pas gnas pas so/ /de skad du/ 'di nyid las/ gnas pa lhag ma ni de yang bse ru ltar rgyud pa ji lta ba bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /legs ldan gyis kyang / zab mo la ni rtogs pa yi/ /mos pa dang ldan zhes so/ /gnyis pa lus kyi gnas pa la khyad par yod de/ bse ru ltar rgyud pa ni gcig par dga' zhing gcig pur gnas pa yin te/ legs ldan gyis/ dang 4 gcig bur gnas pa ste/ /zhes zung/ /lhag ma gnyis de las bzlog nas tshogs dang lhan cig gnas pa yin te/ lhag ma gnyis/ /tshogs dang lhan cig gnas pa yin/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/dedag krongangam spong rdal gang du brten cing gnas kyang/ lus shin tu bsrung ba dngad dbang po shin tu bsnams pa dang/ dran pa shin tu gnas pas mong sogs brtsod snyoms la 'jug cing / dman pa la snying brtseb na yang lus kyis chos ston par mdzad kyi ngag gis min te/de dag lus kyis chos ston gyingag gis mi ston la/ zhe 'gras pa la yang] lus kyis rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan nas dad par byas pas so/ /ji skad du/ legs ldan gyis/ lus la sogs pa legs bsnams nas/ /de ni bsod snyoms dag la 'jug/dman pa rjes su bzung ba'i pyig /de ni gcig tu rab zhi ldan/ /zhes so/ /drug pa sde snod ni nyan thos kyi de las zur du med de/ nyan 'os kyi sde snod rang la dmigs par byed cing / nyon sgrib las gzhan mi slong ba'i phyir/kun btus las/ de la rang sangs rgyas kyi zeg pa gang zhe na/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyid nges 311
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/pa'am ma nges pa la gnas pa'am/ rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring/ bdag rnam par thar bar bya ba'i phyir smon lam btab pa dang] yid 'byung ba dang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang rnam par grol bar bya ba'i bsam pa can dang / bdag nyid mngon par byang chub par bya ba'i bsam pa can dang / nyan thos kyi sde snod la dmigs nas chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i lngardzos sgrub pa dang / zhes sem/ /des na nyan rang la spang bya'i sgrib pa dang lta ba khyad par 'byed pa ni/ rnal 'byor sgyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa kho na'i lugs yin gyi gzhan bye mdo gnyis dang / sems tsam pa dbu ma thal rang su yang mi bzhed de/ bshad cing 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa dbang po'i khyad par nang phan tshun la stos nas rno 'bring rtul gsum yod kyang / rang bzhin gyi dbang po 'bring yin te/ kun btus sogs las nyan thos rigs nges rnams rang bzhin gyi dbang rtul rang rgyal rigs nges rang bzhin gyi dbang 'bring] byang sems rigs nges rnams rang bzhin gyi dbang rnon du bzhag pa ltar yin pas se / /brgyad pa ni/ zhugs gnas brgyad rung ste/ sa sder 'bras bu snga phyi'i thob tshul bshad pa dang]khyad par du nyan thos rnams dang lam khyad med du gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mdzod 'grel sogs sdi (lha /sdi (rnyi pa3 sbyishā kto/sna sna rnyi rnyi/ zlo spyu druṃ sdu kṣiṃ dwo dzī 〉pa traṃ ryaṃ ghnā spra shā nd+ra shāXhā phyir/ zhes dang / kun btus las kyang] nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa gron ma bskyed pa dang / bskyed pa dang / sngon 'bras bu ma thob pa dang] thob pa yang rung lte/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba med par bdag nyid kyis lam mngon du byas nas bse ru lta bur 'gyur te gcig sur gnas pa'arsha ༵ rsha /pa~X ṭwāṃ lha ṭwāṃ / maX rnyilha ṭwāṃ )snro kti lha/(spra pa( traṃ rnyi( ༵ (shādri pa ma ༵ lam ma bskyed pa dang] 'bras shu dang po gnyis se gas thob la/ dgra bcom pa ma thob pa tshogs 312
sems tsam pa'i rigs kyi skor/spyod par sbyar bar bya ba yin no/ /des na sngar bshad pa'i lam dang 'grub pa pyi ma gnyis la brten nas bzod pa nas dgra bcom bar dang/ phyir 'ong nas sam phyir mi 'ong nas dgra bcom gyi bar 'grub par bshad pa 'dis kyang gang zag ya brgyad 'grub ste/ 'grub pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag byed pa de srid pa tha ma'i tshe/ lam mang 4 dang 'bring dang nyung ba bskyed nus pa'i sgos bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /dgu ba tshogs bsags pa'i khyad par yod de/ rang rgyal rigs nges rnams kyis bskal ba chen 4 brgyar sangs rgyas la tshogs bsags pa'i lag rjes gtsug tor sogs mtshan dpe cha 'dra 'byung la/ ma nges pa bskal ba brgyar tshogs bsags pa'i nges pa med pas gtsug tor sogs yod pa'i nges pa med pa'i phyir te/ dper nanges pa bse ru rang rgyal dgra bcom dang / ma nges pa'i nyan zos rgyun zhugs gcig char ba dang / phyir 'ong kha cig rang rgyal du 'gyur ba lta bu yin pa'i phyig legs ldan gyis/ 'ga' zhig bskal ba bgyir sangs rgyas/ /'byung ba rnams la legs mchod cingaka /nas/ smin par byed do gzhan dag ni/ /zhes snga ma bskal brgyar bshad nas gzhan gnyis la sa sde ltar bshad pa dang / de bzhin du mdzod las/ bse ru bskal ba brgya yi rgyu/ /zhes dang / byang sa las kyang / de la bskal ba brgyar bshad nas gzhan gnyis la mi gsal ba dang / mdzod 'grel las kyang / bskal pa chen 4 brgyar byang chub kyi tshogs dag la spyad pas bse ru lta bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /drin lan bsab pa'i mdo las/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ni bskal ba chen ṭo brgyar tshar phyin par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas/ byang ye bar bskal la 'dod pa'ang zhakhrul la/ yang kha cig /rigs nges la tshogs spyod pa gnyis kyang byas nas bskal ba brgya yi sum gnyis dang sum cha zer ba dang / kha cig/nyis brgya dang sum brgya zer ba la shes byed med cing / lung 'di dag gis khegs so/ /des na mdzod lugs la tshogs rgyud pa la nyan thos kyi lam sngon song dang ma nges pa zhig dgos pas/ tshogs de snyed ma bsags pa zhig dgos 313
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/te/ mdzod 'grel las/ rang sangs rgyas rnams ni tshogs shing spyod pa dang bse ru lta bu rnams so/ /de la tshogs shing spyod pa rnams ni nyan thos kyi rigs su gyur pa gron du las ba'i rang rgyal rnams zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang] 'grel bshad rgyal sras ma las/ gang dag gis rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bskyed la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub pa dang / bdag nyid kyi 'dir dgra bcom pa nyid thob par 'gyur ba de dag ni tshogs zhing spyod pa yin la/ zhes so/ /skabs 'dir 'di ltar khas mi len pas/ rang rgyal ma nges pa la'ang bskal chen brgya la tshogs bsog mi bsog gnyis yod de/ gzhan gron du ma song b.radang po nas rang rgyal lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs rgyud pa du macand pa'i phyirate/ 'grub pa gsum gyi dang 4 bse ru rigs nges dang] pyi ma gnyis mnges pa tshogs :snad bskal chen brgya'i tshogs bsagasasan pas so/ /bcu pa sgra bshad ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi skad dod bra st+ya ka bud dha zhes pa'i pra ti rkyen/ e ka gcig buddha rtogs pa'am khong du chud pa la 'jug pas/ mdzod 'grel las/ lung med par bdag gcig phu'i phyir sangs rgyas pa'i rang sangs rgyas zhes pa ltag lung med par bdag gcig pus sangs rgyas pa ste de nyid khong du chud pas rang sangs rgyas so/ /dur khrod kyi rus gong lta bu la dmigs nas rten 'brel lugs bzlog serdzogs kyi rkyen rnams rtogs pas rkyen rtogs te/ gzungs rgyal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam par grol ba ni rkyen khong du chud pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'grel bshad las/ ji ltar bse ru dag gnyis pa de med pa bzhin so de dag kyang khyim pa dang] rab tu byung ba rnams dang] rang sangs rgyas gzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar gnas pas na bse ru lta bu rnams zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / grogs tshogs dang lhan cig rgyud pas na tshogs spyodad pa ste/ legs ldan gyis/ lhag ma ni/ /tshogs dang lhan cig gnas pa yin/ /zhes dngaka'ogs med kyis/ tshogs dang rgyud pa ni/ zhes dang/ mdzod 'grel 'grel bshad dag las 314
sems tsam pa'i rigs kyi skor/tshogs shing spre1da pa/ zhes so/ /gzhan yangan mdo du ma las rtag tu 'byung ba'i ngang tshul can du bshad pa sesnags la brten nas rang rgyal rigs nges la dge 'dun nyi shu mi rung la/ bsnyen par rdzogs tshul rang byung gi yin par shes par bya'o/ /'didagani sngon gyi bod kyi phar mngon pa dang1grub mtha' ba du mas ma bshad 'dug pas 'khral ba spangs te nyung ngu rnam gsal du banasnad pas blo gsar ba rnams yid dga' bar gyis/ gsum pa theg chen gyi rigs ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/yod dang mtshog dang mtshan nyid dang] /rtags dang rigs rabadabye bdang] /nyes dmigasadang ni phan yon dang] /dpe rnams gnyis te rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltas rigs yod pa dngadmtshog dman dang mtshan nyid dang sgra bshad dang] rtags dang dbye ba nyes dmigs dang phan yon dang dpe ste dgu las/ dang 4 ni/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs bden grub tha dad yod de/ lam du ma zhugs dong gi gang zag la'ang khams che 'bring chung gsum tha dad spru du ma yod pa'i phyig lam ñtsā ṭwāṃ kli ༵ ༵ dri kṣiṃ dhri kau dī sna hūṃ ga:snarnyinā snarsha dī da rshanāX (( lha/ pa ji sde ghnā ltarasungad pas na/ 'bras bu tha dad pa'i zeg pa gsum yangasgrungad do/ /rgyan las/ khams rnamasadang snye ༷ze da/ /༈/ ba sna ༵ spyu dzño nāṃ parnyi ] /kṣiṃ pa dzo /shā snye rshaX kṣiṃ paX shā kān/ /galha sna ṭwāṃ sgrib gnyis kyi gnyen po dang] stobs sogs thams cad tshang ba dang/don gnyis 'byung bas don che ba dang mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i zad pa med pa bzhis mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir te/rgyan las/ de dge khyad par 'phags pa dang] /thams cad dang ni don chen dang / /mi zad pa yi rgyu mtshan phyig /rigs malngastog nyid ces ba〈snad pa yin/ /zhes dren/ /gsum pa ni/thos thegags kyis gadrenas ma btab pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / ga〈snas btab pa'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs 315
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/gnyis yod de/ rgyan las/ rang bzhin dngu ni rgyas pa dang / /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ sbyor rigs zhes pa'i skad dod la/ dha tu/ zhes pa sa bon dang / ku la zhes pa gdung ngam rus ming dngad go tra zhes pa yon tan gyi cha nas bshad pa gsum las/ 'dir pyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ nges tshig go ku ṇa dang / tra ta ra na te/ 'di las yon tan sgrol zhing 'byung bas na rigs te/ rgyan las/ yon tan ni/ /snyol ba'i don du shes par spha /zhes dngaka 'grel bas rigs ni yon tan slol ba'i don du yang rigs par bya ste/ 'di las yon tan sgrol zhing 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/mdo las/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chur shes ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni mtshan ma dag las shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bras bu'i rtags gang las rigs 'di nges pa'i rtags ni bsam pa snying rje dang / zeg chen la mos par spyor ba dka' spyad bzod pa/ ngang tshul phar phyin gyi dge ba la bhyor ba gsum dang / snying rje so sor byas pa bzhis shes pa'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ lhor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang / /dge ba'ang yang dag spyod pa ni/ /rigs kyi rtags su shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /drug pa ni rigs la nges ma nges gnyis dang / rkyen gyis 'phrog mi 'phrog gnyisadang bzhi yod cing / nges pa dang mi 'phrog pa don gcig la/ gzhan gnyis kyang don gcig pa'i phyir te/rigs ni nges dang ma nges pa/ /rkyen rnams kyis ni mi 'phrog pa/ /'phrog pa nyid de mdor na rigs/ /dbye ba 'di ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa ni/ nyon mongs mang ba dang grogs ngan dang / yo byad kyis 'phongs pa dang / gzhan gyi dbang du gyur pa'i nyes pa bzhis rigs la gnas kyang yon tan la mi 'jug ste/ nyon mongs goms dang grogs ngan dang / /'phongs dang gzhan gyi dbang nyid de/ /zhes so/ /brgyad pa ni/ theg chen rigs gnas kyi phan yon ni/ ngan 'gror 'gro dka' ba dang] song yang myur du thar pa dang / der yang sdug bsngal chung ba dang / skyo 316

'phros don snod bcud rnam bzhagnas ni/ /dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i 'bru ma non par chags pa'i thog ma 'og gzhi'i rlung dkyil yin snyam pa dang / la las mdzod las/ bar gyi bskal ba dpag med nas/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'dis gabrul nas bskal ba dang po'i gling 'di'i 'gro ba gzugs can lta bu de nas ya 'og 'dzin pa dang / yang kha cig /gnas bskal gyi ya 'og mgo 'dzam gling ba'i tshe lo dpag med brtsams ma thag nas lasdog pa dang / yang kha cig brgyad khri nas 'edzin snyam pa sogs gabrul ba sna tshogs snang ba ni bod lador pho tshod dang sgyi brtol smra ba la mkhas pa dang grub thob tu re ba'i langs shor gyi spyon ham yin la/ dang 4 mi 'thad de me 'jig lta bu'i tshe thog mar tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang / de nas tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don gyi gzhal med khang nas/ 'thab bral gyi gzhal med khang rnams yas rim nas chags/ de'i 'og tu rlung chu sa'i dkyil dngor gsum dang / gling ri rab rnams rim pas chags pa'i phyir te/ de'i rang 'grel las/ dang por ni tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang 'byung ngo / /de'i 'og tu ni 'thab bral ba'i bar du'o/ /de'i 'og tu ni rlung gi dkyil dngor la sogs pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / sa'i dngos gzhi las kyang/ de ltar snod kyi 'jig rten mngon par grub nas/ snga ma kho na bzhin du bskal ba dang po'i myong bar 'gyur ba'i las nyid kyis 'od gsal gyi lha'i rigs nas sems can rnams shi 'phos nas 'dir skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ mngon pa gong ma dang shin tu 'gal 'o(/ /tshul 'dis 'o ga rtog du ma bkag par shes par bya'o/ /lugs gnyis palang mi 'thad de/ de'i tshe da dung nyi zla ma byung bar du lo dang zhag sogs med pas mee lo dpag med thub pa'i tha snyad mi 'thad pa'i pyid ma gruban/ rang gi nyi zla ma byung bar du nyin zhag lo sogs med par bshad pa dang 'gal la/ yang chags bskal dus kyi sems can gzugs can lta bu tshe dpag med thub par mdo las gsungs pa la/ khyed cag gis tshe lo dpag tu med par bshad pa dang yang 'gal 341
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/te/ tshe 'o dpag med thub pa la chags bskal du gtogs pa zhig dbostos la/ de bri banas gnas bskal du gtogs pa zhig dgos pa'i khyad par gnyis so sor lajug dgos pa'i phyir te/ nyi zla byung nas kyang mi tshangs spyod ma byung bar dudage bcu rdzogs par spyod pa la dri ma med par 'dul lung nas byung la midage ba gangayang ma spyad paradamyal bar skye ba mi 'thad pa'i phyig deyan chad du dmyal ba brgyad ma tshang bas chags bskal gyi mjug ma rdzogs pa'i phyid ma mos pa'i 'bras zos pa nas pho mo'i dbang po byung zhing mi tshangs rgyud byung la de spyod mkhan bzang sbyin gyi skye ba dang] de nas 'bras de la le los gsog 'jog byas pas/ mi skye bar zhing rnams bgos par 'phrog pa sogs tshom kun gyi thog ma de nas byung la de nor can gyi skye bar bshad bdang/ dedag dgag par zhing dpon bskos shing zhing gi drug cha ster bar byas pas/ skye dgu kun dga' bas rgyal 4 mang pos bkur ba zhes ming chags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi skye ba yin la rgyal rigs thog mar de nas byung] de nas khyim bdag nas yid phyir phyogs pa de dag la/ phru hra ṇa zhes pa bod skad du zur chag lte bram ze'i rigs de nas byung] de nasayang rkun 4 la chad pa byas pas 'ga' zhig skrag nas rdzun smras sdugags byung ba nas mi dge ba'i las lam dbang gis mee lo mar bri ba nas gnas bskal gyi ya thog gi mgo bzhag na mdo bstan bcos du mar 'grig pa'i spras spra/sa /lha ༵ smi pa ( tā ༷ snang bhee /'o/ ༈ ghnā paXdī ༷ ༈ /rdzu (shā spri ṭwāṃ dzño pa/ kṣiṃ ( gyur pa'i las kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyis sems can dmyal ba rnams na gshin rje'i rgyal por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu sems can dmyal ba'i srung ma rnams ni sprul ba lta bur 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gnod pa dang lcags zangs la serdzogs pa rnams dang] sems can dmyal ba'i me yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'des dmyal srung la sems can gyis khyab par 342
'phros donasnod bcud rnam bzhag'dod pa dang / de la 'gro ba min pas khyab par 'dod pa sogs bkag pa yin la/ de bzhin du 'dul ba lung sogs dang/ mdzod las kyang] de nas las kyi lam lhags pas/ /tshe zung/ zhes dang] rang 'grel las/ de nas de ltar las kyi lam rnams 'phel ba dang mi rnams kyi tshe khad kyis thung ngur 'gyur te/ tha mar mi tshe lo bcu par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / khyad par du de las kyang gsal ba ni/ mdzod las/ bar gyi bskal ba dpag med nas/ /serdzogs kyi rang 'grel las/ tshe dpag tu med pa nas 'grib pa na tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du 'gyur te/ 'di ni chags nas gnas pa rnams kyi bar gyi bskal ba dang po yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ snod chags rjes su tshangs pa sogs gsungs te/ tshe lo dpag med thub pa yan chad bcud chags dus yin la/ de la bar bskal bcu dgu song ba de'i skabs yin pa'i phyir te/ rang 'grel las/ 'jig rten chags pa na/ mi rnams kyi tshe dpag tu med pa la bar gyi bskal ba bcu dgu 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe lo dpag med nas 'grib pa na zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lugs gsum pa brgyad rṇi nas 'dzin pa sa sde dang mthun yang khyed kyis ya thog rkyang pa dang de yang mdzod tshig de'i dgongs par mi 'gro ste/ tshe lo dpag med bri tsam nas brgyad khrir 'gyur ba la lung rigs du mas gnod par rtogs sla ba'i phyir/ des na gangs can gyi paṇḍi ta chen so bcom ldan ral gri'i zhabs kyis kyang tshe lo dpag med bye ba'i 'bru mdzad pa ni tshig la lam rgyus yod pa tsam mo/ /gnyis pa mi 'dra ba ni/ cha 'dra yang1 /'dod ba rtso drug gnas rigs bco brgyad gzugag /ridapyibs rtsogs minanges ba'i las 'dagasogag /sang sogasadabye tshuladage se gas mi 'dralang] /zhes pa la/ mi 'dra ba sbyor bstan/ bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ snod bcud chags bskal 'dzig bskal gnas bskal stong bskal gyi bar bskal ming dang grangs 'dra yang don mi 'dra ba sngar bshad pa lta bu dang / chags tshul yang mngon pa gnyis las 343
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/char gnya' shing tsam babs par gsungs pa ltar lung sogs las kyang snang la/ mdo la la na sprin yang mi 'dra ba so gnyis dang] yun yang bar bskal bcu drug tu babs par bshad la/ char yang bar bskal lnga la ga71la mda' tsam dang / de lnga la glang po'i pho mtshan tsam sesnags babs par bshad pa dang / des tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bar du khyab par bshad de/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo las/ rgyal 4 chen po gang 'jig rten 'di chags par 'gyur ba'i dus de yod de/'dzig rten gyi khams 'di 'chags par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' 'di la kun tu sprin shin tu stug po'i tshogs sum cu rtsaganyis 'khrigs par 'gyur te/ de dag 'khrigs pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'de thams cad g.yogs par 'gyur te/ de la bskal ba bar ma lnga'i bar du gzugal mda' tsam gyi char gyi rgyun 'bab 4/ /bskal ba bar ma lnga'i bar du glang 4 che'i pho mtshan tsam gyi char 'bab bo/ /bskal ba bar ma lnga'i bar du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i char 'bab 4/ /bskal ba bar ma lnga'i bar du thigs pa chen po'i char 'bab 4/ /des sa 'di nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du chus khyab par gang bar 'gyur te/ zhes gsungs la/ ri'i go rim dang grangs kyang mi 'dra ba du ma snang ste/ mdo de nyid las/ ri'i rgyal 4 ri rab dag dang / gnya' shing 'dzin dag dang / mu khyud 'dzin dag dang / gshol mda' 'dzin dag dang / rdo rje 'dzin dag dang / seng ldeng can dag dang / rnam par 'dud dag dang / ri rta rna /lha /dri] rdzu ṭī sprisdi rshang /sna lta sna 〉pa snro shlau ghnā ṭwāṃ ji ga/ shā snro pagad srang /tsho /zlo ༵ ṭwāṃ dang/ ṭīka chen de nyid snang ba las/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ nub ba lang spyod pa'i lus shing tā la bdun brtsegs pa'i tshad tsam pa dang / shar lus 'phags po'i mi rnams shing n+ya kro dha'i sdong po'i tshad dang mtshungs pa tsam gyi lus su bshad pas mdzod dang mi mthun la/ gzhan 344
'phros don snod bcud rnam bzhagyang mdo dran pa nyer bzhag tu ba lang rgyud pa'i mi rnams nu ma gsum pa dang / 'dzam bu gling pa'i sprul gyis mig gi sgo nas sgra thos pa ltad ba lang spyod pa'i mi rnams kyis sgra thos shing dri 'dzin la/ ri la sogs pas bar du chod pa'i gzugs rnams kyang mthong ba dang / shar lus 'phags po'i mi rnams kyi mig gis mtshan mo mun pa'i nang gi gzugs rnams kyang nyin mo dang khyad med par mthong zhing / mda' 'phangs pas sleb pa tsam phan chad kyi sgra mi thos pa mdzod dang gdags pa dang sa sde sogs nas mi 'byung ba'i rnam bzhag mang du gsungs shing / zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang der ma zad ri rab kyang chu'i steng du yang dpag tshad brgyad rṇi bzhi stong yod pa dang / gling so so'i tshad kyang mi mthun pa sogs yod de/ yab sras mjal ba las 'di lta lte/ zla ba'i dkyil gshor dpag tshad bzhi khri gnyis stong nas 'gro lte zhes dang / de nyid las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gnas pa dang / rngams su dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong yod la/ rgyar dpag tshad drug khri yod pa'i sa chen po zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag gi bshad tshul ṭīka chen de nyid las/ ri rab kyi tshad kyang steng du 'phags pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang 'og tu yang brgyad khri bzhi stong du bshad cing / kha dog kyang ri rab kyi shar dngul/snyo baiḍūrya/ nub gser/ byang shel dkar por bshad la/ nyi ma'ang lhun po'i rtsemo'i thad nas 'char ba nub pa dang skye dgu rnams kyi tshe yar 'phel ba na nyi ma'i dkyil gagor yang dpag tshad brgya bar 'gyur ba dang] gling bzhi'i tshad kyang ladzam bu'i gling ni dpag tshad stong phrag bdun yin no/ /ba lang rgyud ni stong phrag brgyad yin no/ /shar gyi lus 'phags po ni dpag tshad stong phrag dgu yin no/ /byang gi sgra mi snyan ni dpag tshad stong phrag bcu yin no/ /zhes bshad pa dang /gser gyi ri las brgal ba'i ri rab dang nye ba rnams na yang gling mi 'dra ba du ma dang / mtsho dang ri mi 'dra ba du ma dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma'i tshad dang ldan pa la 〈snags pa mtha' yas pa zhig 345
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/bshad la/ gser gyi ri 4 stong phrag drug cu pa rnams kyi dbus na lhun po gnas zhes pa tsam ma gtogs gser gyi ri bdun gyi grangs kyang ma bshad cing gser gyi ri bo'i dpang dpag tshad rṇi phrag drug cu bshad pa sogs mngon mdzod dang sa sde gnyis dzodang mi mthun pa che zhing dus lta'or dang yang gtan mi mthun no/ /der ma zad mdo dang lung gzhan las kyang mngon pa dang dus gshor gnyis ka dang mi mthun pa'i rnam bzhag zur tsam mang du 'byung zhing / de dag thams cad kyang mi mjed 'jig rten 'di dang] zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'jig rten gyi khams tha dad kyi dbang du byas na dag ma dag gi 'dzig rten la mtha' gcig tu tshad bzhag dka' ste gdul bya'i las nyon spyod pa'i mtha' ma bkag pa bzhin du sangs rgyas byang sems kyi smon lam yang mtha' yas pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i pyir te/ mdo las/ 'dzig rten gyi khams kha cig sa lta bur 'dug go/kha cig sna tshogs padma'i dbyibs su 'dug go/kha cig shing rta'i dbyibs su 'dug go/steng g.yogs med pa dang] snel zhi dang] sbyi'u tshugs dang] zhes gsungs pa dang] byang sems sa dang po bas smon lam chen 4 bcu 'debs pa'i nang gi smon lam drug pa zhing khams mtha' yas par mngon du byed cing 'jug par smon pa'i mdo sa bcu pa las/ 'jig rten gyi khams shin tu rgyas pa dngam tha gru che ba dang] tshad med pa dang / sra ba dngaka rags pa dngaka 'tshol ba dang] steng g.yogs med cing gzhi phyal ba dang] 'jug pa'i khyim can dang] zhes sogs dang] dbyig gnyen gyis de'i 'grel bad de la shin tu rgya che ba dang/ tha gru che ba dang/ tshad med pa zhes bya ba ni stong la thegags pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams gsum 4 dag bosna/phra ba ni gang dag na yid kyi lus 〈snad pa rnams so/ /rags pa ni gang dag na yid kyi lus ma yin pa yod pa rnams so/ /'tshol ba ni go rims su mi gnas pa rnams serdzo/ /steng gasku(gas med cing gzhi phyal ba ni khyim gnas pa ma byas pa rnams so/ /'jug pa'i khyim canani khyim gnas pa byas pa rnams te 'dini mtha' dag gi mtshan 346
'phros don snod bcud rnam bzhagnyidado/ /zhes gsungs la/ 'dzig rten khams kyi rgyu dang/ngo ṭo/ gnas tshul/rnam dbyibs/nges tshog lnga las/ dang 4 ma dag pa'i de ni sems can sgyi mthun las kyis sna tshogs grub pa yin te/dper na las kyi sa bon khyad par las 'bras bu sna tshogs smin pa bzhin te/ phal chen las/ ji ltar sa 'on khyad par gyis/ /'bru rnams sna tshogs smin pa ltar/ /de bzhin las kyi khyad par gyis/ /sems can rnams dang zhing 'byung ngo] /zhes so/ /dag pa'i zhing ni klu'i nus pas mkha' la sprin chags pa ltar sangs rgyas kyis gron byang sems dus su smon lam btab pa'i dbang gi sna tshogs su grub lte/ phal chen las/ klu yi rgyal pos sprin phung rnams/ /nam mkha'i dbyings la ston pa ltag /de bzhin sangs rgyas smon lam gyis/ /zhing rnams kun tu 'byung ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa ngo 4 ni/ mdag pa'i de ni las nyon gyis bslad pas na ma dag la/ dag pa'i de ni las nyon gyis ma bskyed par smon lam las grub pas na dag pa zhes bya lte/ ma dag tshul yang / phal chen las/ zhing gi dbyings rnams la la ni/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par gnas/ /sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs las/ /chos nyidadedag de na snangan /zhes gsungs pas dbyings ni khams te khams la lar nyon mongs pas sems can la las nyon mongs pa'i chos nyid dam rang bzhin nam ngang tshul kun snang zhes bshad cing] dag tshul yang] de nyid las/ zhing rnams la la 'od btang ba/ /rin chen rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dri med dag/sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs su spyangs/ /zhes gsungs pas dri med snga ma nag nog med pa dang phyi ma pasna spra ṇṭhī pa rsha kyā choX/na /sna dī ryaṃ ༷༵ spra spridī dī ghnā ṭwāṃ rloganyi kham̐ /dri snro/ spri/ spra snod kyi lajig rten gang yin pa las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba 'di mtha' dag ni sdug bsngal bden pa'o/ /yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi 347
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/rdzu rnyisna de )pa / /lhan ba~X mp+raṃ patā dī ṅgi ༷/ (dī rnyisdi gā/ larsha da shāspya sdi snarsha dīspra (snroshā dbang gis byung ba dag go/zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun la 'di nyan thos lde pa phal cher gyis /shā /spya rṇi rṇi lha shālhapa /spya lha spra 〉pa zhu) rnyi lhaX paX/ dhi sbyaX rnyi sdu/ zloX rsha/pa ༵༵ / yang nam mkha' la brten te dang / 'byung ba la dang 'od la dang / sangs rgyas sku'i byin la gnas pa 〈snags yin te/ phal chen las/ zhing rnams rgya mtsho la la dri med 'od can nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas/ /snang ba'i snying po'i 'od can nor bu'i rgya mtsho dag la legs par gnas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med rgya chen padma'i rgya mtsho dag la gnas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor dbyings rnams la la sangs rgyas byin la gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhis rim bzhin du zhing khams dri med kyi 'od can mkha' ladang/ snang ba'i snying 'od cananinor bu'i rgya mtsho la dang/ zhing mtha' dbung ste mtha'adabus med pa'i rgya chenani padma'i mtsho la dang/ de la la sangs rgyas byin la gnas par bshad pas sem/ /bzhi pa rnam pa dang dbyibs ni/ nor bu dang / rgya mtsho dang] ri rab dang / rdo khu dang/ seng ge lta bu dang / zla gam dang] rṇi dang] padma dang] mig dngakamdzod spru dngan sangs rgyas kyi phyag lta bu 〈snags 'dzid de/ phal chen las/ phyogs rnams kun na zhing rnams rgya mtsho snang/ /la la zlum 4 la la zur gsum ste/ /de dag la la phyogs nas gru bzhir gnas/ /nor bu padma 'khor 'dzi yan lag brgyad/ /kun kyang las rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dris/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /yang zhing la la na gling bzhi 'dzid pa 'di lta bu dang / gling bzhi med pa bde ba can lta bu/ lha mi rnams kyang lhan cig pa dang] sangs rgyas ri rab 'od yang dag 'phags kyi yid rab tu dga' ba na/ 'dzam gling la dpag tshad pye ba dngaka gzhan gsum la brgyad 348
'phros don snod bcud rnam bzhagkhri re re yod pa dang/ mngon dga'i zhing na gser dngul gyi skas la 'dzegs te sum cu rtsagasum du 'gro bar bshad pa dang / de bzhin du zhing la lar 'od med pa dang yod pa gnyis dang/ yod pa la'ang lha'i dang] khyim gyi dang /nyi zla'i dang] rang gi dang / ri'i dang / shing gi dang]nor bu'i dang]mar me'i dngan sangs rgyas kyi dang / padmo'i dang] spos chu'i 'od can sogs yod de/ phal chen kṣiṃ////( / rdzu pa ghnā zlo ñtsha shā/ nd+ra//pyā/ shā paX ༈ /lha rdzu ༈ spyanatu ṭwāṃ/ la/tshom na ñtsha dzod snarnyi spu spra la nyi zla'i 'od dang ldan/ /zhing rnams la la rang gi 'od/ /shing gi 'od can dri ma med/ /la la ri'i 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i 'od/ /la la mar me'i 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas 'od/ /zhing rnams la la padmo'i 'od/ /spos chu'i 'od dang ldan pa'ang yod/ /smon lam dbang gi rnam par sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal zhing bkod las sangs rgyas nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po'i zhing nyi zla med par smin mtshams kyi nor bus gsal ba dang] blo gros mi zad pa'i mdor mi 'dzum zhing na zhing bye ba khrag khrig bye ba phrag brgya nyi zla re res gsal bar bshad pa dang / de nyid las/ rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad pag /sna tshogs mig yor lta bur snang / /gsungs pa ltag zhing la rgyan yod med gnyis dang yod pa la yang rin 4 che dang dpag bsam shing sogs kyis tha dad par bshad pa dang / de nyid las/ zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas med/ /zhing rnams la lar sangs rgyas bcas/ /la la'i zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la la sangs rgyas mang po'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar zhing la sangs rgyas yod med gnyis dang/ yod pa la'ang zhing gcig la dus gcig tu sangs rgyas gcig dang ldan pa bde ba can dang / bde gshegs kun bzang gi zhing mig mi 'dzum lta bu dang / dus gcig la zhing gcig la'ang 'dzam gling gi grangs ltar du ma cig car 'byung ba mi mjed kyi zhing 'di lta bu ste/ 'di la nyan thos lde pa la las 349
grub mtha'i rnam bshadgcig las med zer kyang phal cher gyis snga ma ltar 'dod do/ /zhing gi gnas tshad bskal ba gcig dang / bcu dang] rdul grangs dang / bye bar gnas pa sogs yod de/ de nyid las/ zhing rnams la la bskal ba tsam/ /la la bskal ba bcu pa ste/ /zhing rnams la la rdul mnyam pa'i/ /bskal ba bye bar ba'od pa yin/ /zhes zug/ /'jig rten gyi khams thad lngar mtha' med kyang steng 'og la mtha' yod par nyan thos sde pa la la 'dod kyang / theg chen pa bzang spyodad ltar phyogs bcu'i la)ga rten mtha' med par 'dod do/ /lnga pa nges tshig ni/ bcud kyi sems can gnas pas na snod dang] 'dzig pa dang ldan pas na 'jig rten zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa/ stong gsum mi mjed 'di la'ang mi 'dra ba bye brag tu bshad na gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad re re stong la stong spyi phud dang / de stong la stong gnyis dang stong bar ma zer/ stong gnyis pa de stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen sor bshad pa ri rab sogs bye ba phrag brgya yod pa'i mi mjed 'jig rten du nyan thos sde gnyis su ma zad theg chen skabs su'ang gsang 'dus 'grel ba sogs du mar paṇa grub du mas bshad pa ni thun mong ba ste mdzod ltar du 'dod do/ /theg chen thun mong min pa'i dbang du btang na phal chen ltar bshad na/'jig rten 'di gzhi kun nas ston pa'i rlung gi dkyil dngor sogs rlung gi dkyil gakhor ri rab kyi rdul dang mnyam pa'i steng na spos chu'i rgya mtsho nor bu kun nas snang ba'i rgyan dang ldan pa la padma chen po spos kyi rgyal mtshan khyer ba 'od zer dang ze ba sna tshogs pa/ zhes pa la/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gzhi dang snying por me tog gis brgyan pa gnas de ni gru bzhi pa rdo rje dang nor bu'i gshor yug can nor bu'i rgyan gyis spros pa/ mtho dman med pa rin po che thams cad las grub pa rdo rje ltar sra ba 'di gnas so/ /de'i steng na spos chu'i rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul dang mnyam pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang de snyed gnas te/ de dag kyang 350
'phros don snod bcud rnam bzhaggzhi gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ dbyibs gzhan dang gzhan du 'dug pa/ ngos gzhan dang gzhan la lta ba/ rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan gyis 'jug pa/ rgyan gzhan dang gzhan yod pa yin no/ /de'i mtsho dbus ma la nor bu'i rgyal 4 padmo chen 4 zhes bya ba la sangs rgyas kyi zhing du ma yod pa'i bcu gsum pa ni mi mjed 'di yin no/ /yang rnam par snang mdzad kyi phyag mthil na rnam par shes pa'i khams dngam chos kyi dbyings dngaka nam mkha' dang] me dang] chu dang] sa'i khams rgya mtsho dang / me tog mtshan med dang1 phyag mthil gyi rgyud la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams nyer lnga yod pa'i dbus ma ni mi mjed 'de yin no/ /'di la'ang kha cig /zhing khams rgya mtsho gzhi snying mi mjed sogs du ma chud spru ni 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho de la sogs pa du ma chud pa me tog rgyan can/ de la sogs pa du ma chud pa 'og min chen po zer ba mi 'thad de/ phal chen las mi 'byung bar ma zad rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud mitshul yang mi snang la rgyud dag dang mi mthun par bshad par 'gyur ba'i phyig yang mkhas pa mang pos kyanganstong gsum bye ba phrag brgya rgyud dang sor byed pa dang / yang la las rgyud gsum pa bye ba phrag brgya gzhi snying me rtog bkod par lasdog ba dang la la de yang mi 'jog par da dung bar du rab 'byams rgya mtsho 'jug pa dag mi 'thad de/ de ni phyag rdor dbang bskur ba'i rgyud ma mthong ba'i 'ol tshod du 'dug pa'i mig des na 'di ltar yin te/ gling bzhi ri'i rgyal 4 ri rab dang nyi zla nas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad bye ba phrag brgya ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig go/stong gsum chen 4 bye ba phrag brgya gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i mtshams sbyongar gcig go/gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams rgya mtsho bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi snying me rtog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams kyi 'jig rten khams kyi rgyud gcig go/gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i rgyud dang 4 bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi snying me 351
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/tog gis brgyan pa'i 'dzig rten khams kyi rgyud bar ma gcig go /de'i rgyud bar ma bye ba phrag brgya la gzhi dang snying 4 me tog gis brgyan pa'i rab 'byams kyi 'dzig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gsum pa dang de nyid rang la gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'am bkod pa'i 'dzig rten gyi khams gcig 'jog gi de'i bar la gzhan mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dper na stong gnyis pa stong la stong gsum chen po 'jog pa bzhin no/ /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/rigs kyi bu 'dzig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba la)ga rten khams rab 'byams du ma nges par ston pa yod de/ 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams re re nges par ston pa re re la'ang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtshams spyor ba nges par ston pa'i bkod pa rab 'byams du ma yod par khong du chud par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yan chad kyi gzhi snying me tog bkod pa la rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud gsum dgos pa dang /de la mtshams sbyongar ba dgos zhes mdor bstan nas/ de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu de mtshams lhor ba bkod pa rnams kyi tshad ni gling bzhi'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag brgya dang / ri'i rgyal 'o bye ba phrag brgya dang/ rgya mtsho chen po bye ba phrag brgya dang] zla ba dang nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya dag gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams so/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi gzhi'i snying po'i rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa rab 'byams kyi mtshams sbyongar ba rnams rmya khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa gcig go/me tog gi gzhi'i snying 4 rgyan bkod pa dang ldan pa rab 'byams kyi mtshams spyor ba bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me rtog gi gzhi'i snying yo rgyan bkod pa rab 'byams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud gcig go/me tog gi gzhi'i snying 4 rgyan bkod pa'i bye ba phrag 352
'phros donasnod bcud rnam bzhagbrgya rnams gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi gzhi'i snying po bkod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud bar ma gcig go/'dzig rten gyi khams rab 'byams bar ma bkod pa'i rgyud bye ba phrag brgya gang gi khongs su 'dus shing rjes su zhugs pa de me tog gi gzhi'i snying po rgyan bkod pa'i 'dzig rten gyi khams bkod pa gcig ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa rgyud pa na yongs su sbyangs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i mi mjed 'jig rten gyi rnam bzhag la/ rje bla mas/ mdo rgyud gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed dus kyi gsor lo'i rgyud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dpal dus kyi lubor lo la phyi snod nang skyes bu'i rdo rje lus mthun par tshad dbyibs sgo nas gtan la phab lte gzhan bskyed rdzogs kyi lha'i dkyil 'khor tshad dbyibs sogs khams drug dang chos thams cad la rang rang gi sngags su grags pa'i sa bon sbyar te dbang 4 rab lo gsum phyogs gsum sogs tshe gcig la 'bras bu sangs rgyas ster ba 'di'i bshad tshul rgyas par grub pa'i dbang phyug rje nor bzang zhabs kyis ṭīka chen de nyid snang bar blta dgos gsungs pa ltar ṭīka chen dang sbyo don 'od rgyan rjes 'brang ba sogs kyis da lta'i bar du gsal bar bshad pa der lta la 'dir rnam grangs tsam bkod na ye shes le'u 'bum phrag lngar bshad kyang nang skyes bu'i lus la srid zheng la khra bzhi 'angad pa ltar srid pa gsum mam khams gsum gyi gnas bsdoms pa'i chu zheng gnyis zhar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi bzhi ste nang skyes bu'i lus la khra gang byung ba de'i dod la pyi'i snod la 'bum phrag gcig sbyar ba'i rigs pa sbyar rgyu yin te/ 'grel chen las/ de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams kyi tshad 'bum phrag bzhi ste lus khra bzhi'o/ /zhes gsungs pas 'og gzhi rlung dkyil zlum 4 rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi pa dang nang lus kyi 'dom la khu bzhi sbyad de'i steng du me dkyil zlum po 'bum phrag gsum 353
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/pa dang lus la dpung lhu nas khra gsum sbyar/ de'i steng du chu dkyil zlum po rgyar 'bum phrag gnyis dang lus khu gnyis sbyag de'i steng gi dbus su sa dkyil zlum pho 'bum phrag gcig pa dang lus kyi brang khru gang sbyar la dkyil dgor bzhi re re'i dpang la stong phrag lnga bcu re 〈snad la lha'or yug la rang rang gi sum 'gyur yin/ dkyil gangor rang rang gi mtha' gyen du 'phags pa lcags ri lta bu sgyi ma phyi ma mtho ba can sa dkyil man chad la 'bum phrag gnyis yod pa dang /lus la rkang pa nas rked pa'i bar la khra do yod pa dkyil dngor 'og ma gsum re re'i nang na dmyal ba gnyis gnyis te rlung dkyil gyi phyed 'og mar dmyal ba bdun pa ngu 'byod chen po gnas la/ de'i gnas na brgyad pa rdo khu dmyal ba yang gnas pas gnas gcig byas/ steng cha la mun pa chen 4 zhes pa'i dmyal ba dang1 de bzhin du me dkyil la cha 'og mar me'i dmyal ba dang / cha gong mar du ba mi zad pa'i dmyal ba dang / chu'i cha 'og mar 'dam gyi chu yang dag ldan pa'i dmyal ba dang cha steng mar bye ma'i chu bye ma yang dag ldan pa'i dmyal ba gnyis dang / sa dkyil cha gnyis su bgos pa'i 'og ma stong phrag lnga gseg ma'i chu'i dmyal ba dang de steng stong phrag nyer lnga bgos pa'i stong phrag bcu gnyis lnga brgyar lha min grong dang / de steng stong phrag bcu gnyis lnga brgyar klu'i grong dang] sa'i steng du 'grel chen las/ lhun 4 tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar lhun 4 'bum phrag gcig dang rked pa nas mgrin pa'i 'og gi khu gang sbyad de'i steng stong zag nyer lnga ni lus mgrin pa sor drug dang) de steng stong phrag lnga bcu lhun po'i gdong bar grags pa lus kyi mthong skra mtshams bar gyi gdong la sbyar/ de nas stong phrag nyer lnga lhun po'i gtsug tor grags pa lus kyi gtsug tor dang gzugs med gnas dang sbyaglhun po de'i shar int+ra hnā la dang/ lho padma rā ga dang] nub chu shel dang/ byang ke ta ka dang/ snying 4 mar gad kyi rang bzhin dang] steng gi rgya tshad 'grel chen las/ lhun 4 yi ni steng gi rgya shar 354
'phros donasnod bcud rnam bzhagnas nub dang byang nas lho'i cha'i bar du stong phrag lnga bcu'o gsungs pa ltar dang] rtsab stong phrag bcu drug pa stegs bu tshad stong phrag gcig yod pas bskor ba gzhan du ri rab kyi bang rim du bshad pa 'dir ri'i dbang po'i rwa lnga ni gdugs che chung lnga chung rim nas brtsegs pa ltar sgor mor gnas shing / rwa 'og ma dang 'gram stegs mnyam la/ rwa steng ma ni kha ba'i ri'am bsil ri la reg ba/ sa'i dkyil dngor steng na ri'i dbang po'i rwa lnga'i khongs skyebs su ri drug la rim pas gling re 'byar ba lte/ nang nas zla ba'i gling dang 'od dkar gyi dang rab mchog gi dang ku sha'i dang mi'am ci'i dang khung khung gi dang drag po'i gling lte/ gling drug gling so so'i mthar mtsho re re phyi nas nang la chang dang chu dang 'o ma dang zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho ste mtsho drug dang ri nang nas phyi la rim pas 'od sngon dang manda ra dang ni ṣa ṭa dang nor bu'i 'od zer dang / dro med dang bsil ri ste ri drug gi ri rab zlum por bskor te gnas la re re'ang phra spom dpag tshad brgya dang brgyad cu rtsabargyad re yod pa gling bdun pa 'dzam gling chen pos mngor yug tu bskor ba zheng phra 〈snam la 'bum phrag gcig 'dzid pa las kyi sa dang / de'i mtha' na ba tshwa can gyi rgya mtshor grags pa rgya mtsho bdun pa chu dkyil dang dbyer med pa/ de'i mtha' na ri bdun pa rdo rje'i rir grags pa'i mtha' bskor ba gzhan du rta gdong gi mer yang grags pa me dkyil gyi cha shas so/ /'dzam gling chen po'i steng na shar gling rlung gi rang bzhin zlum po dang / lho gling me'i rang bzhin gru gsum dang / nub gling sa'i rang bzhin gru bzhi ba/ byang chu'i rang bzhin zla gam lte/'jig rten 'dir chags pa'i 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams gsum dang /sa dkyil man chad la gnas pa'i dmyal ba dang / lha min dang steng 'og ci rigs na yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi ste 'dod pa 'og ma lnga dang / ri rab mgrin pa man chad la mas rim nas rgyal chen rigs bzhi dang / sum cu rtsagasum dang 'thab bral dang dga' ldan dang 'phrul dga' 355
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/dang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod lha drug dang 'dod pa bcu gcig dang ri rab kyi gdong bar tshangs ris tshangs pa'i mdun na 'don dang / tshangs chen dang / 'od chung dang / tshad med 'od dang / 'od gsal dang / dge chung dang / tshad med dge dang / dge rgyas dang / sprin med dang /bsod nams skyes dang / 'bras bu che ba dang / mi che ba dang / mi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang/'og min te gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu drug dang] gtsug tor la gzugs med bzhi ste/ srid pa sum cu rtsagacig bshad la/ 'grel chen las/ stong gcig ces bya ba mi mjed 'dzig rten gyi khams kyi dbus nas steng dang 'og tu stong phrag re re ste/ shar dang nub dang byang dang lho dang bden bral dang dbang ldan dang rlung dang mer ro/ /de bzhin du stong phrag gnyis dang gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs pas stong gsum rnam bzhag kyang 'dod pas/ la las gzugs gzugs med ri rab la btsud pa dang stong gsum chad gsungs pa khegs so/ /nang lus la tshigs sum brgya dang drug cu yod pa ltar pyi la zhag sum brgya drug cu yod par bshad pa sogs mang / zla ba gang bri'i rgyu mtshan la dogs pa mang ba 'og tu 'chad do/ /sa sde dang mdzod kyi lugs la ri rab chu mtshams yan chad la rgya dpang gnyis sgar dpag tshad brgyad rṇi yod/ chu'i nang du brgyad khri nub pa byang nas ngos bzhi rim bzhin gser dngul baiḍūrya shel gyi rang bzhin du mdzod dang gser dngul shel baiḍūrya'i rang bzhin du sa sdes bshad/ gdags pa las/ shar phyogs kyi ngos shel las grub pa/ lho phyogs kyi ngos ni baiḍūrya las grub pa/ nub phyogs kyi ngos ni dngul las grub pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i mthar mtsho bdun dang gser ri bdun gyis gru bzhir spel mar bskor ba'i ri rnams kyi rang rang gi rngams dang dpang mnyam la snga ma las phyi ma pyi ma phyed kyis dman pa ri rab kyi phyed dang gnya' shing 'dzin mnyam pa sogs so/ /de rnams kyi go rim/ sa sde las/ gser gyi ri bdun 4 'di lta lte/ gnya' shing 'dzin dang / rnam par 356

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/tshogs gcig gi ngo 'or 'gyud /zhes dngad gang phyir shes cha don du ni/ /bzhag phyir shes pa yul bcas pa/ /zhes pa lta bu mang po rtog med kyi gzung rnam bden tshul dang] de bzhin du rtog pa'isprung de nyid las/dedag gikhangade lta'idangos/ /bkag med gsal bar snang ba nyid/ /shes pa'ingo bo'i don nyid phyig /gal te sgyi shesango 4 yi/ /don nyid yin na thal bar 'gyug /de ltar 'dod phyir skyon yod min/ /zhes sogs lta bus so/ /rnam bden pa la rgyas par dbye na/ chung ngu mang mod kyangadedag gi khyad par phra mo rnams su zhig gis bshad nus/ grags che ba gsum lte/sgo nga phyed tshal ba dang gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa dang] sna tshogs gnyis med pa ste/ phyi ma 'di la'ang gabrul ba sna tshogs su snang ba thams cad don dam par shes pa gcig gi ngo sar 'dod pa dang] rnam shes gcig 'dod padang] gro ser sogs sna tshogs pa rnam shes gcig gi rnam par 'dod padang bcas pa'i rim pa gsum ste grags che ba lnga'o/ /dang po 'i/ sgong phyed tshal lam phyed gzhags kyi tha snyadani/ slobadapon 'phrog byed zla bas/ rnam pa gong gzhags ltaburani//smras pa'i sems tsam rnam bden pas/ /bye brag smradang chos mthun lte/ /gzung ba yi ni rnam padang] /'dzin pa'i rnam pa tha dad la/ /zhes se gsadangad bde gshegs gzhung gi rang 'grel las kyang yang kha cig ni nang du snang ba'i shes pa 'didag gzhanasan la 9 rol tu snang ba'ang gzhan kho na'o/ /zhes dang]rnam 'grel las kyanganagang phyir shes chadon du ni/ /bzhag phyis zhes sogs dang/ bram ze bde byedadaga' bas/gang snangade lanar rang yin te/ /gzhan gang deni mi snang nyid/ /ces pa ltabu dag gis so/ /de ltar shes pa'i ngo 4 yul yul can tha dad du snang ba de yang don dam par gnyis su med payinate/ yul yul can gnyis ka shes pa'i bdag nyidayin pas rang rig gis myong bar bya ba'i ngo 4 tsam yin pa'i phyir dang/ kun gzhi'i ngo 'o rang rig gi myong bya tsam de'i stobs las byung ba'i rtog pas de dag la gzung 'dzin du slo 'dogs kyang des slo 'dogs pa ltar gyi gnyis ni 398

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/rig pa'o/ /zhes dang] sngon ṭo rags pa gcig pu'i rnam par rtogs la/ rdzon po'i rnam pa nyams su myong ba de la ldog pas dbye bas gzung ba dang 'dzin pa dang rig pa'i char brtags pa yin te/dper na sngon po de nyid kyi skad cig ma nyid dngad bdag med pa nyid dang] dngos po nyid ldog pa'i dbye bas brtags pa ltabu min nam/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang rnamanges ltar dbu ma pas 'o na sngon 4 lan ngas rig go snyam pa mi 'thad par thal/ de gnyis tshad mas grub dus tha dad pa'i phyir byas pa la/ 'de ban re/ skyonade med par thal/ grub dus thadad kyang de gnyis dasangs rig go snyam pa'i dran pa skyed pa mi 'gal ba'i phyigade nyid las/ de gnyis ma'i nus pa las byung ba de lta bu'i zhen pa la 'gal ba ci yosnad/ ces sem/ /kho na re/ rgyud gzhan la de ltar thal ba 'phen nayang mi mtshungs te/ rgyud gzhan la de ltar skyed pa'i nus pa med la rgyud gcig la yod pa'i phyir dngande gnyis rgyud gcig la yod pa'i sgyir te/ de gnyis kun gzhi gcig las skyes pa'i phyir 〈snags smra lte/ de nyid las/ rgyud gcig la 〈snad pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gcig las skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du de gnyis rtogs pa 4 gcig tu 'du mi 'du dang gsal ba gcig tu 'du mi 'du'i rtsod tshul chos mtshog dang rdze tā ri sogs kyis bshad tshul go na grub mtha' lanang byan chud pa'i mkhas par 'gyur gyi ming tsam shes pas don go bar mi 'gyur yang mkhas par rlom pa ladagongs nas mnyam med jo bo ji ltagacig la 'od kyi rtog ger rlom pa dag gis grub mtha' dang tshad ma zhus pas gzhan sne 'od du mi 'ong khyed cag la gzhan sder rtsod pa'i nus pa mi snang gsungs pa dang rje yab sras kyis kyang tshig sbyo'i bshad sgrub ces smad pa de dor nas don dpyis phyin pa re mdzad 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam 'dod pa la mdo sde'i skabs kyi gzung 'dzin rim 'byung ba lta bur 'dod pa'i sems tsam rnam bden pa yang yod par mngon te sems tsam rnam 400

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/mthong ba tha dad par med par snang na ni bden pa'i rnam pa nyid du snang bar 'gyur na sogs kyang cha 'dra bar snang la/ de la sna tshogs gnyis med pa dang / zhi 'tsho sogs na re/ 'o na/ mdo las/gang snga phyi med par sems 'byung ba 'di ni gnas ma yin te/ go skabs med do/ /zhes pa dang /yang mdo las/ sems can thams cad ni rnam par shes pa'i rgyud gcig pa'o/ /zhes pa'i lung dang 'gal lo smras pa na/ 'di dag na re/ mdo lung na kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi dbang du byas nas gsungs kyi 'jug shes la min la/ kun gzhi du ma dus gcig la yod na gang zag kyang du mar 'gyur bas gcig las med/ 'jug pa'i rnam shes du ma yod kyang gang zag du mar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir te/dperan mig gi rnam shes du ma can gyi gang zag gcig bzhin snyam du bsamanas de skad smra ste/ rang 'grel las/rnam par smin pa'i rnam par shes pa'idabang du mdzad de/de skad gsungs par 'dod do/ /zhe na/ zhes dang/ de'i 'grel bshad las/ rnam par smin pa'i rnam par shes pa'i zhes bya ba ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa ste/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa ni gcig kho na 'byung gi /du ma cig car mi 'byung ba de'i phyir 'de ni bcom ldan 'das kyis kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i dbang du mdzad nas gsungs kyi 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa ni ma yin no zhes grags te/zhes so/ /de la'ang zhi 'tsho sogs na re/ der ma zad chos grags kyi lung dang yang 'gal te/rigs mthun pa'i rnam shes gnyis cig car 'byung bar slob dasan mi bzhed pa'i phyir/ rnam 'grel las/dedag rnams las rigs mthun pa'i/ /rnam par shes la nges par 'gyug /'di ltar rnam par rtog pa rnams/ /rim gyis 'byung bar yang dag rtogs/ /zhes bya ba dang 'gal lo gsungs pa la/ 'di dag na re/ khyod kyis smras pa de lta bu ma yin te/ gal te khyed 〈snan gyi slob dngon gyi tshul 'or nas rang dgar de ltar bshad na kho 'o yang bshad tshul gzhan yang 'di ltar byas chog lte/ mdo snga ma'i mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i sems gnyis snga pyi med par cig 402

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/ba'i rgyal rigs su skye bar 'gyur te nas lha mo dge bsnyen gyi rgyal 4 mya ngan med ces bya bar 'gyur te/ lha mo khyed kyi dngor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po mya ngan med ces bya ba des chos kyi bstan chos pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po 'og mar sgrogs shing mngon par mchod par byed do/ /zhes so/ /'di dus dgra bcom pa mang yang theg chen med par mngon/ ston pa 'das nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa na/ gron gyi de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgron me'i dus kyi rgyal 'o brtson 'grus chen po'i klu zhes pa ston pa zhal bzhugs dus kyi bram ze ko'u di n+ya la ring bsrel kyi gtam byed pa'i yi tsa byi mthong na dga' ba slar shākya'i rigs lho phyogs kyi rgyud du sngar bshad pa ltar lubrungs shing lo drug brgya bzhugs pa yin te/ sprin chen las rgyal po brtson 'grus chen po'i klu de ni da lta li tsa byi gzhon nu 'jig rten thams cad kyis mthong na dga' ba 'di yin no/ /zhes dang /'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ /lo ni bzhi brgya lon pa na/ /dge slong klu zhes de 'bod 'byungan /zhes dang/ lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /zhes dang sprin chen gyi mdo stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las/ kun dga' 4 liṃ tsa ñtsha gzhon nu mthong na dga' ba 'di nga mya ngarna las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya lon pa na klu zhes bya ba'i dge slong du gyur nas nga'i bstan pa rgyas par byas te/ mthar gyis dang ba'i 'od ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes 'byung gnas 'od ces bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang slob dpon byang chub bzang pos kyang/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ngawenangs su myangan las 'das te lo bzhi brgya lon pa na lho phyogs kyi rgyud du zhes so/ /mi rnams lo brgyad cu pa'i dus su slob dpon 'di lubrungs par 'dod pa dang/ lo brgya las ma bzhugs par 'dod pa dag mi 'badade/ lo brgyad cu pa'i dus de slob dpon gyis mi yul du lan gsum chos kyi sgra chen po bsgrags pa'i tha ma'i dus yin la/lo brgya yang chos de 'chad pa'i yun tshad yin pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad rigs pa'i rgya mtsho las 440

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/gnyis pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ston pa 'das nas lo bzhi brgya lon pas lnga brgya ma lon tsam gyi bar slob dpon gyi dgung lo brgya ma lon tsam na/ 'bum sogs sher phyogs kyi mdo rnams klu yul nas spyan drangs nas dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rtsab shes rab sogs rigs tshogs rnams brtsams nas/ mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbu mar dbrokhongs pa bkral nas shing rta'i srol phye zhing / mtshan la'ang klu sgrub ces 'bod cing / zab mo stong pa nyid kyi sgo nas chos sgra chen 4 gnyis pa bsgrags pa yin te/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyis skye 4 mang po la sde snod gsum 'chad cing yod pa'i tshe pyis pa gnyis chos nyan du byung bas kun tu dri bzang pos khyab cing / de gnyis song ba na dri med par gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ de dag na re klu'i rgyal 4 'grog po'i bu yin/ mi yul du 'ong bar tsan dan gor sha'i bsrung ba byas zeg slob dpon gyis tsan dan de blang du yod dam dris pas yab la 'dre zeg yab la dris pas/ slob dpon klu'i yul du 'phyon na 'bul zer bas/ de la brten cing / gtso 'or sher phyin spyan 'drin zhing] klu'i 'dam las mchod rten mang po bzhengs pa'i ched du phebs nas/ klu rnams la chos bstan cing bsod 〈snams bzhes pas/ klu rnams kyis bzhugs par gadrenal yang ma bzhugs par 'bum sesnags sher mdo rnams dang / klu 'dam bsnams nas mi yul du byon te mchod rten bye ba ma long tsam dang / sku gzugs du ma bzhengs pa sogs mdzad pa'i phyir te/ rnga bo che'i mdo las gnyis pa theg pa chen po'i mdo stong pa nyid kyi gtam smra bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsargyud las bstan chos du ma dang / dngos med don gyi de nyid rig /ces dang / lang gshegs las/yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig cing / /nga yi theg pa bla med 'di/ /'jig rten rnams la rab ston cing / /zhes sem/ /klu sgrub kyi skad dod/ nā ga rdzu na'i nā ga klu dang / a rdzu na srid sgrub la 'jug cing / klu la rgya mtshor gnas pa dang / yid bzhin gyi nor bu sogs nor gyi mdzod ldan 444

theg chen byung rim sogs kyi skor/nas rnal 'gyor spyod pa dang mthun pa'i dbu ma ba tsam yod mod kyang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed ni slob dpon zhi 'tsho kho na yin te/ slob dngon 'des zla grags kyi'ang rjes tsam na de 'dra'i lugs ston pa'i dbu ma rgyan rtsa'agrel sogs gzhung rgyas par brtsams nas srol chen po btod pa'i pyir ro/ /de'i sngon nas kyang srol tsam yod kyang mi gnod de/ 'jig rten na shing rta chen 4 'gro sa'i lam la lam yod tsam gyis mi chog gi /lam srol yangs la che ba dgos pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ slob dpon ye shes sdes kyang / ji skad so de nas slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos rnal 'byor spyod pa'i gzhung la brten nas tha snyad du phyi rol med pa dang / don dam par sems rang bzhin med par ston pa'i dbu ma'i tshul mi 'dra ba zhig mdzad pas dbu ma ba rnam pa gnyis su byung zhing/ zhes so/ /'di ni rje bdag nyid chen po'i yang dgongs pa yin te/ legs bshad snying po las/ des na 'di 'dra ba'i lugs kyang re re tsam byung mod kyang / gzhung rgyas par brtsams nas tha snyad du sgyi rol med pa'i tshul gyis dbu ma'i grub mtha' ni slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos srol phye bar slob dpon ye shes sdes bzhed pa ltar legs se / /zhes se / /'on kyang 'od kha cig legs ldan yan chad du 'phags pa yab sras 〈snags dbu ma pa sus kyang sems tsam pa ma bkag ste/ slob dpon ye shes sde'i gsung las/ 'phags pa yab sras kyis dbu ma'i bstan bcos mdzad pa las phyi'i don sku'od med kyi tshul gsal bar ma mdzad la/ de'i 'og tu slob dpon legs ldan zhes sogs gsungs pas so/ /snyam pa mi 'thad ltar /pa /༵ ghnā paXn ༵ ༵༵༵ spri lharsha ༷༵༵༵ ༵༵ lha nd+ra rdzu rtarsha papal pa/ lha lha /snaX spras rnam dpyad na/ /phung po kun gyi nang rnams na/ /gang zhig nas kyang rnyed min nyid/ /ces pa nas/'di dag thams cad sems tsam zhes/ /thub pas bstan par gang mdzad de/ /byis pa rnams kyi 457
