grub mtha'i rnam bshad/pos smras tshad sus zlos par byed/ 'di ni dge slong ma dpal mo'i ming po ind+ra 4 nyi dang mtshan gzhan lu ba pa yang zer mod/ sangs rgyas la mjal ba ind+ra bhū ti de ga la yin la/ 'di gnyis mingadang mdzad pa mi tso mod bodadag gnyis gar ind+ra bhū ti zer ba ni dpe yang ma mthong bar zad do/ /de 'dra'i rtag chad smra ba dbu ma pa'i ming can ci 'dra yod snyam na 'jam mgon sa skya parnyi ta'i sdom gsum las/ da lta'i phyag rgya chen 4 dang] /rgya nag lugs kyi rdzogs chen la/ /yas babs dang ni mas 'phreg gnyis/ /rim gyis pa dang cig car bad /ming 'dogs bsgyur ba ma gtogs pag /don la rnam par dbye ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gzhi la kun rdzob thams cad ri bong gi rwa dang rab rib kyi nam mkha'i skra shad ltar gzhi cir yang ma grub kyang blo zhakhrul ba'i ngor yod pa kun rdzob tu yod pa'i don du gdod la/ lam sgom tshe yid la gang byas thams cad mtshan 'dzin bdud las su bsams nas shes rab kyi cha kun lasag cing spyod pa'i tshe chos spyod bcu dang phar phyin lnga sogs thams cad blun so mas 'dzeg gi ched yin pas 'gog par byed pa'i rgya nag gi mkhan po hwa shang gi rdzogs pa chen po'i skor dang/ de'i rjes 'brangs ming don bya rgyud sor bzhag byed pa 'ga' zhig dang bka' brgyud gong ma mar mi dag gi phyag chen ni mtshan nyid pa yin mod bar skabasanas chos lugs sna tshogs nyan mkhan mang pos grub snying skor nas/ sa rdo shing gi rang bzhin gyi/ /glegs bam dag la phyag mi bya/ /zhes 〈snags dang / bla med rdzogs rim gyi mnyam bzhag na rnam rtog bya mi rung par bshad pa rnams las dang sa ba'i dbang rnon gyi nyams su len lugs yin par bsams shing] hwa shang gi lugs dang mthun par go nas/ hwa shang gi yas babs la cig caradang mas 'dzeg la rim gyis ba btagasanas gzhi lam lta rgyud de ltar byas la gzhan yang / dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar gyi nang ltar res rnam rtog chos sku dang nyon mongs ye shes yin zer ba dang / res rnam rtog gang yin mtshan 'odzin dang bdud las su 'dod pa gnyis lta 460

grub mtha'i rnam bshasigrub snying kun gyi pyi mo gsang ba grub pa las kyang]dpal ldan 'dus paraphunangs gsang ba/ /'gro ba'i mgon gyis gang gsungs pa'i/ /bstong ma bosnang ma'i lam nyid kyis/ /bsgom par bya ba bzhi 4 nyid/ /ces bskyed rimadang rang bzhinadang ye rgya dang de nas phyag chen te bzhi 'o rim pas sgom dgos par bshad ba lta bu mang ba'i pyir dang / de'i rgyu mtshan slongs pa'i blo ngo na phung sogs laga' 'i 'char bar mtshan mo'inam mkha' ltabu gcigawend pa lade'i steng du shes bya'i rabadabye la ma spyangs par bshadanade 'dra'i gti mug gis stong nyams cher 'phelanas khyad gzhi mnges bar khyad chos stong nyidangesadaka' bas thog mar phung sogs thams cad stonadagosate/ byang chub sems 'grel las/chos canasemadan chos rnams la//'jig rtenanani rgyud pa 'jug/cesadang]zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ de khon nyid tshol bar 'dod pade la bla ma phan par 'dod par ci zhig bya zhe na/ thams cadagegad ces brjod par bya'o/ /bram ze thams cad thams cad ces bya ba'i phung po lnga dang skye mched bcaganyisadang khams bco brgyad kyi bar ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i shes pa la stosanas phung 4 la sogs ba 'dispenadade zhes brjod bar bya'o//zhesadang/ grubadabangalan lag med pa'i rdo rjes thabs shes grub pag mar me 'bar ba bsad rung gi /shi na ci yang byar med tshog/dngos por bedzin ba nyid rungagi/dngos med 'odzin bde ltar min//zhes pa ltabu mang ba'i pyid khyad bar gnyis pa ma dbyad bar yul gtan la 'bebs tshuladeyang mdo sngagasadang rgyab 'gal yin te/ mdo sngags kun mthun par yul gtan la 'beebs pa la dbyad dgos par gsungs pa'i pyir te/ 'jug pa las/ bstan bcos las dbyad rtsod la chags pa'i phyis /ma mdzad rnam grol phyir ni de nyid bstan/ /zhes dngad mdzod las kyang / chos rnams rab tu rnam 'byed med par nyon mongs rnams/ /gang gyir nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i thabs med la/ /zhes dang] /rnam 'grel las/ 'di yul sun rgyung med bar ni/ /de rdzong bar ni nus masan/ /zhes 462

stag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/mdor na 'di dag gi gdul byas de ltar dbyad mi dgos na rgyud dang bstan bcos 'di dag tu bshad pa de su ladagos snyam du bsam par gyis shig/khyad par gnyis pa sam bu ṭa las/ stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /zhes drenags la 'khul nas mdo sngags gnyis spru'i skabs su stong nyid mi sgom pa sogs 'dod pa yang mdo sngags kun dang rgyab 'gal yin te gdan bzhi dang sam bu ṭa gnyis las/ don dam bar rnam pa dang re dogs dang 'dod sdig thog mtha' sogs su bden par 'dzin pa'i yul med tsam nam mkha' lta bur bsgom par bshad pa'i phyir te/ sam bu ṭa las/rnam pa med cing dogs pa med/ /'dod pa med cing sdig pa bral/ /'og gam tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /nam mkha' ltabur mkhas pas sgom/ /zhes dang] dpal bde ba chen po'i mgon pos kyangande ltar de nyid shes byas la/ /phyag rgya chen po rnam par bsgom/ /zhes dang] ye shes grub pa las kyang/ de ltar shes mchog thabasadang ni/ /bcas paralangadag sgom pa ni/ /shin tu drag po'i bdag nyid can/ /skye ba gcig gis 'grub par 'gyug /zhes thabs dang bcas pas yang dag pa'i stong nyid drag tu bsgom na tshe de la mchog 'grub par bshad pas grub snying gzhan las kyang gsungs la/ 'dis kyang chos dbyings bstod pa'i lung drangs nas bshad cingad byang chub sems 'grel las kyang/ de'i phyir chos rnams kun gyi gzhi/ /gnas med sgyu ma dang mtshungs pa'i/ /zhi ba srid pa 'joms byed pa'i/ /stong pa nyid 'di rtag du bsgom/ /zhes zeg gsum spangs rtogs kun sgya gzhir gyur pa chos gang yang rang ngos nas med kyang der snang ba sgyu ma chos dbyings de'ingo na sgra rtog gcig tha dad sogs spros pa thams cad zhi ba srid pa lasdoms byed kyi stong pa nyid gde rtag tu bsgom zhes bshad la/ mai tri pas kyang de nyid bcu pa las/ de ltar chos rnams ro gcig ste/ /zhes sogs dang/ de'i 'grel bar parnyi ta lhan skyes rdo rjes kyang] de la dang khor thos pa las byung ba'i shes rab bskyed par bya ste lung gi don nges par bya'o/ /de nas bsam pa las byung ba'i 465
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/rig pa dang lung ngag so sor brtags te nges pa drang ba'i don la nges pa yangadag pa'idon bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltabu mang ba'i pyida'on stong pa ma bsgom par 'dodadam bsgom par 'dod kyang ci yang yid la mi bya bar bsam rgyu med par sems had de bsgom na ci 'dra snyam na/de ni tha chad yin te/ de ni ma rig pa'i bsgom tshul yin la de mang du bsgom na dud 'gror skye bar bshad pa'i phyir te/ inas nyisawe shes grub pa las/de ltar nyes pa'i tshogs 'gyur ba/ /de bas rnam med de nyidasan//desan sems medade nyidani/ /deni rab tu dgag par sga /shin tu slongs skabs ye shes su/ /rnal 'byor ba ni la la 'dod/ /ces rnam pa 'dzin rgyu med pa'i sems de chags sogs nyes pa kun gyi rgyur gyur pa rgyu mtshan de bas na nga de dgag par bya zhes dam bcas nas blo la rnam pa gang yang 'char ba'am 'dzin rgyu med pa'i skabs de 'dra rnyed na/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes sam shes par rnal 'byor pa la la 'dod ces rgya gar du yang sngar de 'dra ba byung ba phyogs sngar bkod nas de nyid las/ slongs pa bsgom pas slongs pa ni/ /tshul ngan rnams kyis thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa/ 'dis rmongs pa bsgom pas zhes ma rig pa bsgom par bstan nas lhag mas 'bras bu bshad pa'i phyir/ des na sngar zhi gnas ma grub pa gcig gis 'de 'dra'i rmongs pa de bsgom pas gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug kyang mi 'grub lte/zhi gnas dang bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin bzhi rim bzhin ma grub par de 'grub mi srid pa'i ༈sna dī ghnāṇā sa phyi sna/ pa/ shā lha shā spra ༵ /sna pal/ ndha sna hūm̐ rdzu (3〉]sa/ sna kau ༵ lha ༵༵ ṭwāṃ/ blun po phyag rgya cher bsgom pa/ /phal cher dud 'gro'i rgyu ru gsungs/ /min na gzugs med khams su skye/ /yang na nyan zos 'gog par lhungan /zhes gsungs pa dang mi 'gal lam snyam na rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang mi 'gal na 'di dag dang 'gal yang 'di dag gi skyon du 'gyur mod 466
stag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'isnor/kyang 'di dang mthun te blun 4 zhi gnas sogs ma thob pas rmongs pa bsgom pa phal cher ram mang 7stos de dud 'gror skye ba dang zhi lhag gam bsam gzugs thob pa gcig gis gzugs snang bkag tsam gyi nam mkha' bsgom na gzugs med du skye ba dang / zhi lhag skyon med gcig dang stong rkyang bsgom na nyan thos kyi lasag par lhung la pyi ma 'di ni srid mthar snang ste/ lam gyi gtso ṭo rnam gsum gyi dgongs 'grel lung rigs gter mdzod las/ rtog pa nang du kha chom pa'i/ nas/ zhi gnas skyon med gcig dang zung du 'grel te bsgom na/ zhes gsungs pa'i sgyidting 'dzin sgrub tshul skyon med tsam yang sgom tshul de la ma mthong la inta 4 sgyis rgyas par bkag 'dug pas slo ldan rnams kyis bag bya ba'i gnas su snang ngo / /khyad par bzhi pa mdo sngags phyag rgya zhes pa kun don gcig par 'chad pa ni ma rig pa tshan che rtags yin te/ phyag rgya chen 4 zhes pa bud med kyi ming brtags pa yin la phar phyin gyi phyag rgya zhes pa lag rtags la dpe byas nas de'i ming btags kyang phyag rgya chen po'i sgra don gang yang med pa'i phyir/ dang 'o yin te/ sam bu ṭa las/ de phyir ye shes bskyed ba yi/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni sbyar bar sga /zhes gsungs pa'i don la 'od dag gis 'dra min mang yang rgyud rdo rje phreng bar shin tu gsal zhing de ltar dgos te/ pha ma gnyis dzi'i phyag rgya'i don 'dir rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir te/ rdor phreng gi zhe bzhi pa las/ phyag rgya'i dbye ba bla na med/ /chos dang las dang dam tshig dang / /phyag rgya chen 4 mngon par brjod/ /ces las rgya dang] chos kyi phyag rgyadang] dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang]phyag rgya chen 4 bzhi'i dbye ba bstan nas ngos 'dzin yang rim pa bzhin du/ de nyid las/ las kyi rnam smin nges pa yis/ /kun nas rgyas btab lta bur gnas/ /zhes dang / chos rnams rang bzhin med pa nyid/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rgyas btab nas/ /zhes dang / dam tshig rang gi yon tan dngos/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis rgyas btab pa/ /sogs dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam 467
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/tshig ni/ /yongs dag pa yi mdzad pa'i sa/ /de yi rang bzhin rang bzhin med/ /phyag rgya chen pho zhes ni brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar stong nyid la phyag rgya chen por bshad la de ltar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dril bu zhabs kyis/ khams gsum la khyab pa'i stong pa nyid kyi phyag rgya chen 4 dang / 'khyud pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin/ zhes dang / sbas don lta ba'i mig 'byed las/ theg pa bla na med pa 'dir chos nyid la btsun mo dang phyag rgya ma'i mchog tu gsungs pa du ma zhig 'dug pa'i nges don mi shes par snang ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i pyir dang / des na phyag chen la stong nyid dang rnam med lhan skyes kyi bde chen dang rnam bcas stong gzugs kyi phyag chen gnyis dus gshor nas bshad pa sogs dang rgyud sde so so'i bshad pa shes dgos/khyad par gnyis pa yin te gzungs rgyal gyi mdo las/ phyogs bcu dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chos ston pa'i gsung gi 'phrin las ji snyed 'jug pa de dag byang chub sems dpa'i kha'i sgos rgyas btab pa dang mtshungs par 'byungayod /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas rgyas btab pa zhes gsungs la bkar brtags kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab tshul yang de ltar yin no/ /mdo nying nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya ste/ zhes pas rgyas 'debs yul stong nyid bstan kyang phyag rgya chen po'i ming ma bstan la phyag rgya zhes pa tsam la zhakhri 'dod na mdo gzhan rgyas te/ gzungs rgyal gyi mdo gde na'ang phyag rgya zhes pa mang du bshad pa bzhin sher mdo sogs na shin tu mang ba'i phyir te/ mdo de nyid las/ de la phyag rgya bstan pa ni 'di yin te/ 'di lta ste/ a zhes bya ba ni mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /ra zhes bya ba ni chos thams cad la 'dod chags dang bral ba thob pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /pa zhes bya ba ni don dam pa bstan pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /tsa zhes bya ba ni mig rnam par dag ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /na zhes bya ba ni ming dang gzugs thams cad yongs su shes pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /zhes 468
stag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/sogs ltar bshad dgos la/ stong nyid la yum gyi tha snyad byas kyang chung ma'i tha snyad min la/khyed cag gis grub snying gi phyag chen du 'dod pa dang phyag dang rgya sogs phral nas bshad tshul de mdo sngags gang dang yang mi mthun pa'o/ /'o na 'dir yang stong nyid la phyag chen du bshad pas de dang mthun snyam na mi rung ste/ nyan thos kyi sde snod las :na pa bshad tshad ming mthun yang byang sems dang theg chen gyi sbyon par bshad pa dang mi mthun pa bzhin no/ /khyad par lnga pa 'bras bu'i tshe blo dang phung sogs gtan med du 'gro bar 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas dang myang 'das thob mkhan yod pa'i phyir dang/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs kyi ston pa yod pa'i phyir dang / yan lag bdun dang dbang phyug brgyad ldan gyi rgyal ba yod pa grub snying sogs kyi dgongs pa yin pa'i phyir dang / stong nyid bsgoms pas khyod kyi zhe gdod ltar sems kyang zad mi 'gro bar dri ma zad kyang sems kyi khams zad par mi byed de/ sems dang sems kyi dri ma chags se gas 'bral rung yin pa'i phyir te/ dri ma sems la gnas kyang rang bzhin la ma zhugs pas des sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba zhes mdo du mar yang yang bshad pa'i phyir te/ chosadabyings bstod pa las/ sa bon gyur pa khams de nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rten du 'dod/ /rim gyis sbyangs par gyur pa las/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyug /zhes sa bon rim gyis sbyangs snaX 'dri lha /dī ༵ ༵༵ 〉pa /byelta/da/hāzlog kau se/ (spra 9 〉pa /bye/ /spra/ snri kṣiṃ ༵ rdorsha ghnā med pa yin/ /zhes dang / de nyid las/ ji ltar me yis dag pa'i gos/ /sna tshogs dri mas dri ma can/ /ji ltar me yi nang bcug na/ /dri ma 'tsheg 'gyur bo sa min ltad /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems/ /'dod chags la 31gas dri ma can/ /ye shes me yis nyon mongs sreg /de nyid 'od gsal ma yin no/ /zhes dang / stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa 469
grub mtha'irnam bshadgang] /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs ldog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /zhes gsal bar gsungs rtso/ /'o na mdo rgyud snga 'gyur phyis 'gyur du ma las slo zad chos zad la/ bsngags pa de'idon gang yin snyam na/de ni dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin la ma zhugs padangaka rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang don dam par srid zhi ro gcig pa rnams kyi go don dang gcig yin te/ chos dbyings kyidon nyon mongs pa dang / da gdod de dang bral ba dang skye 'chi dang gshor 'das skya bya byed kun zad pa myang 'das lta bur gdod nas gnas pa'i phyir na rang bzhin gyi myang 'das dang]rang bzhin gyis de ltar dri ma dang bral bas na rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dang] de'i gshor ba dngade spangs pa'i cha gangakhang med pas srid zhi ro mnyam sogasayin pa'i phyir te/ mdokhab sras mjal ba las/ chos gang la rang bzhin ma mchis pa de ni dngos 4 ma mchis ba'o/ /dngos pho mchis pa de ni 'amangs su ma grub pa'o/ /gang 'amangs su ma grub pa de ni mi skye ba'o/ /gang mi skye ba de ni mi 'gag pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / dkon mchog sprin las/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /gzodanas zhi zhing ma skyesadangan /rang bzhin myangan 'das pa zhes/ /mgon 4 khyed kyis chos rnams bshad/ /cesadang]bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa las/ gdod ma nyid nas mnyam gyur pa/ /rang bzhin gyis kyang mya ngan 'das/ /yang dag par ni ma skyes lags/ /de slad chos rnams khyod kyis gsungs/ /zhes dang] rgyud bla ma dang rin chen phreng ba sogs du mas de ltar bshad do/ /kun mkhyen jo nang pa chen pos snying po'i mdo bcu dang rgyud bla ma dang dus gshor dgongs par byas nas gzugs don dam dpyod byed kyis dbyad tshe gzugs gzugs kyis stong pa rang stongadangade dus pangor nas bshad pa'i chad stong yin lades na chos gang yang rang gingo 4 bden stong yang de dang 'dra bas stong tshul gnod lasdoms ltar yongs grub ni gzhan dbang kun btags gnyis ma yin ba'i tshul gyi stong pa de dus pa'or sogs kyi rnam kun mchog ldan kyi stong par 470

grub mtha'i rnam bshagzhes sogs kyis sems tsam pa sogs kyi 'dod pa ltar yod pa min pa dang rgyang phan ltar tha snyad du'ang med pa ma yin yod med gang yang min pa'i phung gsum min yong med gnyis ku'ang min par bshad padanganaje tā ris kyang/ 'do ltarayod minate yod pa'i bdag nyid min te zhes bdag nyid kyi 〈snad pa ma yin par bshad la/ yang de nyid las med min kun rdzob tu yang med pa min te/zhes dang] yodadang med pa'i bdag nyid kyis gnyis lnga'i ngo 'o min la/ zhes dang/ yod dang med pa las gzhan pa gnyis ka min pa'i rang bzhin yang min te/ zhes bshad/ de bzhin du tshig 'jam dpal zhal lung na yod pa la'ang 'grel ba las khyad par so sor bshad cing brgya ba las/ yod dang med dang yod med dang / /yod med min zhes bya ba'i tshul/ /'di ni mkhas pas gcig nyid drenags/ /dag la rtag tu sbyar bar sga /zhesatsand min med min zhes 〈snags la gcig nyid 〈snags kyi khyad par ci rigs sbyar dgos par bshad la 'grel ba las kyang sbyar la mdor na rigs tshogs dang brgya ba las yod pa min par bshad pa thams cad la dgag bya'i khyad par sbyar ma sbyar ci rigs sgo nas med par bshad pas na khyod kyis mtha' bzhi'i dngos 'gal de 'dra dbu sems susang mi 'chad la byams chosadangadabu ma'i yod min med min tshigade 'dra la khyad bar ci yang ma sbyar ba'i 'grel ba gcig yod kyang yod pa min pas na ngan skyugs bzhin du dor bar bya laming 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag mi rtog pa'i yul stong nyid la mi lasdog par shes bya sogs sems la dran pa gang yang min pa'i spros bral du 'dod pa ni sems can thams cad kyi ye shes kyi mig 'byon padang thar pa'i srog gcod pa'i srid pa gsum gyi tshom kun chen 'o yin te/ stong nyid3 spros pa mtha' dag gcod byed yin pa'i phyiradang] stong nyid ni 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi yul so so rang rigasan pa'i phyiradang]donadam pa ni mtshan nyid lnga ldan yin pa'i phyiradang]shes byed kyang rim pa bzhin du rtsashe las/dedag spros las spros pani/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'gag 514
stag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'izlar/par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / brjod par bya ba bzlog pa ste/ /sems kyi rgyud yul bzlog bas 37/ /zhes padedag gi 'grel ba gnyisadang tshig gsal las/de'i phyir spros pa ma lus pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir stong pa nyid nye bar ston pa yin te/ zhes sogs dang] yang de nyid las/ de dag kyang spros pa sna tshogs pa/ gshor ba thog ma med pa nas goms ba shes pa dang shes bya dngakabrjod bya dang rdzod byed dang bum pa dang snam bu dang shing rta dang gzugs dang tshor ba dang skyes pa ṭā lha/shā spra sde srang]hārsha papa da/nga] rdzu ༈ ṭwāṃ dī spyug]shāspya shā)spyanasprisdi pa/ pa pangaskye] ༵༵ ((]'jig rten pa'i spros pa de yang ma lus par stong ba nyid kyis te/ dngos 4 thams cad stong pa nyid du lta bas 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang budhabā i ta las/ de lta bas na spros pani stong pa nyid kyis lagag par 'gyur te/ zhes dang] rang 'grel las/ de kho na nyidade lade'i yul can dngos yodang dngos 4 med pa dang] rang gi dngos po dang] gtso gyi dngos 'o dang sogasadangan mdo de las/'on kyang lha'i bu don dam par na donadam pa'i bden pa ni tha snyad thams cad las 'das pa sogs ltabu'i mdo bstan bcos ches mang lnga1 /yang de so so rang gis rig tshul dang mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan tshul yang/ dbu ma las/ gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang] /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /rnam rtog med don tha dad min/ /de ni de nyid mtshan nyid do/ /zhes dang] bud tathā tra ta las/ de kho na'i mtshan nyid gang yin bshad pa nas gzhan las shes min zhes gsungs pa ni 'di la gzhan las shes pa med pa ste/ lung med par bdag gis mngon sum du 'gyur zhing bdag nyid kyis mngon sum zhes bya ba'i tha tshig bordzo/zhes semags dang/ tshig gsal las kyang] gzhan gyis bstan pas rtog par bya ba ma yin gyi rang nyid kyis rtogs par bya ba yin no/ /zhes sogs dang / 'jug 'grel las/ de kho na nyid bsam pa la 'phags pa rnams kho na tshad ma yin gyi/515
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/sogs dang/ yang de nyid las/ dngos 4 byas pa can la ma reg par rang bzhin 'ba' zhig mngon du mdzad de/ zhes sogs dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa ni rang bzhin nyid yin zhing /de yang bslu ba med pa nyid kyis don dam pa'i bden pa yin la/ de ni de rnams kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba yin no/ /zhes sesnags lta bu du ma'i mdo bstan bcos 〈snad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang zos bsam bsgom pa'i blo gsum las sgom pa'i skabs su stong nyid sgom mi rigs lte/ bden pa'i skye ba med do/ /zhes dang / bdag med do zhes sgom pa ni bdag sgom pa yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems 'grel las/ skye med ces dang stong zhes dang / /bdag med ces pas stong pa nyid/ /dman pa'i bdag nyid gang bsgom pa/ /de ni 'di na bdag sgom pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan zer ba ni 'phags pa lhas/ dam chos 'di yi ming las kyang/ /dam pa min la 'jigs pa skye/ /zhes pa ltar chos 'di sgom pa lta ci ming la'ang skrag pa'i cho ྅ yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis stong nyid bsgom na chad stong du 'gyur bas sems sgyu ma lta bur sgom zhes dang / sems gsal la ngos bzung med pa sgom/zhes dang / hwa shang ltar yul gang dulang 'di'o zhes bzung na bdag 'dzin du 'gyur bas : yang yid la mi byed/ ces sesnags lta ngan gyi spros pa sna tshogs smras yod phal cher bkag zin la 'di ni dbu ma'i lugs ltar gyi skye med dang/ stong nyidadang/ bdag med gsum ltar ma yin pa de las dman pa'i bdag nyid de rang bzhin nam gnas lugs sgom pa ni bdag bsgom pa'am mthar lta bsgom zhes pa yin gyi/ de ltar mi 'thad na byang chub sems 'grel la nang 'gal yod par smra dgos par 'gyur te/ de las stong nyid sgom par yang yang bshad pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ bdag nyid chen po sangs rgyas dang / /brtser ldan kun gyis dus kun tu/ /stong pa mkha' dang mtshungs par mkhyen/ /de phyir chos rnams kun kyi gzhi/ /zhi zhing sgyu ma dang mtshungs pag /gzhi med srid pa 'jig pyed pa'i/ /stong nyid 'di ni rtag tu sgom/ /skye med dang ni stong nyidadang] /bdag med ces 516
stag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/bya stong pa nyid/ /bdag nyid dman pa gang sgom pa/ /de de sgom par byed pa min/ /zhes rab zhi'i 'gyur la pa tshab kyis bcos pa las byung la/ yang de nyid las/ sems la dmigs pa med pa yi/ /gnas pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid yin/ /de dag stong nyid sgom pa ni/ /nam mkha' sgom par bzhed pa yin/ /zhes stong nyid mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bur sgom par bshad pa dang / yang de nyid las/ gang dag stong nyid mi shes pa/ /de dag thar pa brten ma yin/ /las drug srid pa'i brtson rar ni/ /slongs pa de dag gsor bar 'gyur/ /de ltar stong pa nyid 'de ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis sgom byas na/ /gzhan gyi don la chags pa'i blo/ /'byung bar 'gyur bar ze tshom med/ /ces pa lta bhu bstan bcos re re na'ang du ma mthong lte/ spyod 'jug las/ stong pa nyid dang bral ba'i sems/ /'gag pa slar yang skye 'gyur te/ /'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug bzhin/ /des na stong nyid bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ de ltar stong pa nyid phyogs la/ /sun 'byin pa ni 'thad ma yin/ /des na ze tshom mi za bar/ /stong pa nyid ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa yi/ /mun pa'i gnyen po stong pa nyid/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen 'dod pas/ /de ni ji ltar sgom mi byed/ /ces sogs dang / rdo rje snying 4 rgyan gyi rgyud las kyang / rnam 'byor gcig gcig shes byas nas/ /dbeen par sesnang ste rab 'bad na/ /sdig dag tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub/ /chos bdag med par rab bsgom pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa khong du chud/ /ces spyod 'jug dang mthun par bshad la/ mdo 〉nga 'dzin rgyal 4 las kyang sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang gzhan yang rgyal ba rang nyid stong nyid btsal tshul dang sgom tshul sogs bshad nas stong nyid sgom tshul yang yang nan tan du gsungs te/ mdo de nyid las/ su dag nags khrod mngon par dga' ba yi/ /dge grang de ni shin tu bde ba myong / /su dag ci la'ang bdag gir bya ba med/ /yongs su 'dzin pa rnam pa kun tu spangs/ /bse 517
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/ru bzhin du 'jig rten 'di na gnas/ /nam mkha' la ni lung dag rgyu ba bzhin/ /lam rnams bsgom zhing ye shes rab tu zhugs/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa bdag med par/ /chos rnams 'di dag gang gis rab bsgom pa/ /de yi spobs pa dag ni mtha' yas 'gyud /zhes yon tan mang po yod tshul dang] yang de nyid las/ gang gis chos 'de stong par goms byas pa/ /de dag 'od zer bye ba stong rnams rtag tu 'gyed/ /nyi ma'i dkyil dngor dag kyang thams cad gzi med byas/ /dpa' bo de dag mi ring 'drin par 'gyud /zhes bsgom na sangs rgyas thob pa dang /yang de nyid las/ ngas sngon spyod yul zhi ba 'de ni rab tu bsgoms/ /bskal ba mang po bye ba khrag khrig stong du yang / /lam 'dir ngas ni nam yang brtson 'grus rgyun ma bcad/ /de tshe mar me mdzad kyis rgyal bar lung yang bstan/ /mdo sde 'di la khyed kyis nga yi rjes su slobs/ /zhes rgyal ba rang nyid kyis kyang stong pa nyid spros pa thams cad zhi ba brtson 'grus kyis bskal ba du mar bsgom pa ltar nga yi rjes su slobs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rigs kyi mdo de nyid las/ nga ni myangan 'das gyur phyi ma'i tshe/ /dam pa'i chos ni rnam par 'jig pan/ /dge slong mu stegs slo la brtson padag/de dgangs zhi ba'i chos la spongs/ /zhesadang]dedag 'jigs shing skraganas khyim spangs te/ /rab tu byung nas shin tu dam du 'dzin/ /skyes bu dam pa'i zeg pa spangs byas nas/ /bye brag lhag par 'dod pa brlag par 'gyug /zhes sogs kyis lung bstan pa ltar stong nyid sgom zer mkhan gyi lugs spongs padangadagra ltar bedzin par ma byed cig/'on kyang khyed kyis 'grel bderadeng sangani bshad ma thag pa'idabu ma chen por grags padag gis phyogs kun gang bar 'gyur bas/nas/ mdo sngags kun nas 'di shin tu rtogasadaka' bas khong du chud pa mang po mi 'byung bar bshad palang 'i 'bad par 'gyur te/ dbu ma chen po'i don khong du chud nas phyogs kun gang ba'i phyir ro//zhesadang/shog gu'i mkha'angos kun snag tshasanag por byas nas/ zhes 518
wa wa ltagatshangabal 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/drenags la bltas na phrag dog gi mes rang rgyud thal bar byas tshul la ya nga la gang ltar zab mo ma spongs shig/khyod kyi thal 'gyurade ni rgyal ba dang mdo rgyudangesadon du ma la lanal brjod du snang ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyes/ su la bstan kyang bo bar mi nus pas/ /nma smra zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ mdo tshan re re'am tshigs bcad re gsungs na'ang bye ba khrag khrig du mas bden pa mthong ba dang yang de snyed kyis dgra bcom thob par bshad pa'i phyir dang / gsang 'dus las rgyud bshad ma thag nam mkha'i khams gang ba tsam gyis sangs rgyas gsar thob bshad pa'i phyir dngan gsung mkhanadang chosadedag mi 'bad smra'am/ yangan rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum midagos pa dang yon tan gang yang med pa'i 'od kyi sangs rgyas ltabu gcig lasad dam/ yang sa dang po'i skabs su'ang skad cig ma zung 7stos gcig la 'jig rten khams brgya la 'gro/ sems can brgya smin pa sogs brgya phrag bcu gnyis thub na byang sems gong ma dag bsam gyis khyab bam/ de dusadabu ma chen los phyogs kun gang ba bden yangango mi mtshar lte/ byang semasadag la'ang mthu de ltar yod na kho bo'i rje bla ma rgyal ba gnyis pa ni rgyal ba thams cad kyi yab gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs su nges don du gnas la drang don gyi tshul byas na'ang mdo kun btus las/ sngon bskal ba dpag tu med pa brjod kyis mi langs pa'i sngon rol khu la)ga rten gyi khams 'dir 'dzig rten gyi khams dang ba'i 'od ces bya bar rgyal ba dbang po'i tog ces bya ba byung bar bshad pa ltar rgyal ba de'i lhagar rgyal sras rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su'ang zab mo tshel ba la sa ma'on 4 dag gis 'gran mi nus pa dang lung bstan bsngags brjod dpag med mdzad na deng dus lta ci smos/des na zab mo stong nyid nyan bsam sgom gsum la rang gi lus srog longs spyod bskal pa du mar gtong ba la ngo mtshar ci che gzhan gyi 'di'i tshig sbyi tsam 'chad pa po rang gi bla ma min pa la yang sangs rgyas ltar gus shing de'i sku gsung zugs la sngon rabs kyi gtam ltar 'bad nas dus 519
grub mtha'i rnam bshabākun tu nyin mtshan med par sgra dbyangs sras po'i sher phyin btsal ba ltar rigs te/ skyon thams cad 'gog byed dang khams gsum gyi btson las sgrol byed 'di kho nar nges pa'i pyir dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' khor gsung rab gzhan kun nub pa las sher phyin gyi tshig gcig nub pa gnod par bshad pa sogs kyi phyir te/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ brten nas 'byung ba'i de nyid gsal mdzad pa/ /chub pa'i lugs bzang skye ba thams cad pu /lus dang srog kyang btang nas 'edzin pa la/ /skad cig tsam yang lhod par ma gyur cig/sogs dang/ting 'odzin rgyal 4 las/ zas la mi chags mi skam za ba yin/ /lus dang smra1ga la lta ba rab slongs la/ /stong pa shin tu zhi ba bsgom par gyis/ /zhes dang / tshigs gsal las kyang / gang gi phyir 'di de ltar yin pa de'i phyir shes rab can rnams kyis srog dag kyang yongs su btang ste de kho na nyid btsal bar 'os pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus bcom ldan 'das ma ji ltar btsal ba bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /gzhan yang stong nyid rtogs pa'i bsam byung gron du btang nas de rjes su stong nyid mi sgom par sems dmigs pa med pa'i had lasdog hwa shang dang mi 'dra zer ba'ang mi 'thad de/ de'i bhyor ba mi 'dra ba bden 'ang dngos gzhi'i skabs su shin tu mthun te/ hwa shang gis gang la dmigs sam bzung na mtshan 'odzin du 'gro bas gang yang yid la mi byed zer la khyod kyis stong pa'o bden med do dang bdag med do zhes bzung na bdag bedzin du 'ju bas yod med yin min gang yang mi bsams pa'i shes byed du chos nyid spros dang bral ba la/ shes pa'ang spros dang bral bar bzhag/ces drang ba'i nyid 'di shin tu tha chad yin nta/ so so skye bo'i sems gcig yod phyin chad dmigs pa gcig la mi dmigs pa mi srid pa'i phyir dang] yang sems med na ci yang med pa'i spros med sgom pa'ang mi 'thad pa'i phyir dang / bsam gtan bzhi pa ma thob pa'i so skye la sems ci yang med pa'i sems dgag pa mdo gong 'og gang nas kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir 520
ltag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/dang/ sher mdo sogs las dmigs med dang yid la mi byed par bshad pa ni de bzhin nyid la dbyad na kun rdzob kyi gnyis snang med pa la byed par sher mdo rang las gsungs pa'i pyir te/ ji skad du sgom rim tha ma las/ gal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa yod na ni de'i tshe des gdon mi za bar ci zhig la dmigs dgos te/ so rtso skye 4 rnams kyis shes pa ni slo bur dudamigs pa med par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhesadang] yang de nyid las/ ji lte med na ni de'i tshe ji ltar chos rnams kyi ngo bo nyid med par rtog par 'gyug zhes dang/ de nyid las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa ma thob pa'i so so skye bo'i sems ni 'gog par 'gyur mi srid do/ /zhes dang/ de nyid las/ de lta bas na dam pa'i chos las dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa med pa 'byung ba de yang/ yang dag par so sor rtog pa sngon du 'gro ba yin par blta bar bya ste/ gang gi phyir yang dag par so sor rtog pa nyid kyis dran pa med pa dang yid la byed pa med par nus kyi gzhan du ma yin no zhes pa bzhi rtags zur bzhi dang sbyar bar bya ladamigs padang mi dmigs pa'i don yang sher mdo mdo btus su drangs pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba ji tsam du gnyis pa de tsam du dmigs pado/ /mi gnyis pa ni mi dmigs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang/ de lta min na lta ba la dpyad pa sngon du btang ba'i gnyid 'thug po'ang lta ba'i sgom yin par 'gyur la/ de lta na int+ra bo nyis ye shes grub pa dang / dus na'or las yid la mi byed pa'i don de ltar min par bshad pa dang 'gal la sgom rim gsum rtsogasadang yang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /khyod kyis lung des ni shes pa spros bral la lasdog par bshad la de la shes pa lasdog padang gnas pa ni 'dzin stangs gonas 'jug gnas sogasadagos kyi/ de dag med par mi stan la sdod pa ltabu'i gnas tshul med pa'i phyiradang/ srid zhi la gnas mi gnas bshad pas rtso/ /lung de gnyid dus kyi spyod lam la'ang sbyi1ra dgos pas nyin mo'i sgom dang mi 'brel la/ thos bsam dus su bdag med kyi lta bas dpyod kyang sgom dus 521
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/lta ba mi sgom par mi rtog pa'i sgom zer ba ni phyin ci log yin par jo 'o yab sras bzhed de/ 4 to ba'i pe'u bum las/ kha cig thos bsam dus na rigs pas/ /rang bzhin med par gtan la phab nas/ /sgom dus mi rtog 'ba' zhig sgom zeg /de lta na ni 'brel med stong nyid/ /logs su sgom phyir gnyen por mi 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rtsa'agrel dang / jo bo'i lam sgron las/ stong nyid bdun bcu'i rigs pa dang/ /nas/ sgom pa'i phyir na rab tu bshad/ /de bas chos rnams ma lus pa'i/ /rang bzhin dag ni mi dmigs pas/ /bdag med pa ni sgom gang bzhin/ /de nyid shes rab sgom pa yin/ /zhes sher phyin rigs tshogs ltar sgom par bshad pa dang der ma zad lazhug sgom dus su yang dbyad nas rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad ma mthong bar bdag med du stong cham gyis song ba de la mi rtog mi dpyod par mnyam bzhag nam mkha' lta bur sgom par bshad pa'i phyir te/ byang chub lam sgron las/ shes rab kyis ni tshos rnams kun/ /gang gi rang bzhin ma mthong zhing/ /shes rabade nyid rigasadapyad pa/ /rnam rtog med parade sgom sga /zhes pa nas/rtog med ting 'dzin la gnas/ /nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal/ /zhes shes byed dang bcas pa dngaka dbu ma'i man ngag las kyang] de kho na gtan tshigs chen po rnams kyis gzhig cing btsal na/ skra'i rtsemo brgyar gzhags pa'i tshad tsam kyang gzung du med do zhes nges par khong du chud par bya'o/ /nas/ de lta bu la shes pa gnas bar bya'o/ /zhes dbu ma'i don de lta bu la shes pa gnas par bshad pa ltar mchan rnying du mas kyang bshad pa lam sgron dang mthun pa'i phyir te/ lam sgron las/ lung dang rigs pa dag gis ni/ /chos rnams thams cad skye med pa'i/ /rang bzhin med pa nges byas nas/ /rnam par rtog med sgom par spha /de ltar de nyid sgom byas na/ /rab dga' la sogs thob par 'gyug /sangs rgyas byang chub yun mi ring / /zhes sangs rgyas bar du mnyam bzhaganam mkha' ltabur sgom par gsungs pa'i phyiradang de ltar du snying 4 bsdu bdanganor bu'i 522
ltag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun badzodapa'i skor/phreng ba sogs du mas bshad do//yang gzhan skye medod pa la lagal brjod bcu gcig pa/debashamātsa46sagazhanaskye g.yothenadang1/bdaga'adod tsalagyisagagaskyes 46 laltag/zhes smras te/kho na re/rdzas grub med dang dngos 4 yod pa 'gal//gzhan skye med dang sa myug rdzas gzhan 'gal//zhes rtsabar 'gal ba yod khul la 'grel bar rdzas yod mi 'dod par btags yod kyis khyab par smra na de bzhin no//zhes smras nas rang re'i lugs la bden kha byin la rdzas tsam yod med dpyod pa ni kho 'o ni rang 'grel la lta tsam yang myong ri zhes rang mtshang sgrogs pa ste/bum pa phrog pa la rdzas phrog pa'i tha snyad sun 'byin mi rung bar bshad pa'i phyir/ de mwa la lan lta ci rjes zlos yang mi 'os then/ /'grel ba des sa myug rdzas gzhan khas mi len na ni/ zhes pa nas/ rdzas gzhan bskyed bya skyed byed la gzhan skye mi byed pagang 'jig rten gyi tshad ma rang lugs la khas len pa 'gal ba yin no//zhes so//'o na/gzhan skye'i gzhan de yod par thal/de sa myug tha snyad du rdzas gzhan yin pa tsam la byed pa'i phyiga'akhor gsum song]'dod na/dngos po thams cad gzhan gyis byas pa dang skyed par 'gyur zhing /de lta na sa lu ljang ba'i mdo las/mig sogs bdag gis ma byas gzhan gyis ma byas bar bshad pa sogs dang 'gal la/ 'phags pas//sna sna /lha snang hā/ kṣiṃ rnyi( ji /sa/ pa// ñdza lha rlo dang /spra ༵ /sna rshapa/ la/rgyu/ spyashā lha( ṭwāṃ las/ dngos po rnams gzhan las skye ba ma yin te/ gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa dang /mtha' bzhi khas mi len par bshad pa sogs du ma dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / dngos 4 skye'o zhes pa'i tha snyad tsam gyis de tsam gyis 'jog mi thub par thal/de skye na bdag las sam gzhan las sam gnyis las sam rgyu med las skye zhes dpyad pa'i tshe rjed pa'i phyir te/de'i tshe gzhan 523
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/skye rnyed pa'i pyid sangor gsum khas blangs/ 'jug pa las/ gzhan las skye ba 'dzig rten las kyang med/ /ces gsungs pa'ang mi 'thad par thal/ gzhan skye tha snyad du yod pa'i pyir/ lubor gsum khas/ sa 'on dang myu gu rdzas gzhan yin pas gzhan skye cis kyang dgos na 'o na/ bu dang btsugs pa'i ldon pa gnyis kyang bdag las skyes par thal/ 'jig rten pa'i tha snyad la bdag gis bu 'di bskyed shing 'di btsugs zhes smra zhing grags pa'i phyir lubor gsum la lan med do/ /'jug pa las/ gang phyir 'jig rten sa 'on tsam btab nas/ /bdag gis bu 'di bskyed ces smra byed cing / /shing yang btsugs so snyam du rtogs des na/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs du ma dang 'gal bar 'gyur ro/ /yang kho'i thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen par mi 'dod pa dang lam bzod lugs la 'gal brjod bcu gnyis pa dang / bcu gsum pa ni/ bskal mang gnas kun bamag kyang 'bras dus ma /ji nyedagacigakyang mishes lamarigagasag /lhag medagazugasarigagatan med skyabazhi 'gal/ /zhes smras te/ 'di ni sngar ltar sangs rgyas la ji snyed pa gcig kyang mkhyen pa'i ye shes med par 'dod pa 'gal ba snga ma dang kho rang gi rtsabar/ 'phrin las bsam yas gzhan snang rnam rol rnams/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku dang 'phrin las bsam yas brjod kyis mi langs pa rnams nas/ gdul bya'i las bzang po'i dbang gis gdul bya dang de'i gzhan snang gi rnam rol kho na yin par bzhed de zhes sku bzhi 'phrin las gdul bya'i gzhan snang las med par 'dod pa la 'gal ba gnyis pa byas te/ sa bcu pa las/ de khyad par can gyi chos yongs su tshol ba la mngon par brtson pas 'dzig rten na yi ge dang bstan bcos dang rtsis dang rgya dang / zhes sogs ltar bskal ba grangs med du mar rigs pa'i gnas kun bslab kyang 'bras dus ji snyed gcig kyang mi shes pa'i lam bzod lugs kyi rim pa mdo sde 524
stag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/rgyan sogs mdo bstan bcos du ma dang rang tshig yang 'gal la/ lhag med sangs rgyas kyi sa na sems med na sems byung yang ldog dgos/ de log na de gnyis la ma gtogs pa'i shes pa nang pa'i grub mtha' su yang mi 'dod pas ye shes kyang med dgos la sems dang sems byung ngam ye shes kyi sku med na gzugs sku gnyis kyang med dgos pas sku bzhi 'dod pa nang 'gal dang gsung rab kun dang rgyab 'gal yin la/ yang rgyu mthun sprul sku sku 'dra tsam yin zer ba ni rang gi ston pa zam sho dang bstan pa de ston pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi bstan pa dang rang nyid ston pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi bstan pa la zhugs par smra ba las khyod rang dma' 'bab lugs lha 'dre stong gis kyang ci byed/ des na 'di gnyis ka rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi lam bgrod lugs mtha' dag dang / sgrib pa spangs lugs thams cad dang / yon tan thob lugs thams cad dang re re nas rgyab 'gal bye ba'i phung ṭo yin te/ de re re nas su zhig gis yi ger nus/ gsung rab gcig dang yang mthun mi mthun bltas na shes la/ 'dir thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi lam bgrod lugs sogs dang 'gal tshul mdo tsam bstan na/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ sa 'on gyur pa khams de nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rten du 'dod/ /rim gyis sbyangs par gyur pa las sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyug /zhes dang / ji ltar tshes pa'i zla ba la/ /skad cig skad cig rgyas par mthong / /de bzhin sa la zhugs rnams kyis/ /rim gyi rim gyis rgyas par mthongaka /ji ltar yar ngo'i bco lnga la/ /zla ba rdzogs par 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin sa yi mthar zug na/ /tshos kyi sku yang rdzogs shing gsal/ /zhes khams rgyas byed chos rnams kyis sbyangs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi chos sku yar ngo'i zla ba rdzogs shing gsal zhes pas ye shes kyis thams cad gsal bar bshad pa dang 'gal la/ de bzhin du mdo dkon mchog smin las/ rigs kyi bu ṇḍa lta nye/dper na byi dor ma byas pa'i nor bu rin po che dang byi dor byas pa'i nor bu rin po che ni 'di lta 525
grub mtha'i rnam bshadlte/ zhes sogs kyis nor bu dri ma dag padang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku dngan sa bcu la lus mnyam pa sesnags bcus ma rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus chos sku ma dag ces bshad pa dang] mdo de nyid las/ rigs pa'i bu 'di lta lte/ dper na tshes gnyis kyi zla ba ni zla ba zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ba nas zla ba nya'i bar gyi zla ba yang zla ba zhes bya'i grangs su 'gro mod kyi tshes gnyis kyi zla ba ji ltab de lta bur ni zla ba nya ba ma yin no zhes sogs byang sems kyi 〈snan tan bsags pa'i lus ma rdzogs pa zla ba ma gang ba dang bden gnyis ltar sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsags nas rdzogs pa zla ba nya ba lta bur bshad pa dngan dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin mdo las/ 'phong gi slob ma ni smras mtshon pa la rdzog par byed par gnas pas phyis gang du'ang mi slob 'o/ /nas/ blo phros bstan pa de bzhin du dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'odzin la gnas pa'i byang semasakyis kyang chos gang la yang bslab par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de sngon legs par bslab pa'i phyir te/tingange 'dzin thams cad dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad dang rnam par thar pa thams cad dngad byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan gyi tshos thams cad de la mngon du 'gyur ro/ /zhes dper na 'phong gi slob mas dang po ba lang gi go ba nas mthar skra bcu dang / skra gcig la phog bar bslabs pas skras mtshon pa la 'og la des de gang 'dod la rdzog pa ltar rgyal sras kyis kyang thog mar bsam pa dang de nas skyongar ba lte/ rnal 'phyor dang /de nas lhag bsam dang / de nas byams sogs bzhi la rim bzhin dang de nas mngon shes lnga la lob pas phyin drug tshar phyin nas/ de nas thabs mkhas la dang / de nas brgyad pa'i bzod pa dang lung bstan la dang / de nas zhing bkod dang / de nas bcu bar sangs rgyas thams cad la dbang bskur thob pa dang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pas chos gang la gsar slob mi dgos la de bar du bslab dgos shing mdo gzhan las sa rtso so la yon tan stong 'gyur 526
ltag tshang ba la 'gal 'du nyer bdun brjod pa'i skor/serdzogs su gong 'phel du bshad pa mtha' dag mi 'thad par thal/ sangs rgyas sa na yon tan mtha' med de dag gcig kyang med pa'i phyir/ gakhor gsum khas/ 'dis sku gsung zugs kyi yon tan gong 'phel du bshad pa thams cad dang byang sems dang sangs rgyas nam mkha' dang khab mig tsam du bshad pa sogs kyis kyang dgag par bya'o/ /yang gsung rab nas sgrib pa je dag tu song gi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan che ru dang zugs yang gsal du las bar bshad pa rnams dang] khyad par du rgyud bla ma las/ nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa deg /sprin dang 'dra bar brjod pa yin/ /sgrib pa gnyis dang bral ba yi/ /rgyu ni ye shes gnyis yin te/ /mi rtog dang ni de yi ni/ /rjes thob de ni ye shes 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar shes sgrib de shes bya thams cad yongs su gcod pa'i sgrib pa nyi mas sa kun gsal bar byed pa la sgrib pa'i sprin lta bu dang / de dang bral ba na don dam mkhyen ba'i mnyam bzhag mi rtog ye shes dang ji snyed thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gnyis 'byung bar bshad pa dang 'gal te/ khyod ltar na sangs rgyas pa dang nyi ma nub ste mun 'phebs pa stong nyid tsam las gang yang mi shes pa'i phyir dang / chos dbyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar mar me bumanang gnas/ /cung zhig snang ba mi 'gyur ba/ /nas/ gang tshe ting 'dzin rdo rje yis/ /bum pa de ni bcag gyur pa/ /de tshe de ni nam mkha' yi/ /mthar thug bar du snang bar byed/ /ces bumanang du rin 4 che'i snyon me bzang 4wend kyang gzhan mi gsal ba ltas nyon 27ngas pa'i sgrib pas mi gsal la bum pa lta bu bu ga cung zad byas pas phyogs re gsal ba ltar sems can gyi sgrib pa cung zad re spangs pas phyogs re'i shes bya mkhyen la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nyon mongs pa'i bag chags shes sgrib bum pa lta bu de bcag pa na nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i shes bya gang yod la mkhyen pa'i 'od kyis khyab par bshad pa dang 'gal te khyod kyi de ltar mi 'dod par bum pa bcag pa dang 'od med par 'dod pas so/ /shes sgrib zad kyang shes 527

mdo gne spyod pa'idagag bya ngos 'dzin gyiskor/dbu ma snang ba dang] bden gnyis las/ gang zhig gis sam gang zhig la/ /yang dag sgrib byed kun rdzob bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar yangadag pa'idon la blo gang gis sam blo lda yod pasas sgrib pas na kun rdzob ste ma rig pa dang / bden gnyis las/ des na 'di kun bden pa lte/ /dam pa'i don du bden ma yin/ /zhes pa ltar ma rig pa de'i ngor bden gyi/ dam pa'i don du mi bden pas na don dam bden pa las ngo 'o dbyer med kyang ldog pas 'gal ba gzhan du byas pa'i kun rdzob bden pa zhes sgra bshad ni/sher mdo las/ rab 'gyor phyin ci log ma gtogs par gang la 'jig rten gnasanas byis pa so so skye 'o rnams las mngon par 'du byed par 'gyur ba'idangos so bden pani skra'i rtsemo'i cha shas gzigs pa'i tshad tsamakhang medado//zhes gsungs la/ mtshan nyid ni kun rdzob tu 'jig rten gyi tha snyad phyin ci ma log pa ste/de'i yul tha snyad pa'i chos ni mthong ba'i don yod pas na kun rdzob bden par bzhag ste/rtog ge 'bar ba las/ kun rdzob ces bya ba ni gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos po kun rnam par 'byed pa'idon gyis te 'jig lten gyi tha snyad phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /de nyid bden pa ste/ rnam par bzhag pa thams cad la 'gro ba'i tshad ma yin pa'i pyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gna'i tha snyad la yuladang yul can gnyis bya lte/ mdo du ma'i don yin te blo spos mi zad pa'i mdo las/de la kun rdzob kyi bden ba gang zhe na/ji snyed du 'jig rten gyi tha snyad gdags pa dang] zhes sesna/ /bden gnyis kyi dgos pa tshogs gnyis mtha'alpus pa bsags pa'i ched dang] kun rdzob med paradon dam rtogs mi nus la don dam ma rtogs par sgrib gnyis spangs mi nus pa dang/ de yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu sa lnga'i skabs ltar legs ldan gyis bshadado/ /donadam gyidabye ba thal rang lab la kun rdzob bden pa ladabye tshul gnyisate gcigani med kyangasku'od par slo btags pa ma yin par brtenanas skyes pa'idangos ṭo thams cad yangadag kun rdzob bden padang] yangadag par skye ba sogasadang sems tsam pa'idonadang grangs 611
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/can gyi gtso 'odang rgyang phan gyi sems can 'byung ba las skye ba sogs su grub mtha'i dbang gis btags pa'i blos bzos pa thams cad log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa yin te/ bden gnyis las/brtags pa'i don gyis dbeen gyur pa/ /dngos tsam brten nas gang skyes te/ /yang dag kun rdzob shes par spha /zhes yang dag pa dang/ de nyid las/ yang dag min ni kun btags yin/ /zhes so/ /'jog tshul gnyis pa ni rang snang ba'i blo la snang ba ltar don byed nus pa'i chos yang dag kun rdzob bden pa dang / de ltar mi nus pa'i chos kun rdzob pa ni log pa'i kun rdzob bden pa ste/ chu dang rta dang sgra la sogs pa dang po dang smig rgyu dang sgyu ma'i rta dang brag cha sogs gnyis par bshad cing] bden gnyis las/ snang du 'dra yang don byed dag /nus pa'i phyir dang mi nus phyis /yang dag yangadag ma yin pa'i/ /kun rdzob kyi nidabye ba byas/ /zhes dang/ rang 'grel las/yang kun rdzob ni rnam pa gnyis te/ zhes slar yang dbye ba 'di bshad cing / rnal 'phyor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnam bden dang mthun pa dang mdo sde rgyud pa'i dbu ma'i gde ltar snang ba ltar don byed nus kyang/ rnam rdzun dang mthun pa dag gis mi rung la/ dbye ba snga ma'i sems tsam gyi don log pa'i kun rdzob tu rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma pa gnyis kyis mi rung zhing / lhag ma 'dra la a bya'i lugs so so'i dbang gis phyi don med pa dang kun gzhi yod pa'ang bshad kyang / thub dgongs su phyi don med pa zla ba ltar bkag cing kun gzhi yang mi bzhed pa legs ldan dang spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs dang ye shes snying 4 rnams 'dra ste/ de yang dbu ma snying 4 las/ rnam shes zhes bya'i rnam grangs kyis/ /bdagani nges par bstan pa yin/ /zhes sesnags kyis kun gzhi bkag la nyon yid kyang med par bshad 'dod de/ rnam par smin pa dang] ngar sems padang] rnam par rig pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa 'gal ba gsum med kyi sems kyi gnas skabs kyi ming de chags par bzhed pa'i phyir te/rtog ge 'bar ba las/ rnam par smin pa dang / ngar sems 612
mdosde spyod pa'i lamadang 'bras bu'isnyor/pa dang /rnam par rig pa zhes bya ba rnam par shes pa gsum gyur pa de bdag cag gis mi 'dod do//'on kyang de ni sems kyi gnas skabs kyi khyad par yin par 'dod do//zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa'o//bzhi pa bden gnyis nges byed tshad ma ni/mja rjesaganyisadang 63 sumagasulabazhi rig/zhes pa la rang rgyud pa gnyis das mngon sum tshad ma dang rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis yul mngon lkog sgo nas dbu ma snang ba dang rnam nges ltar 'dod la rang sbyis kyang rung tsam mo/mngon sum tshad ma la mdo sde spyod pa dbang mngon yid mngon rnam 'byor mngon sum gsum 'dod cing/rnal 'byor spyod pa'idabu ma bsade gsum dang rang rig mngon sumadang bzhir 'dod/gzhal bya'i gnas gsum sogs kyang tshad chen rtsa'agrel la bltasan mthunano//rgyas parade sogs su lta'o//lnga pa 'bras bu thob dus sogs ni/rigasanges: dang rdzogasabyangabthālhag/7gsumigasangagakhubabaṇḍasasumabargya rtsogag/zhes smras te/de yang sto 'byor rgyud pa'idabu ma ltar na mngon pa kun btus ltar theg chen rigs nges kyis cig car nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa yin la/legs ldan yab sras ltar na theg chen rigs nges kyis mdo sde sa bcu pa ltar sa brgyad par dgra bcom pa bzhin du nyon mongs sa bon dang bcas pa spangs la nyon mongs kyi bag chags dang bden 'dzin skor sgyi ma gsum skad cig spyor gyi mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib gnyis gtan zad de kun rtog sogs zhabrul ba'i bag chags ma lus pa zad pa dang rdzogs byang thob pa dang sku bzhi mngon du mdzad pa dus mnyam ste/rtog ge 'bar ba las/bskal ba grangs med pa gnyis pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i sa brgyad pa la ni/zhes pa nas/skye ba med pa'i chos la bzod pa thob pa de'i nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa nidagra bcom padang 613

dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bden gnyis kyiskor/dang 'bras bur 'brel ba mi 'gal ba dang / rang bzhin med kyang ji ltar mthong bzhin pa'i chos thams cad mi 'gal ba'i de ltar ni/ yab dang sras mjal ba'i mdos bstan te/ zhes gsungs shing / 'dir ni dpyad na bdag med kyang las dang de'i 'bras bu'i 'brel ba 'thad pa dang / rang bzhin nam rang ngos nas grub pa med kyang mngon sum drug gis ji ltar mthong bzhin pa'i yul mngon gyur drug sogs 'thad par de dag mi lagal bar bshad pa'i phyir rang bzhin med na tshad grub mi rung zer ba yang legs par bkag 'dug cing / dbu ma pa'i lugs la las 'bras dang skyes bu sogs thams cad kun rdzob thams cad mi 'dod zer ba yang legs par bkag lte/khams drug reg pa'i skye mched yid kyi nye bar rgyu ba bco brgyad rnams kyi khams re re skye ba'i tshe yang gang nas mi 'ongs 'gag pa'i tshe yang gang du yang mi 'gro ba sogs yin yang khams de dag la nang du bud med dang phyi'i skyes par dmigs nas chags snang dang 'phrad 'dod kyis phrad de mer mer nur nur sogs skya mtshams spyor yang kun rtog zhakhrul ba ma gtogs dpyad na skyes pa skyes pas stong pa serdzogs yin pas khams dedag la skyes pa'am bud med ming tsam brda tsam las med tshul/ mdo de nyid las/ rgyal 4 chen po skyes bu gang dag 'di ni khams drug pa sesnags gsungs pa 'jug 'grel du'ang drangs so/ /gang zag dang la 〈snags chos thams cad ming tsam las med kyang las gsogs padang rnam smin phyong tshul/ yang mdode nyid las/ rgyal 4 chen po de ltar na chos gang yang 'jig rten lan nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'pho ba yang med la 'chi 'pho dang skye bar mngon pa yang yod de/ zhes pa nas/ de ci'i pyir zhe na/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i phyir te/rnam par shes pa tha ma ni rnam par shes pa tha mas stongaka las ni las kyis stong] rnam par shes pa dang po ni rnam par shes pa dang pos stongaka 'chi 'pho ni 'chi 'phos stong lte/ skye ba ni skye bas stong la/ las rnams 'bras bu med par mi 'gyur zhing/ rnam par smin pa myong bar mngon pa yang 703
grub mtha'i rnam bshabāyod de/ de la ming gi brda tsam ma gtogs par byed pa 4'am za ba 'o gang yang med do/ /rgyal po chen 4 'di lta ste/ dper na mi zhig nyal ba'i 'i lam na/ zhes sdugags gsungs/ 'jug 'grel du'ang] 'jug pag gang zhig rang bzhin gyis de mi 'gag pa/ /de'i phyir kun gzhi med kyang 'di nus phyig /la lar las 'gag yun ring lon las kyangaka /'bras bu yang dag 'byung ba rig par gyis/ /zhes pa shes byed du drangs pa'i phyig zhi ba lha dang zla ba'i zhabs/ dgongs pa gcig dang dbyangs gcig par snang la/ de bzhin du rje bla mas kyang lam gyi gtso 4 rnam gsum sga kun rdzob rgyu 'bras/ slu ba med pa dang] /stong pa khas len bral ba'i go ba gnyis/ /ji srid so sor snang ba de srid du/ /da dung shub pa'i dgongs pa rtogs pa med/ /nam zhig res 'jog med par cig car du /lter 'brel mi slu mthong ba tsam nyid nas/ /nges shes yul gyi 7rin stangs kun lareg na/ /de tshe lta ba'i dpyad pa rdzogs pa lags/ /zhes dang / dkon mchog sprin las/ 'jig rten pa'i tshos sulang 'dod chags la don dam par 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams su'ang mi dmigs shing mngon par mi chags rtso/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams su'ang 'dod chags la don dam par sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams su'ang mi dmigs shing mngon par mi chags so/ /zhes dang/ de bzhin du mdo du mdang rin chen phreng ba las kyang] ji ltar me long ma brten pas /rang bzhin gzugs brnyan mi snang ltas /phung po rnams la ma brten pas /ngar bedzin pa yang de dang 'dra/ /'phags pa kun dga' 4 yis ni/ /de lta bu yi don thob nas/ /chos la mig thob bdag nyid kyis/ /dge slong rnams la bzlas te smras/ /zhes dang / jo 4 rje lha gcig gi bden gnyis las/ yang dag kun rdzob khyad bsad nas/ /stong pa nyid la goms byed na/ /kun rdzob rgyu 'bras dge sdig sogs/ /'jig rten pha rol bslus par 'gyud /zhes dang/des na rgyu rkyen sna tshogs kyis/ /bskyed pas snang ba thams cad grub/ /ces drenags lta bu dag gis sesna/ /704
dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bden gnyis kyisnyor/bdun pa bden gnyis bstan pa'i dgos pa zhakhrul spong dang bcas pa ni/ dgosaphyagogakunbzlogadang zang blangs lhag /gnas skabasagasulabarastong nazlosabrasagasag /zhes smras te/ 'dir stag lo na re/ stong nyid bstan pa'i dgos pa ni/ bdag 'dzin bzlog pa'i ched dang /stong nyid min pa'i spros bral zhes pa yod pa'ang ma yin med pa'ang ma yin/ gnyis ka'ang ma yin/gnyis ka ma yin pa'ang min pa des lta ba bzang ngan gang yin dang spros pa'am gang du bzung tshad thams cad bzlog dgos pa ni/ bzhi brgya bar dang 4 bathend nams ma yin bzlog pa bstan pa dang / bar du bdag bzlog pa dang tha mar lta zhig kun bzlog par bshad pa'i dgongs par byas la/ shāka mchog sogs du mas kyang de bden snyam nas spros bral ni stong nyid zab mo'ang 'gog byed du gdod pa mi yod de/de la dbu ma las/ stong nyidadagos dang stong nyid dang] /stong nyid don ni ma rtogs pas/ /de'i phyir de ltar gnod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar stong nyid kyidagos pa dang] stong nyid kyi mtshan nyid dang / stong nyid kyi tshig la rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhes rang bzhin sbyar ba'i go don gsum ma rtogs pa'i slongs tshabs chen po yin te/ stong nyid kyi dgos pa lta ngan kun dang las nyon gshor ba sogs spros pa ma lus pa sgom spang bzlog pa'i phyir du yin pa'i phyir te/ tshig gsal las/ des na stong pa nyid kyi dgos ba ji zhe na/ 'di ni las dang nyon mongs zad pas thag /las dang nyon mongs rnam rtog las/ /de dag spros las spros pa ni/ /stong pa nyid kyis 'gag par 'gyug /zhes bdag brtags par bshad zin to/ /de'i phyir spros pa ma lus pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir stong pa nyid nye bar ston pa yin te/ de'i phyir stong nyid kyi dgos pa ni spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba yin na/ khyod kyis ni stong pa nyid kyi don med pa nyid yin par rtog cing / spros pa'i dra ba kho na spel bar byed pas na stong pa nyid kyi dgos pa ma rtogs pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs rtso/ /des na khyod kyis stong nyid mtshan nyid khyad par lnga ldan yang ma go ba yin 705
grub mtha'i rnam bshadte/ de go na spros bral gzhan du pyin ci log de mi 'chad pa'i phyir te/ tshig gsal las/ de nas stong pa nyid gang yin zhe na/ de yang gzhan las shes min zhi ba dang/ /spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/ /rnam rtog medadon thadad min/ /de nide nyid mtshan nyidado/ /zhesade nyid du bshad zinato/ /de'i phyir stong nyid spros pa thams cad log pa'i rang bzhin la med pa nyid ga la'angad/de'i phyir khyod kyis stong nyid kyang mi shes pasan no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyogs snga'i mthil du khyed cag snang bas bag yod par mdzod cig /lhag ma sla la/ yod min med min dngos 'gal du sngar yang bshad la der ma zad/ dbu ma las/ stong pa nyid la ltanyisan/ /shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyug /zhes pa'i skyon 'byung ste/ de'i 'grel ba tshig gsal las/ deni gnyis ka ltar yang stong nyid la ltanyis pas phung bar byed pasanano/ /ji ltar zhe na/ gal te thams cad stong pa lte/ /thams cadawend pa ma yin no//zhes rtogasanani/de'i tshe dzado log par ltabar 'gyurate/ji skad ma chos lan log par bzung gyuran/ /mi mkhas rnams ni chud kyang za/ /'de ltar med par ltabs/ /mi gtsangaderani bying par 'gyud/zhes bshadado//zhesagasungs pa'i phyig yod pa masan padang med pa la khyad par mi snang bas lugasanganadedag la g.yang za bar gyis shig/yang gangadag stag lo sogs kha cig sdonadang da ltar stong nyid rtogasanades tshog/kun rdzob kyi las 'bras la spang blang gramonas midagos zer ba yang blun po'i tha shaladangangan shos su gsungs te/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ rnam paradapen don mi shes la/ /thos pa tsam la 'jug byed cing/ /gangadag bsodanams na byed pa/ /skyes bu tha shal dedag brlag /cesadang/ zla bsade'i 'grel bag gangadag stong nyid so sor rang gis rtogs pa med par stong nyid kyi sgra thos pa tsam khonas/ bya ba byas pa rnams spyod pa'i lad mo byed padagani mi dge ba'i las nyid la zhugs payin gyi/dge ba lani mayinate/dedaganinges par snyobastogag rgyas pa'i bya tshul/ byi'u tshul/ byi'u phrug slo gzhog ma skyes pa'i rjes su byed pa bzhin du nyon mongs pa 706
dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i bden gnyis kyiskor/gcig bu'i mthar 'argyuraro//zhes panagade nyid kyi pyir nyis pa 'doyongs su spang bar bzhed pas bcom ldan 'das kyis nyan ba 4 rnams kun rdzob kyi bden pa lasaspenangs su mi nyams par bya ba'i don du re zhig thog ma khonas las rnams 'bras bur bcas nyidadang] /'gro bdag kyangasangadag bshad/ /gang du gnasanas sems can rnams las rnams byed padang/ de'i 'bras bulang nye bar za bar 'gyur ba/'phyo ba lnga podag bcom ldan 'das kyis bstanarto//zhesadang]sher mdo las kyang sum 4rtsagasum gyi bya phung po chen bo gnag slo med padaper byasate bshad pasanadedag spangs te/ 'jug pa las/ de nyid nye bar bstan pa'i snodanideyinate/ /de lades rjes su 'gro ba'isku'on tan 'byung/ /zhes sogs ltar mdzad 'tshal/brgyad pa ni/ 'o na khyod kyi lugs la/ bzhi brgya pa las/ bsod nams min pa dang por bzlog /bar du bdag ni bzlog pa dang] /tha mar lta zhig kun zlog ba/ /gang gis shes de mkhas pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bzlog rgyu'i bdag dang lta ba gang yin dang gnas skabs kyi khyad par ci lta bu zhe na/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa thabs la mkhas shing gdul bya rgyud snod rung du rim gyis byed tshul rim pa gsum du las 'bras sogs kyis chad lta bzlog pa dang] gtsang bde rtag bdag bzhi'i tsho/ shārnyi lca dzornyi sna ḍā pal kyirji rshasdu nga shā druṃ ༷dī /rnyi ghnā shāgam ༵ rlonga~X sna/lha /shā 'gog pa dang / de ltar bstan pas rgyud smin te zab mo'i snod du rung ba na/ sher mdo sogs las rags pa'i bdag med dang rags pa'i bden med gnas lugs mthar zug tu 'dzin pa bzlog par ma zad bden 7)na sogs ltar gyi spros pa yod do cog kun bzlog pa ni mdo lang gshegs ting nge 74na rgyal 'o sher mdo sogs dang / rigs tshogs rjes 'brangs dang bcas padang sngags kyi rgyud dang dgongs 'grel chen po'i lugs rnams kyidagongs payin tshul bstan 707
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/pa'i phyir tshigs bcad gcig smras pa ni/ dang 4ra las 'bras sogs kyis brtsod min bzlog /bar du mi rtag rtsogs kyis bdag gnyis bzlog /tha marade nyid mngon du gyur rim gig/ltakunadri bcasatsasdo sngab9ubazhed/ces pa ni/ rin chen phreng ba las/ dang por mngon par mtho thob pas/ /phyis ni nges par legs pa 'byung / /zhes pa ltar mngon mtho sogs kyi rgyud smin ched du las sogs bstan cing / de myong ba'i bdag yod pa sogs bstan pa yinate/ rtsashe'i rnam bshad las/de ltar na gang zag rang skya thub pa'i rdzasaphungad du 'dzin pa'i yul sun ma phyung bar las bsog padang 'bras bu myong ba'i bdag yod par gsungs pa ni/ ngan 'gror mi ltang ba dang bde 'gro la 'god pa'i phyir du las 'bras kyinges pa skyed pa'i phyir yin/ zhes dngakabrgya ba'i 'grel ba las/ bstan pa 'di ni rim gyis 'dus byas thams cad bzlog par bya'o/ /de la 'dir re zhig bsod nams min pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog pa ni dang por bya ste/ mthong ba dang ma mthong ba'i nyes pa brgya phrag du ma'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir te/ spangs par sla ba dang por bzlog par bya'o/ /zhes dang/ tshig gsal las kyang] 'din gangadag ltabangan pa'i rab rib kyis/ zhes pa nas/ blo nur nur 4 la sogs pa'i 'byung ba chen 4 yongs su smin pa tsam las byung ba nyid du smra ba gron gyi mtha' dngad pyi ma'i mtha' la skur ba 'debs par zhugs pa 'jig rten 'di yang med de/ legs par byas pa dang nyes par byas pa'i las kyi 'bras bu'i rnam par smin pa yang med/sems can rdzus te skyes pa yang med do/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag gi yangadag pa ma yin pa'i lta ba de bzlog par bya zhing / gdul bya dman pa dang 'bring bo dang mtshog rjes su gzung bar bzhed pas/ gdul bya dman pa sdig pa mi dge ba byed pa rnams mi dge ba las bzlog par bya ba'i phyir zhes pa nas/ 'ga' zhig tu bdag go zhes kyang btags gyur cing ste bzhag par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs la de'i rgyu mtshan gdul byadaman pa la bdag dang bdag med gnyis las bdag bstan 708

dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu'i rnam bzhaglag drug cu gsang ba bsam mi khyab dang /rtog ge 'bar ba dang/mdo sde rgyan gyi 'grel ba rnam bshad rigs pa byang sa nyi rṇi snang ba sogs ltaradang/rgyud bla ma las/mthongan tshem mdzad yon tan gang //sum cu rtsaganyis zhes bya ba//sprul ba chos la rdzogs par ni//longs rgyud rdzogs sku gnyis la brten//zhes pa ltar de gnyis la ldan pas 'der bshad la lan ni gsung gi gsang ba yang yin no//lnga pa ni/gsangagasumarogisakun khasaskalabasamathong /skad cigabaskalabarabazlogdpas5reg/ bkod kyangasprukhalabazhinache zungasamā/zhes smras te/sku gsung zugs kyi gsang ba bsam mi khyab kyi le'u gsum las shes dgos la kun la khyab kyang skal bas mthong tshul sogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang ye shes yul la 'jug pa sogs dang rgyud du ma dang dbu ma snying 4 rtsa'agrel sogs du ma las bshad yod/ /dpe tsam byas na rgyud bla ma las/brgya byin rnga sprin tshangs pa dang //nyi ma nor bu rin chen bzhin//de bzhin gshegs pa sgra brnyan bzhin/ /nam mkha' dang ni sa bzhin no/ /zhes brgya byin sa gzhi dwangs par mthong nas smon sogs ltar thub sku yang gdul bya'i las sgrib bral ba'i dang ba'i ngor shar nas smon pa sogs dang rgyas par bshad pa lta bu gdul bya rang rang gi skal bas de tsam mthong gi sangs rgyas byang sems mthong bde yis ma bstan pa min lade bzhin du skad cig bskal bar byin gyis slobs padang bskal ba skad cig dudang/rdul phra rab gcig dang ba spu'i khung bu cig tu 7)ga rten thams cad bkod kyang phan tshun che chung du mi 'gyur la mi dogs pa nam mkha' ltabu lte/'jug pa las/thub dbang skad cig kho nar de'i rgyu mthun//zhes pa nas/dag pa 'di ni bzhed pa 'jug pa yis//rdul gcig yul la mkha' gtugs 'jig rten dang //'jig rten mtha' yas phyogs khyab rdul ston mod//rdul rags mi 'gyur 'jig rten phra mi 'gyug/zhes sogs ltar rgyas par 759
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/'jug pa rtsa'agrel dang mdo du ma sogs ltar ro/ /drug pa ni/ stobasab ngajiga'adrephubaco brgyad rtsogag/rmad byungazanganatagasalusrgyalarnams chig /brjod la4gas kyang4 rdzogs mkha'isprutha' bzhin /zhes smras lte/ 'dir dpal ldan zla ba dang thogs med kyi rgyud bla ma'i 'grel ba dgongs pa gcig ste rgyud bla mar yang rin 4 che'i rgyal po bkru ba gsum dper mdzad nas/ mthar thug zeg pa gcig tu mdzad la zla bas kyang sprul sku'i skabs su bshad cing thogs 'grel las bdag med gnyis kyang 'jug pa ltar bshad cing / gzungs rgyal gyi mdo la brten nas stobs sogs 'phrin las so gnyis bshad pa 'jug 'grel du stobs dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ma 'dris pa bco brgyad la mdo de drangs nas bshad pas rgyas par der shes dgos shing 'dir khyad par 'ga' smras na/ rgyud bla ma las/ gnas dang gnas min las rnams kyi/ /rnam smin dang ni dbang 4 dang / /khams rnams dang ni mos pa dang / /kun 'gro'i lam dang bsam gtan sogs/ /nyon mongs dri ma med pa dang / /gnas ni rjes su dran pa dang / /lha yi mig dang zhi ba dag /mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rnam pa bcu/ /zhes gsungs te/ gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / dbang 4 mtshog dman mkhyen pa'i dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i dang / mos pa sna sogs mkhyen pa'i dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i dang / bsam gtan sogs dang dri ma med pa mkhyen pa'i dang / sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye sogs mkhyen pa'i dang / zag pa ma lus pa zhi ba mkhyen pa'i stobs te stobs bcu'i gnas dang gnas min mkhyen pa nas thams cad du'am kun tu 'akro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang po drug gis nyon mongs can min pa'i mi shes pa shes sgrib go cha ltabu 'jigs par byed pa'i rdo rje ltabu dngaka bsam gtan rnam thar sogs dri med mkhyen pa'i dang] sngon gnas rjes dran mkhyen pa'i 760
dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu'i rnam bzhagdang] 'chi 'pho /snags mkhyen pa'i stobs gsum ni snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa rtsig pa lta bu 'jig pa'i rdo rje lta bu dang / zag zad mkhyen pa'i stobs ni nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i shing rnams gcod pa'i rdo rje lta bu yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ stobs sogs rnams las stobs drug dang / /gsum dang gcig gis rim pa bzhin/ /shes bya snyoms par 'jug pa dang/ /bag chags bcas pa kun bsal bas/ /go cha rtsig pa shang bzhin du/ /phug dang gzhig dang bcad phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du mi 'dzigs pa bzhidang sangs rgyas kyi chos nyan rang sogs gzhanadang ma 'dris pa bco brgyad de bral ba'i yon tan so gnyis dang rnam smin gyi yon tan mtshan bzang so gnyis te ldan chos drug cu rtsabazhi rgyud bla 'dir dngos su bshad la der ma zad sogs sgras dpe byad brgyad cu dang yang sogs sgras sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dris pa'i tha snyad bco brgyad kho nar zad dam zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan sems can dang mo 'dres pa sum brgya sogs kyang yod la de re re'i yon tan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa mdo so so nas shes dgos te/ 'jug 'grel las/de la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ni bco brgyad de/ zhes pa nas/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dris pa bco brgyad gang yin pa de dag ni/ zhes sogs kyi gzungs rgyal gyi mdo drangs nas bshad la rtog ge 'bar ba las/ grangs med pa dang / dpag tu med pa dang] rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid chen po bstan pa ni mdo sde du ma las snang ste/ 'di lta lte/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gzugs kyi sku mtha' dang dbus med pa yongs su dag pa zhes pa nas/ de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' dang dbus med pa bcu yin no/ /de bzhin du skad cig ma la sangs rgyas rnams kyis ye shes bcu mngon par bsgrub pa lte/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dus las mi 'da' ba bcudangaka sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlab mngon par sgrub pa'i ye shes bcu dang / gzhal du med pa'i khongs 761
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/su gtogs pa nyid bcu dang/ shes rab 'chal bas bsnyen par dka' ba che zhing rgyas pa'i lhasnas bcu dang/ bdag nyid che ba nyid bcu dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa bcu dngaka sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa bcu dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rigs pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'dren pa bcu dngakasangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa bcu dang / sems can gyi snying po'i chos bcu dang/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi ma chags par gnas pa bcu dngaka sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyan bcu dngan sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang phyug la dbang ba bcu dang / sangs rgyas rnams kyi yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa bcu dngan sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs la mkhas pa bcu dngan sangs rgyas rnams kyidagongs pa bcu dngan sangs rgyas rnams kyi stobs bcudang/ chos kyis phyug pa'i chos bcu dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas pa bcu dang/ chos thams cad ma lus par mkhyen pa nyid bcu dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas pa bcu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran pa rnam par dag pa bcu dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa myur du masang ba'i chos bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin bcu dang/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par bzhag pa bcu dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa bcu lte/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa sum brgya ṭo 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa bcu pa'i mdo las bstan to/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa dang shun mong ma yin pa nyid yin no/ /gang yang gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang] dkon mchog sprin dang] sa bcu pa la sesnags pa'i mdo de las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba'i bdag nyid nye bar bstan pa rnams khyad par du shes par lasad na/ mdo de dag nyid kun tu blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa dang] rgyud bla ma las/ yon tan drug cu rtsabazhi po/ /'di dag so sor rgyur bcas te/ /go rim ji bzhin rin chen gyi/ /mdoyi rjes 'brang shes par sga /zhes dang/ de'i snga 'grel las/ de ltarade bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcudangad mi 'jigs pa bzhidangan sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa 762
dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i 'bras bu'i rnam bzhagbco brgyadadang/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsaganyis podedag rnam pa gcig tu mngon par kyu/ ༈ ṇā /shā rmo spras swā ṭwāṃ nd+ra/ sa/zhe sna ṭā] dzño )pa dābyini~X ñtsha dzo ṭwāṃ (pa spra kṣiṃ mkha'i mtha' bzhinano/ /ji skad du 'jug pa las/ nam mkha' med pas 'dab chags ldog par mi 'gyur gyi/ /sogasadang/ de'i rang 'grel las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gzugs sku'i ba spu'i bu ga re redang] skyes bu chen po'i mtshan dngadape byadadang/ stobasadang/ mi 'jigs padang/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma phres pa la sogs payonatan gyi khyad parayongs su gcod parani sangs rgyas khonas spyod la/ galate gsungasanani rang nyid kyis shes kyi yul du gyur pa bskal ba grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab par skuche'i tshad byin gyis brlab cing 'phrin lasagazhan mi mnga' bar skyen pa skyen paragasungs pade ltaranayangayonatanadagayongs su rdzogs par mi 'gyuran byang chub semasadapas ltaci smosate/ zhes so/ /bdun pa ni/ gang 'dugecasaposa'o:galasartagasaston/zhes smras te/ de la sbyor sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad la 'phrin las re yod pa dang / gtso 'o ni stobs bcu'i 'phrin las dang/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i 'phrin las dngaka ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi 'phrin las te 'phrin las so gnyis yod kyang de tsam du ma zad de gdul bya re 'dul ba'i 'phrin las re ston pas bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' la de thams cad 'bad med lhun grub dang phyogs thams cad khyab par dus thams cad du 'jug lte/ gzungs kyidabang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bude la de bzhin gshegs pa'i las gang zhen/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i las ni sum cu rtsaganyis 4 'di dag go/zhes pa nas/ rigs kyi bu gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las gang yin pa de ni tshad med pa'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis rnam par shes par 763
grub mtha'i rnam bshad/bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /yi ge rnams kyis brjod par bya ba ma yin pa'o/ /gzhan dag gis thob par dka' ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rgyun chad pa med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnya5 pa nyid du rjes su song ba'o/ /zhes sogs dang] yang mdo de nyid las/ de'i phyir rigs gyi bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang/ kun gyi rjes su song ba dang / thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med pa dang/ dus gsum gyi rjes su song ba dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung rgyun mi gcod par rnam grangs 'dis rig par bya ste/ nas/ rigs kyi bu gang rgyun chad med pa rgyun chags pa rgyun mi gcod pa byang chub sems dpa'i lung bstan pa'i gtam rgyun mi gcod pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'phrin las yang dag pa'o/ /zhes dang/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ gang gi srid pa ji srid pas /'go la phan pa sna tshogasadag/mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bzhin gshor ba ji srid 'di'i/ /las ni rgyun chad med par 'dod/ /ces pa lta bu mang ngo / /'dir smras pa/gang gi zegs ma ze tshom gyis spyad kyang / /gshor ba'i rgud pa kun 'phyog 'chi med zas/ /ci dgar spyod pa'i grags snyan 'byor ba'i tshogs/ /rnam sad tshal bzhin mig yid rna ba'i gsos/ /ming rtog tsam las nam yang chos gang yang / /med kyang srid zhi 'byor rgud thos bsam bsgom/ /'bras bus mi slu ngo mtshar ri mo 'bum/ /byed pa med kyang rab bkra e ma mtshar/ /gdod nas dag kyang slongs 'khrul sgyu ma yi/ /chos brgyad 'dod pa'i yul lngas ches 764

grub mtha'i rnam bshad/phyir dang] de'i dngos gnyen bden med phra ba'i lam sgom thub pa'i phyir dang / de la the tshom don 'gyur skyes na'ang thar pa'i sa 'on 'grog thub pa'i phyir te/ bzhi brgya pa las/ bsod nams chung ngus chos 'di la/ /ze tshom za bar yang mi 'gyur/ /ze tshom zos pa tsam gyis kyang / /srid pa hrul por byed par 'gyug /zhes dang] de nyid shes pas gal te 'dig /mya ngan 'das pa ma thob kyang] /tshe rabs gzhan du 'bad med par/ /grol 'gyur nges pa'i las bzhin no/ /zhes dang /dbu ma las/ rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams ma byung zhing / /nyan thos rnams kyang zad pa na/ /rang sangs rgyas skya ye shes ni/ /brten pa med pa rab tu 'byung / /zhes so/ /des na yul mchog bden med phar phyin theg par bstan kyang/ shes rab de gcig pus shes sgrib kyi 'ching ba las mi grol bas/ dri ma med par grags pas zhus pa las/ thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ni 'ching ba sogs dang / sa ra has/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid zhugs pa/ /des ni lam mtshog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /zhes sogs bshad la/ des na yul stong pa mchog bstan kyang yul can bla med kyi bde chen ni sngags kyi rgyud lde 'og ma gsum du yang ma bstan na/ de'i rnam bzhag de man chad du ci'i phyir ston pas sbas la/ de bzhin du srang bya dug gsum gyi dri ma'i gtso bo shes sgrib skor dgu bstan cing / de'i gnyen 4 bar chad med lam gsum sogs bstan kyang snga ma rnams la rnam rtog dang las rlung gtan log mi dgos par spang rung la/ shes sgrib chung ngu'i chung ngu spong ba la de gnyis gtan log dgos shing / de ldog byed kyi gnyen ṭo bla med kyi bde chen ma bstan pa'i pyig shes sgrib chung shos phra lhastos sngags las mdo rkyang pas mi nus so/ /do ha las/ bde ba'i de nyid dang ni bral gyur cing / /lus kyi dka' shub 'ba' zhig tsam bltan pa/ /nas/phal cher mi mchun phyogs la zhugs pa yin/ /zhes dang / ye shes grub pa las/ ma lus sprengang rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /slongs pa gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni gshor 766
